items.quote: there is a gradual increase month-on-month for Dombivli Hospital. yes, it is ramping up pretty well on both the interest from doctors and the patients.

items.statement: PI Intermediate performance expected to be sustained for FY27 based on order visibility
items.quote: Given the order visibility in this particular molecule, we believe this performance can be sustained for FY27.

items.statement: Capex guidance of INR250 crores for FY27 maintained at company level
items.quote: At the company level, it will be similar amount.

items.statement: Vizag Phase 1 investment of approximately INR1,000 crores over next 3 years
items.quote: This phase represents an investment of approximately INR1,000 crores over the next 3 years.

items.statement: Unit 3 backward integration project at Mahad with INR210 crores invested and further INR40 crores committed
items.value: INR210 crores invested, INR40 crores committed
items.quote: We have invested already about INR210 crores on this project with a further INR40 crores committed in the next couple of months to complete this phase.

items.statement: Strong order book for PI API with visibility for next 3-4 quarters
items.quote: On our side, we have a s trong order book now. And the plant is running very consistently. Production is happening consistently. So at least for the next 3 or 4 quarters, I think we have very good visibility

items.statement: Gross margin at 53% reduced by 3% sequentially due to raw material price increase and product mix
items.quote: Reported gross margin at 53% is a reduction of 3% over previous quarter and reported operating EBITDA is 33.5% compared to 30.4% in the previous quarter, an increase of 3%.

items.statement: Operating EBITDA margin expanded to 33.5% from 30.4% due to operating leverage on higher sales
items.quote: Our operating EBITDA at 33.5% is an increase of 3% over previous quarter. This expansion of gross EBITDA margin is on account of operating leverage on a higher sale.

items.statement: Raw material prices increased significantly post geopolitical situation from March; pass-through to customers with few quarter lag
items.quote: We have seen significant increase in raw material price across board post geopolitical situation to be very precise from March. Raw material price increase has partially impacted Q1 performance as material consumed were more fro m purchases made in the previous quarters

items.statement: Contrast media segment stable with long-term arrangements; usage increasing across geographies
items.quote: I think the overall segment is doing well. And the usage of contrast media across geographies is increasing. And from our standpoint, the optic requirements are quite stable. As you are aware that they are backed by long-term arrangements. So we see a lot of stability in the segment and a good traction because we would be launching a few intermediates in this phase too.

items.statement: Expect to launch 3 candidates in Contrast Media and initiate pilot for new high-intensity sweetener in FY27
items.quote: During FY27, we expect to launch 3 candidates within the Contrast Media segment alongside initiating pilot activities for a new high-intensity sweetener.

items.statement: 4 high-conviction NCE programs in chronic therapy (oncology, CNS) progressing through customer development
items.quote: From approximately 20 high conviction NCE opportunities we have been tracking, we now have visibility for 4 programs with the chronic therapy space which are progressing well through customer development activities.

items.statement: Raw material pricing trend uncertain due to geopolitical situation; difficult to forecast impact
items.quote: Given the current geopolitical situation, raw material pricing trend will be uncertain in the period to come, and it will be difficult to forecast the impact in the current scenario.

items.statement: Successful QIP completion strengthens balance sheet and provides financial flexibility for long-term strategy
items.quote: The successful completion of our QIP , marks an important milestone in Blue Jet's growth journey. It not only strengthens our balance sheet, but also provides us with the financial flexibility to accelerate the execution of our long -term strategy.

items.statement: Hyderabad R&D center expected to become operational this month with focus on peptides, GLP-1 intermediates, biocatalysts, continuous manufacturing
items.quote: Our Hyderabad R&D center also remains on-track and is expected to become operational during the current month. Further strengthening our ability to support customer development and expand our chemistry capabilities.

items.statement: Credit cost expected to fall to around 2% by year-end from 4.4% annualized.
items.quote: Credit cost on annualized basis at 4.4% flattish, but due to a lower net NPA stock and slippages well under control, we estimate the same will come to around 2% by the year -end.

items.statement: ROA expected to reach 2% by year-end FY27.
items.quote: ROA, we expect that it will be 2% by year -end.

items.statement: NIM may moderate but expected to stay above 7.5%.
items.quote: However, we expect that NIM could be kept at a level above 7.5 percentage.

items.statement: Asset/book growth guidance of 22% to 25%.
items.quote: See, book growth, we have given the guidance only to the extent of 22% to 25% on the asset growth.

items.statement: FY28 ROA seen higher than FY27 revised estimate.
items.quote: But as it stands today, it will be more than that we are seeing in FY27 as per the revised estimate.

items.statement: Steady-state ROA seen at 2% to 2.5%.
items.quote: But on a steady-state ROA, I think 2% to 2.5% will be a good guess given the growth rate as well as the expense, which is additionally required for the investment in IT, technology, spread, etc.

items.statement: Effective tax rate expected around 25.5%.
items.quote: Effective tax rate will always be around 25.5.

items.statement: Plans 50 new branches this year; 17 already opened.
items.quote: For this year, we have planned 50 branches out of that 17 is already opened and operationalized.

items.statement: Gold loan portfolio to be maintained at 40% to 45% of book.
items.quote: Thank you, Sebin, and we'll be continuing at almost this level, 40% to 45% we will be continuing.

items.statement: Overall gold loan book LTV at 72%, below regulatory upper limit.
items.quote: And our overall book level LTV is at 72%. We are not going for the upper limit.

items.statement: May raise Tier 1 capital by end of this year if price levels are appropriate.
items.quote: So, keeping all these in mind, if the price level comes at appropriate level, we may hope for raising Tier 1 capital by the end of this year.

items.statement: Corporate loans exposure reduced; expected to remain in current range.
items.quote: We have reduced our corporate loans exposure, and we expect them to remain in the current range as we continue to focus our efforts on increasing the MARG and EH portfolio.

items.statement: ESAF 2.0 digital/IT transformation to be fully implemented by end of this calendar year.
items.quote: We estimate it to be fully implemented by the end of this calendar year.

items.statement: Cautious on West Asia crisis; no material impact so far.
items.quote: While these events have not had any material impact on our business or operating performance, we remain cautious and watchful for future developments.

items.statement: CFO expects margins to improve substantially over next 2-3 years, with a different margin trajectory.
items.quote: And as explained in my earlier calls as well, I see the margins are going to improve substantially from here in next 2 to 3 years it will be a different margin trajectory.

items.statement: CFO says margin will stabilize from Q2 or Q3, with no additional one-time costs except Aadhaar Seva Kendra.
items.quote: None to my knowledge. The only thing which will have some temporary impact will be Aadhaar Seva Kendra that otherwise, I don't see any such onetimers going forward. So I think margin will get stabilized from Q2 or Q3.

items.statement: Normalized EBITDA margin was 17.2% excluding INR18 crore upfront RFP investments.
items.quote: On a normalized basis, excluding these upfront investments, EBITDA for the quarter would have been INR46 crores, translating into an EBITDA margin of around 17.2%, broadly in line with our historical operating performance.

items.statement: Incurred INR18 crore upfront investment for RFP mandate implementation, impacting Q1 EBITDA.
items.quote: The decline in margin was primarily driven by upfront investment of around INR 18 crores incurred towards the implementation of multiple RFP mandates.

items.statement: Aadhaar Seva Kendra rollout to be completed by Q3, with revenue already commenced.
items.quote: We have rolled out 75 ASKs across 24 states and union territories as of July '26. We expect to complete the implementation by Q3 and revenue from these centers has already commenced, and it gives us visibility into a recurring transaction-based revenue stream.

items.statement: Aadhaar Seva Kendra initial revenue estimates are in line with expectations; need one more quarter for visibility.
items.quote: Rohan, very early to say right now because the Aadhaar Seva Kendra are operational for last 3 - 4 months. So, we need to see the trend for at least one more quarter, and then we can provide some visibility on what kind of revenues. But having said that, the initial estimates are in line with our expectations.

items.statement: Aadhaar Seva Kendra margins not substantially low; will generate sustainable stable margins, not EBITDA accretive.
items.quote: The margin in Aadhaar Seva Kendra would not be substantially low, but as I said, we must see how the volume picks up in Q3 and Q4FY27 when these centers are stable and operational. Then only we could really figure out what kind of margin we will earn. But having said that, as I earlier said, these are not EBITDA accret

items.statement: Aadhaar Seva Kendra working capital not heavy; monthly recurring revenue, billed monthly based on volumes.
items.quote: Because this is a managed operational project, so working capital will not be heavy in this, except the initial furniture offices, which we need to set up. Otherwise, this is a monthly recurring revenue. And all the routine expenses, except the CapEx part will be out of revenues.

items.statement: New initiatives contributed 17% of Q1 revenue, up from 10% in FY26.
items.quote: I'm also encouraged by our new initiatives, which continue to deliver robust outcomes. This contributed 17% of our quarterly revenues as compared with 10% in FY26.

items.statement: New initiatives revenue of INR42 crores driven by RFP mandate, Aadhaar, and new products like eSign Pro.
items.quote: This is primarily because of the one, RFP mandate some revenue recognized because of that. Second one is Aadhaar, wherein we started recognizing the revenue. And third one is our new products like RISE with Protean or eSign Pro, where we started getting so me traction and therefore, the revenue is there.

items.statement: PAN market share increased 275 bps to 62% in Q1FY27 from 59% in FY26.
items.quote: Despite this, however, Protean showed resilience in its distribution capabilities, and we gained 275 basis points in market share, moving from 59% in FY26 to 62% in Q1FY27, while we issued over 1 crore PAN cards.

items.statement: Identity Services revenue grew 16% YoY with 20% volume growth.
items.quote: Third is our Identity Services, which is a strong source of transactional revenue. We delivered 16% revenue growth year-on-year, supported by 20% combined volume growth.

items.statement: Revenue from operations grew 19% YoY to INR251 crores in Q1FY27.
items.quote: Revenue from operations for Q1FY27 stood at INR251 crores, which is an impressive growth of 19% YoY as compared to INR211 crores in last year same quarter.

items.statement: Expect FY27 EBITDA margin ~21% vs 19% last year, translating to INR110-115 cr EBITDA
items.quote: We expect to close the year at around 21% EBITDA margins compared to the 19% of last year. So, that is a 200 basis point increase in EBITDA margins, which should translate to somewhere around INR110 crores or INR115 crores.

items.statement: Target Raipur exit occupancy ~30% by FY27 end
items.quote: We expect to close the year at around 30% occupancy at Raipur.

items.statement: Jamshedpur hospital commissioning expected late Q4 FY27, may slip to early FY28
items.quote: We are expecting the hospital to be commissioned by late of fourth quarter. So there might be -- if the approvals come in place, we are hopeful of starting that. But in case of any delay in approvals, it might be pushed to first -- the beginning of next year.

items.statement: Jamshedpur project debt ~INR25 cr to be drawn in FY27
items.quote: Jamshedpur will see an incoming debt, but that will happen in this FY. That will be to the tune of around INR25 crores.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 20.4%, PAT margin 9.9%
items.quote: During Q1 FY27, revenue from operations stood at INR126.2 crores, while EBITDA was INR26.2 crores, translating to an EBITDA margin of 20.4%. Profit after tax for the quarter stood at INR12.7 crores, with a PAT margin of 9.9%.

items.statement: Mature hospital occupancy healthy at 58.07%; Raipur occupancy improved to 17% from 7% YoY
items.quote: Excluding the newly commissioned Raipur facility, occupancy across our mature hospitals maintained healthily at 58.07%, reflecting steady patient inflows and continued demand for specialized tertiary care.

items.statement: Agartala occupancy dip due to Tripura tribal elections (month-long movement restrictions)
items.quote: Last quarter, there was a certain amount of dip in the occupancy level, and that was purely on account of the local elections in that area. There were tribal elections because of which the state had restricted movement during that phase of almost a month, which impacted the overall patient flow.

items.statement: Jamshedpur initial ARPOB INR38-40k, targeting Kolkata levels INR42-43k over time
items.quote: So the ARPOB -- initially, the ARPOB level at that hospital should be around the INR38,000 to INR40,000 mark. Slowly, as the hospital establishes, we expect it to catch up with the Calcutta level of around INR42,000, INR43,000 on current terms.

items.statement: Long-term ROE/ROCE target ~25%; levers: occupancy, lower ALOS, higher ARPOB mix, asset-light expansion
items.quote: Backed by a healthy balance sheet and disciplined execution, we remain committed to delivering sustainable earnings growth while targeting long-term ROE and ROCE of around 25%.

items.statement: Aims to at least double turnover in five years and grow EBITDA faster than topline.
items.quote: Business as is, the aim in five years to at least double the business and grow EBITDA faster than that pace.

items.statement: Plans calibrated price hikes: apparel 5-6%, fabric 7-9%, starting Q2.
items.quote: But my guess is between 5 % to 7% in apparel and between 7 to 8% in fabric. Because fabric will need between 7 % to 9% depending on the quality

items.statement: Garmenting margins could reach double-digit if product mix holds; no fixed timeline.
items.quote: if we can keep our combination right, which is the suit versus shirt versus trouser, this combination, the product mix there, then there is no reason why we shouldn't go to double-digit EBITDA actually.

items.statement: Expects very strong H2 FY27 due to delayed festive and winter wedding season.
items.quote: So my guess is that our H2 will be very, very strong.

items.statement: Casual brands ColorPlus and Parx growing double-digit; casual share in Park Avenue and Raymond up 200 bps.
items.quote: From the casualization point of view, ColorPlus and Parx, which are our casual brands, are growing at double digit. Also, the casual part in Park Avenue and Raymond Ready -to-Wear has grown up by 200 bps over last year.

items.statement: Raw material costs surged: wool up 100%, cotton/flax up 20%, chemicals up 30% YoY.
items.quote: if you look at wool, it is almost increased 100% over the same quarter last year. Cotton and flax has almost increased by about 20% over last year. Your chemicals have increased by about 30%.

items.statement: Net store openings in branded EBOs will be negative this year; rationalization to take 2-3 more quarters.
items.quote: our net openings in branded EBO stores will be negative this year.

items.statement: Ethnix shifting high-value products to made-to-measure; expanding to other channels for better ROCE.
items.quote: we are going to Made-to-Measure model from Made-to-Stock.

items.statement: Targets mid-teens ROCE for manufacturing-driven business as an outcome, not a chased target.
items.quote: I have done enough businesses in my life to know mid-teens is a good ROCE to have for a manufacturing -driven business, so that will be the endeavor, but that is not the target that I am chasing.

items.statement: Aims to restrict US share of garmenting exports to 55% and grow other geographies faster.
items.quote: I should think I should be able to restrict U.S. at 55% and still run my factories full and be ready to put in new lines and add capacity.

items.statement: Renewable energy share in factories to reach 25% by 2030, currently close to 12%.
items.quote: This year we are close to 12 % and we intend to get to 25 % by 2030, but my guess is we will reach that much before time

items.statement: Q1 depreciation included INR11 crores one-off; will not recur in coming quarters.
items.quote: There was a bit of an error which happened last year because of which there was a INR11 crores depreciation which has come in one time, that won't happen in the quarters going forward.

items.statement: Gross margin improved ~1% YoY in Q1 FY27 due to higher surgery mix; finance cost reduced from INR24.7 crores to INR23.5 crores YoY
items.quote: And as Dr. Adil mentioned, overall, the COGS, there was an improvement of about close to 1%, which roughly translated to a gross margin improvement of about 1%.

items.statement: Premiumization contributed ~7.5% and price hike ~0.5% to value growth in Q1 FY27 on like-to-like basis
items.quote: On the premiumization we are close to around 7.5%. And price hike, so far this year, we have realized around 0.5%. So, overall, closer to 8% is what we have realized from a premiumization and price hike.

items.statement: SSSG for pre-FY23 facilities grew 16.3% YoY in Q1 FY27 with volume and value each contributing ~8%
items.quote: Our most mature facilities, those which have been operational prior to FY '23 contributed to INR465 crores of revenue, recording a strong 16.3% year -on-year growth and accounting for 75.9% of the overall group revenues.

items.statement: High-end cataract surgeries 29.3% of total cataract; Femto cataract up 33.4% YoY to 1,548 procedures; SMILE up 36.2% YoY; retinal surgeries up 30% YoY to 3,861
items.quote: For this quarter, high-end cataract surgeries accounted for 29.3% of the 67,000 total cataract surgeries performed. Within the high-end surgeries, robotic cataract surgeries, what we refer to as the Femto Cataract, grew by 33.4% year-on-year, crossing 1,548 procedures for the quarter.

items.statement: Merger expected to close around mid-November 2026
items.quote: So, we are in the process of closing some of the final items when it comes to the merger, and we expect to close this around mid-November.

items.statement: Delhi NCR: 8 facilities currently, 3-5 more planned for remainder of FY27; North region revenue up 50.5% YoY to INR57 crores
items.quote: a year ago, we now operate eight facilities in this market. This quarter's additions include Faridabad, Shahdara and Ghaziab ad. This has further strengthened our hub-and-spoke model across the region. With three to five more facilities planned for the remainder of the year, we remain committed to building a meaningful presence in the Delhi NCR market

items.statement: Doctor count grew 23% YoY to 1,057; senior doctor attrition 2-3%, overall attrition 16-17%
items.quote: I think we're still at that 16%, 17% attrition rate overall at a group level. This includes a lot of junior doctors and a lot of students who have jo ined us. But still, our attrition rate for senior doctors is still at that 2% to 3%, it is very, very low right now for senior doctors

items.statement: Femto cataract adds ~INR35,000 revenue per procedure vs ~INR10,500-11,000 click fee; rupee gross margin increases
items.quote: Rupee gross margin will definitely go up because for a Femto cataract procedure, in terms of additional charge, it will be close to about INR35,000, whereas the click fee which you will be paying for the license, that comes to around INR10,500, INR11,000.

items.statement: AURIC Phase-1 go-live expected later this calendar year, ramping to 42,000 units/month within 4-5 months, likely by end of Q4 FY27 or early Q1 FY28
items.quote: Expect reliable daily output all throughout Q4, starting from first Jan itself. It is difficult for me to exactly pin down whether it is end of Q4 or into Q1 that the ramp-up to 42,000 units a month will finish, but it will finish sometime in that zip code.

items.statement: Total fundraise of Rs. 2,500 crores (Rs. 1,300 crore QIP closed + Rs. 1,200 crore preference issue pending) to fund AURIC Phase-1, potential Phase-2 fast-track, supplier capacity, and new product launches
items.quote: We are also in the midst of seeking shareholder approval and closing a fundraise of another Rs. 1,200 crores via preference issue, leading to a total fundraise of Rs. 2,500 crores.

items.statement: Paid preorders up 158% YoY to 1.5 lakh in Q1 FY27; monthly preorders now exceed 50,000 despite dealers stopping acceptance in many states due to 2+ month wait times
items.quote: Ather preorders, these are paid preorders that are captured across the country, they were up 158%, hitting a first-ever seen 1.5 lakh preorders in Q1 FY 2027.

items.statement: Adjusted gross margin fell 5.6% to 22.4% in Q1 FY27 due to commodity cost escalation (commodity index up 46% over 5 quarters); structural gains from price hikes, SKU mix, and AtherStack Pro attach partially offset the hit
items.quote: Net it out, we have landed up at 22.4% AGM for Q1 2027. A fairly respectable place, particularly looking at how strong the commodity hit was.

items.statement: ASP increased to Rs. 1.61 lakh (from Rs. 1.5 lakh) via price hikes and improved SKU management; price hikes are 100% margin accretive, SKU mix contributes ~25% to gross margin; further commodity hit of 100-200 bps expected but largely mitig
items.quote: The average sales price of Ather has now hit Rs. 1.61 lakh across the country, up from about Rs. 1.5 lakh as of last quarter.

items.statement: Industry EV penetration at 11% (up 44%), scooter EV penetration >25%; Ather inquiries up 95%, registrations up 102% YoY to 90,000+; unrealized retail potential of 13,000-15,000 units/month due to supply constraints
items.quote: Registrations for Ather grew from 44,900 units in Q1 to more than 90,000 units in Q1 FY 2027.

items.statement: EL scooter platform launch on 29th August; SOP and homologation complete; initial production at Hosur (up to 18,000/month) then scaling at AURIC (42,000/month); targeting 60,000/month combined; AtherStack Pro attach rate guided at 75%+ for
items.quote: EL scooter is already under production. High volume trials have already begun. SOP has already begun. Homologation is already completed.

items.statement: Commodity cost inflation may add another 100-200 bps margin pressure; PM E-DRIVE subsidy extension uncertain (15-20% of Q1 sales without subsidy); AURIC Phase-1 ramp-up execution risk; potential ASP dilution from EL launch
items.quote: I would say there’s probably another couple percentage points worth of risk left. There’s also a possibili ty that this could start cooling, but that’s extremely volatile and difficult to exactly predict when that happens

items.statement: Rs. 1,300 crore QIP closed with strong domestic and foreign participation; Rs. 1,200 crore preference issue pending shareholder approval; total Rs. 2,500 crore war chest for capacity expansion, supplier support, new products, and balance sh
items.quote: Recently, we finished closure of our Rs. 1,300 crore QIP a few weeks ago with very strong participation from funds, both from India and abroad.

items.statement: First ever positive EBITDA of Rs. 9 crore (0.8% margin) in Q1 FY27; fixed cost discipline to continue but AURIC Phase-1 costs to hit P&L from Q4 FY27; expect net-neutral impact as volumes scale
items.quote: Our EBITDA came in at a Rs. 9 crore margin for Q1 2027, which is roughly about 0.8%. It's a small number, but this is the first time ever we have delivered one.

items.statement: AURIC Phase-1 adds 5 lakh annual capacity (total 9.2 lakh); Phase-2 can add another 5 lakh (total 14.2 lakh) on same land with common infra; Phase-2 fast-track possible if demand trajectory holds
items.quote: Go-live of AURIC will take our total capacity up from 4.2 lakh units to 9.2 lakh units later this calendar year.

items.statement: Middle India (Gujarat, Maharashtra, MP, Chhattisgarh, Odisha) led retail growth at 141% YoY; Rest of India 118%, South India 76%; Tier-2/3 cities becoming largest volume drivers
items.quote: Middle India continues to be our growth driver, driving the highest growth among all zones for us. Middle India are the five zones of Gujarat, Maharashtra, MP, Chhattisgarh, and Odisha, which grew 141% in retail from Q1 last year to Q1 this year.

items.statement: Dealer inventory down from 14 to 3 days; new store openings paused in Q1 due to supply constraints; will resume after EL launch and AURIC go-live
items.quote: Our dealer stocks are down from 14 days to 3 three days, as of Q1 FY 2027.

items.statement: Non-vehicle revenue at 14% of operating revenue; AtherStack Pro attach rate 94% in Q1; long-term growth from service revenues (currently 2-3% of revenue vs 10-12% for mature 2W players) and accessories
items.quote: Non-vehicle revenue, the largest piece today for us is the AtherStack Pro, the software pack in our offering, which has done incredibly well for us, even better than we anticipated.

items.statement: Policy tailwinds strengthening: PM emphasis on transport electrification, Delhi EV Policy implementation likely, Haryana showing similar support; consumer sentiment shifting due to fossil fuel availability concerns
items.quote: I think all signs that we have seen are remarkably consistent from a policy perspective around the need to support electric vehicles.

items.statement: Targeting more than 300 gross store additions in FY27 with net additions of 150-200 stores
items.quote: We are confident to achieve our targeted expansion of more than 300 stores during this fiscal year.

items.statement: Expect 3-4% cost increase in H2 FY27 from raw materials, logistics, and labor
items.quote: For the second half of the year, and particularly between Q2 and Q3, we expect between 3% to 4% cost increase.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin expanded 50 bps to 16%
items.quote: Consolidated EBITDA increased by 14% Y-o-Y to Rs. 327 crores, compared to Rs. 286 crores in the corresponding quarter last year, while EBITDA margin expanded by 50 bps to 16%.

items.statement: Lifestyle Brands EBITDA margin expanded ~40 bps to 18.5% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: EBITDA stood at Rs. 319 crores, translating into an EBITDA margin of 18.5%, and an expansion of approximately 40 bps over the corresponding quarter last year.

items.statement: Emerging Brands EBITDA margin expanded 240 bps to 4.3% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Profitability also improved meaningfully, with EBITDA margin expanding by 240 bps Y-o-Y to 4.3% during the quarter.

items.statement: Taken small price hikes across brands to offset 3-4% cost increase
items.quote: Yes, we have taken smaller priced price hikes. They are not very large, but we have taken price hikes to compensate for that.

items.statement: Domestic demand conditions remain broadly consistent; consumer traction healthy across categories and channels
items.quote: As we reflect on the quarter, domestic demand condition s remain broadly consistent with the trends witnessed in the same quarter , despite continued global microeconomic uncertainty. Consumer traction remains healthy and well distributed across categories and channels

items.statement: Small-town network delivering double-digit growth for fifth consecutive quarter; growing at 15%+ vs metros at ~10%
items.quote: Tier 3, tier 4 markets where small towns are, which is a small part of our business, is growing in excess of 15%, while metros in Tier 1 is growing closer to 10%.

items.statement: Casual wear share increasing 2-3 percentage points annually across lifestyle brands
items.quote: We have seen even in a period of one year, you would find typically between two to three percentage point increase in the share of casual wear.

items.statement: Opened 68 gross new stores in Q1 FY27; retail footprint at 3,362 stores spanning ~5 million sq ft
items.quote: During the quarter, we opened more than 65 new stores across the portfolio. At the end of the quarter, our retail footprint stood at 3,362 stores, spanning nearly 5 million square feet across more than 800 cities and towns.

items.statement: Reebok revenue doubled from Rs 250 cr to Rs 500 cr in 2.5 years; targeting ~20% annual growth
items.quote: We more than doubled in less than three years. And I think the current trajectory gives us confidence that we can further double it in another 3, 3.5 years.

items.statement: Cautious on consumer inflation impact in H2 FY27; no meaningful demand shift seen yet
items.quote: We are cautious that this may play out in the second half of the year. And therefore, we have called out in our commentary. As and when it plays out, we will obviously have to respond to that at that point of time.

items.statement: Q1 typically contributes 21-22% of annual revenue but less than half that for profitability due to operating leverage
items.quote: This quarter is typically about 18, no, slightly higher than 20%, between 21%-22%.

items.statement: E-commerce profitability now marginally lower than retail; grew 23% overall and 50%+ on own platform in Lifestyle Brands
items.quote: Over the years, we have managed to bring this channel profitability very close to our retail profitability. It is just marginally lower than our retail profitability.

items.statement: Van Heusen Innerwear distribution at 38,000-40,000 trade points; targeting ~20% network addition over next couple of years
items.quote: Over the next couple of years, we expect in line with the overall growth, about 20% kind of addition in the network as well.

items.statement: Revenue growth guidance maintained at 35-40% YoY for FY27
items.quote: We would like to stick to the same guidance. It's more of a strategic play. The demand is huge. Obviously, our scale is negligible compared to the market size, but we will stick to the guidance that we have shared, about 35-40% annually.

items.statement: EBITDA margin of 10.5% expected to sustain for next few quarters driven by mix shift
items.quote: And we expect this to sustain for the next few quarters.

items.statement: Plan to add 2-3 million tons annual capacity in next two quarters by recycling existing deposits
items.quote: And we look to add about 2- 3 million annual capacity this year , in the next two quarters.

items.statement: GDV under execution increased to over INR 1,800 crores across 10 active DaaS projects
items.quote: As a result, our execution portfolio expanded to 10 active projects , with gross development value under execution increasing to over INR 1,800 crores , providing strong long- term revenue visibility.

items.statement: Contract manufacturing contribution reached 53% of revenue in Q1 FY27, targeting 55-60%
items.quote: During Q1 FY27 , this segment contributed nearly 53% of revenues, underscoring its growing importance within our business mix and strengthening our supply capabilities.

items.statement: Contract manufacturing utilization at 65-70% with significant headroom for growth
items.quote: Based on the annual capacity that we have in the revenue possibility. We are at a utilization of somewhere around 65-70% as on Q1 FY27. So, there is significant headroom for growth

items.quote: maybe 2026, I don't I'm not expecting that we'll reach the industry growth. 2027, this is what we -- where we are evaluating right now.

items.quote: the strategy that we put in place, we are offsetting a significant part of it. Thanks to specialization of the Goa site in certain products that are manufactured from Goa site.

items.quote: We are expecting as well certain tenders from South Africa that we are waiting for the result. So, strateg

items.quote: if we look for from quarter perspective, it's minus 5%. In YTD H1, minus 15%. And we continue. This will be the trend without impacting, of course, the top line.

items.statement: Toujeo grew 11% in market share value; Soliqua grew 16% quarter-by-quarter despite GLP-1 erosion; Lantus volume up 6%
items.quote: Toujeo, being the second preferred second generation basal insulin, has grown by 11% in the market share in value. This really talks about our consolidated leadership in basal analog segment as we continue. An

items.statement: Export business faces heavy competition in Australia for mature products; losses being offset by other markets and Goa site specialization
items.quote: Export, more or less, we are stabilizing. And we are facing certain challenge from Australia market where, heavy competition in this market for the mature products, but the good thing that, the strategy that we put in place, we are offsetting a significant part of it. Thanks to specialization of the Goa site in certain products that are manufactured from Goa site.

items.statement: Cash grew 34%; no buyback currently in strategy; dividend payout expected not lower than last year but no commitment
items.quote: when you look to the financial statement, you'll see that, it's a very healthy situation where you look to the cash of the Company. So, we are growing by 34% in terms of cash, no major risk that we're facing. So, the Company remain strong, and we I hope that we continue to deliver on as per expectation.

items.statement: Public sector expansion drove 70% of diabetes growth; digital outreach in tier 2/3 markets continues despite optimization
items.quote: close to 70% growth is attributed by that discipline of execution, expansion, and acceleration in public sector while we continue developing strategies with diabetes care in terms of making sure that we reach the last milestone with help of digital footprint.

items.statement: FY27 revenue guidance Rs 1,400-1,600 crore with EBITDA around 10%
items.quote: We expect revenue for Financial Year '27 to be in the range of Rs 1,400 to Rs 1,600 crores, based on the current pricing environment, with EBITDA in the region of 10%.

items.statement: New Rs 130 crore investment in Dahej progressing well despite war-related disruptions
items.quote: Our new Rs 130 crore investment in Dahej is also progressing well, and our teams have done a great job of keeping it on track in spite of the challenges and disruptions we have been witnessing on account of the war in the last few months.

items.statement: TDQ plant trial production underway with customer samples initiated; commercial supplies expected from Q4 FY27
items.quote: Trial production at our new TDQ plant in Dahej is coming along well with initiation of samples to customers. As approvals progress and commercial supplies ramp up over time, we believe this investment will further reinforce our competitive position in the market.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 11.2%, up 210 bps YoY and 480 bps QoQ
items.quote: EBITDA margins for Q1 FY27 stood at 11.2%, expanding by 210 basis points YoY compared to Q1 FY26, and by 480 basis points QoQ compared to Q4 FY26.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 export-domestic volume mix 33:67; export share expected to rise directionally to 40-45% over time
items.quote: In the 1st Quarter, we see exports about roughly 33% and domestic 67%.

items.statement: Specialty segment currently ~15% of revenue; expected to add 5-10% more over next 1-2 years
items.quote: Yes, so that should add to that. So, I would expect at least another 5% to 10%, we should see an additional.

items.statement: Deferred volumes from Q1 supply constraints expected to recover in coming quarters
items.quote: We continue to work closely with our suppliers and logistics partners to normalize supplies and execute the pending orders, and we remain confident of recovering the deferred volumes in the coming quarters.

items.statement: Anti-dumping duties on CBS/NS and Pilflex 13 cover ~25-30% of topline (ex-TDQ)
items.quote: So, this would be totally about 25% to 30%.

items.statement: Maintain 2x market growth target with low double-digit pricing actions taken in Q2
items.quote: maintain the range of 2x the market growth. We are in that range. Different parts of our portfolio have grown at different levels. In the quarter, which is the April to June quarter, we have taken pricing action, which are in low double

items.statement: EBITDA margin target range maintained at 21% to 24% guiding pricing decisions
items.quote: We are guided by our pricing actions by 2 things. One is our outlook on raw material prices / cost, and the second is our direction on maintaining our EBITDA margin at 21% to 24%.

items.statement: Two price increases implemented January to June in low double digits to offset commodity inflation
items.quote: In the quarter, which is the April to June quarter, we have taken pricing action, which are in low double digit. And with that, there are 2 price increases that we have implemented this year, January to June.

items.statement: Premium portfolio expansion with fully synthetic variants in Activ, GTX upgrades and new 0W-20
items.quote: We expanded our fully synthetic range. We introduced premium variants in Castrol Activ. It's called Castrol Activ Synthetic 10W-30 and 5W-30 visco metrics. We upgraded GTX 5W-30 to a fully synthetic product positioning, and introduced a full synthetic under GTX 0W-20.

items.statement: Commodity and feedstock inflation impact expected to become more visible in Q3 FY26
items.quote: We, therefore, expect the impact of commodity and feedstock inflation to become more visible in the third quarter.

items.statement: Annual capex around INR100 crores split between manufacturing and market visibility investments
items.quote: We spend about INR100 crores, almost about half amidst both of them.

items.statement: Q2 FY26 EBITDA margin approximately 26%, H1 FY26 at 24% driven by volume growth, pricing, premiumization and cost management
items.quote: This translates to an EBITDA margin of approximately 26% for the quarter and 24% for the first half. The performance was driven by broad-based volume growth, pricing action, portfolio premiumization, and prudent cost management.

items.statement: Interim dividend of INR6.25 per share declared, payable on or before 2nd September 2026
items.quote: The Board this quarter has declared an interim dividend of INR6.25 per share, which will be payable on or before 2nd September 2026.

items.statement: Cautious outlook due to higher inflationary pressures, uneven monsoon, and continued commodity volatility
items.quote: Looking ahead, we remain cautious given higher inflationary pressures, uneven monsoon conditions, and continued volatility in key commodities.

items.statement: Industrial business contributes ~15% of revenue, growing at high double digits for last couple of years
items.quote: Industrial business, as you would remember in the past, we've spoken about it, has contributed about 15% of our overall business. It is growing faster than the rest of the company, and hence that percentage slowly will increase, but it is still in that ballpark range.

items.statement: Broad-based volume growth across consumer, industrial and institutional businesses with consumer driven by rural and premiumization
items.quote: There is a broad-based volume growth across our 3 businesses. In the consumer business, a lot of it coming from our rural operations and premiumization of the portfolio now in urban clusters.

items.statement: Pricing actions modeled for Q2 and H2 based on raw material and forex scenarios; ready to take further action if volatility increases

items.statement: Silvassa plant fully operational after July flooding; business continuity plan maintained peak operating levels
items.quote: We had ceased operation of our plant at that point in time, in the interest of safety. But I'm pleased to say that the plant is fully back up. items.statement: Data center cooling products ready for both immersion and direct-to-chip; trials ongoing but not material yet
items.quote: We have products that apply for both. From a competitor set, there are lubricant companies which operate in this space. There are also other chemical companies that operate with fluids in that space.

items.statement: Targets INR 1,000 crore revenue by FY29-30 through organic growth from existing product basket and new verticals
items.quote: The company looks at growing to INR 1,000 crores by 2029-'30. And that growth is going to be very organic coming from its existing product basket.

items.quote: Target margins are to stabilize and take the EBITDA margins to a sustainable double digit, grow it from a 10% to 11% and going up to 13% and keep it sustainably consistent at those levels.

items.statement: Expects to reach 10% EBITDA margin in FY27 through economies of scale and cost reduction
items.quote: So hopefully, yes, we can go up to -- we are trying to get into 10% this year.

items.quote: This year, I think we're looking at around INR 5 crores to INR 7 crores, because as I mentioned -- or going up to INR 10 crores, because as I mentioned, we've already set up two product vertical lines, and we're also looking at expanding the MIG wire product line.

items.quote: We are looking at around another INR 30 crores to INR 40 crores capex and going up to INR 1,000 crores over the next three to four years.

items.quote: So currently around 27% to 30% would come from the niche product category. And of course, the larger chunk coming from the commodity products.

items.quote: So, when I say that growing at a 20% CAGR vis-a-vis a 6% to 7% CAGR which the industry is witnessing today.

items.quote: The first line is already in process. I think by within by September end or early October, it should start the production.

items.statement: FY27 industry volume could be north of 450,000 units, best case same as last year.
items.quote: If you do the math, we should be north of 450,000. Best case, same as last year.

items.statement: PAT margin target range 7.5%-8.5% for the year.
items.quote: somewhere between 7.5%-8.5% is the margin range that we can at least as an overall band that you can take.

items.statement: Phase-1 and Phase-1(a) capex nearly 40% done, some production started.

items.statement: Capex to improve capacity by 25%-30%.
items.quote: Roughly, I would say that we are looking at anywhere between 25%-30% capacity improvement.

items.statement: Q4 expected to be another peak quarter, barring geopolitical and monsoon headwinds.

items.statement: Qualitative year: reasonable Q2, increasing demand Q3, Q4 peak.
items.quote: Reasonable Q2, increasing demand in Q3, barring the monsoon question that I had, and then Q4 ending at a peak.

items.statement: Commodity price increases are fully passed through to customers.

items.statement: Monsoon and geopolitical tensions are key headwinds being monitored.
items.quote: The headwind is monsoon. We do not know how it is going to play out.

items.quote: As the Chairman explained, the rail plant is on track. The plain bearings, which is going on in our Bharuch factory, that's on track.

items.quote: If you look at it, the gross margin for this quarter, we were at 39.9%. That is 100 basis points expanded year-over-year.

items.quote: Our PBT margin was at 16.2%, broadly in line with 16.1% in Q1 '26.

items.quote: The scheme of amalgamation of Timken GGB Technology Private Limited with Timken India Limited has been approved by the Board earlier and is now with the NCLT.

items.quote: And as we had guided earlier on the last year's call, we are targeting about INR6,000-odd crores at the minimum.

items.quote: Even if you were to exclude those two large IPOs, we've seen a decent growth, and the pipeline is at INR150,000 crores.

items.statement: Bespoke and real estate loan book targeting 13-14% returns
items.quote: And the combination of bespoke and real estate, we target a return of roughly 13% to 14%.

items.statement: July Corporate Advisory revenues already exceed June, signaling recovery

items.statement: Wealth recurring AUM grew to INR33,400 crores, now 30% of total AUM
items.quote: The proportion of recurring to total AUM has now increased to 30%.

items.quote: On our Affordable Housing business, it reported a strong Y-o-Y growth in disbursements of 87% and a 28% Y-o-Y growth in AUM. That business is now on a solid footing. And again, we focus on listing that separately in a span of 2 to 3 years.

items.quote: we've always aspired to grow at about 20%, and we expect that FY 27& FY28 also we expect to grow that way.

items.quote: So obviously, the forward capex will be much higher than the capex that we've deployed so far. Qualitatively, it will be different as well.

items.quote: While we have not experienced any material impact on our operations, supply chain continuity of customer commitments thus far, we remain vigilant and continue to monitor developments closely.
