items.quote: we believe that it was a deferment and we saw things pick up in June. What we lost in May, perhaps we gained back in the month of June.

items.statement: Buyer growth of 5% in Q1 FY27 averaged across April-June; stable gold prices support positive sentiment and buyer growth.
items.quote: buyer growth of 5% when gold prices are stable. Is this buyer growth tracking in line with your expectations? How do you think this plays out, assuming gold stays stable for the rest of the year?

items.statement: Studded jewellery momentum from Q4 FY26 continued in Q1 FY27; color stone jewellery reclassified from studded to gold jewellery category.
items.quote: we began seeing a resurgence of studded in Quarter 4 of last year, and we are seeing that continue to play out in Quarter 1.

items.statement: Coin growth moderating from previous high levels; expected to help mix and margins if gold prices stabilize.
items.quote: the kind of growth Y -o-Y coin was showing, it should start moderating fro m here

items.statement: Damas core business loss-making due to war impact reducing footfall and ticket sizes in Dubai and Saudi Arabia.
items.quote: given the current situation of war, I think purchasing jewellery in Dubai and Saudi and other countries is the last priority for anyone there. So the footfall has fallen down. Ticket sizes have fallen down.

items.statement: International business ex-Damas at 5-6% EBIT margin; overall international portfolio expected positive EBIT for full year.
items.quote: our rest of the portfolio of international business, except Damas is making profit mid-single-digit EBIT margin, 5% - 6%, which they will continue to make. And overall, Damas contribution in international business will not be very high. So I would expect overall portfolio would still turn out to be positive EBIT performance for the full year.

items.statement: TEAL normalized margin gravitating towards 12-16% long-term; CaratLane targeting double-digit EBIT margin around 10%+.
items.quote: the normalized margin would be gradually gravitating towards 12% to 15%, 16%. This year, full year basis, they can be higher. But that's the trend I see if mid- to long term, you see that kind of business, they will deliver. As far as CaratLane is concerned, we have always said they will gradually go towards double-digit EBIT margin, more like Tanishq kind of margin it's there.

items.statement: Committed to double-digit healthy value growth in jewellery business to achieve FY30 goals; started FY27 well.
items.quote: we are committed to a double-digit healthy growth in value in the jewellery business. So that's the only way we'll get to our committed FY 30 goals that we've said.

items.statement: Cash-for-gold program rolled out in June; margin neutral with deductions on exchange; viewed as customer solution not revenue stream.
items.quote: The way that the program works, there is a deduction which is there when you bring gold for exchange, and that takes care of - nullifies this or takes care of this.

items.statement: Slight softness in plain gold jewellery in late July due to gold price volatility and bearish news; studded less affected.
items.quote: towards the end of July, perhaps we did see some softness in -- on the plain gold side, okay? And it does happen sometimes when the price is range bound or the price and people also hear news from various sources that bears have taken hold of gold and gold is likely to go down.

items.statement: Medium-term EBITDA margin target range of 14% to 16%
items.quote: Our primary focus will remain on driving EBITDA growth while progressing towards our medium-term EBITDA margin target range of 14% to 16%.

items.statement: EV capacity to triple from 15,000 to 45,000 per month by end of FY27
items.quote: As we stand today, in the first week of August, it has already increased to close to 30,000 per month. And you should see us go to close to 45,000 per month before the end of thi s financial year

items.statement: New GPC 2.0 parts facility with INR750 crores capex to more than double parts capacity
items.quote: So that pretty much more than doubles our capacity to handle parts business.

items.statement: EV channel inventory at 2-3 days indicating pent-up demand
items.quote: We have pretty much nil channel inventory. It's 2 to 3 days depending on region to region. So whatever we are supplying and shipping is actually retailed immediately.

items.statement: Gross margin contracted 300 bps QoQ due to ~4.5% net commodity inflation; EBITDA margin down 120 bps to 13.3%
items.quote: Because of this, our gross margin for the quarter came down under pressure, contracting 300 basis points quarter -on-quarter, primaril y due to an approximate 4.5% net commodity inflation impact

items.statement: Cumulative 4.5% blended price increase on ICE since Feb; EV price increases in early double digits
items.quote: So we have taken so far about cumulatively from, over the last 3, 4 mo nths, 4.5% of a blended average price increase

items.statement: Industry 2-wheeler retail grew 14% YoY in Q1 (ICE 11%, EV 67%); July retail grew 28% YoY
items.quote: 2-wheeler industry volumes grew 14% year-on-year in terms of VAHAN or retail sales, of which 11% was growth in ICE and 67% was in EV.

items.statement: Mix benefit of 8% from shift to EV, scooters, premium and global business; scooter dispatches nearly doubled
items.quote: This top line expansion was driven by premiumization across our portfolio, driven by a shift in mix towards EV, scooters and premium variants, contributing a mix benefit of 8% with the rest coming from calibrated price increase.

items.statement: Commodity cost inflation from West Asia conflict impacted gross margin; expect marginal uptick in Q2
items.quote: Looking ahead to quarter 2 financial year '27, while we expect a marginal uptick in input cost inflation, we plan to neutralize by c ontinued improvement of product mix, optimizing our discretionary spends and accelerating cost-saving

items.statement: PLI benefit of INR48 crores in Q1 covering 60% of EV portfolio; expect 100% coverage by Dec 2026
items.quote: On the PLI front, I'm pleased to share that around 60% of our EV portfolio is now PLI certified, and we expect 100% of our portfolio to be PLI compliant by December 2026.

items.statement: EV EBITDA loss per unit improved from ~INR50,000 to ~INR40,000 QoQ
items.quote: Just to give some numbers, this quarter, the EBITDA loss has come down from almost INR50,000 from previous quarter to INR40,000.

items.statement: EV motorcycle platforms (Ubex and VXZ) to launch from next year; not in current fiscal
items.quote: It's not this year. We will be looking at products coming in from the next year.

items.statement: Exports grew >60% YoY in Q1; targeting 40%+ YoY growth going forward
items.quote: As you saw, we grew more than 60% in the quarter on exports, and there's still a huge headroom considering still where we are.

items.statement: ICE EBITDA margin contracted 90 bps QoQ to 15.9% cushioned by operating leverage and parts profitability
items.quote: Looking specifically at our ICE portfolio, EBITDA margins held up even better, contracting by 90 basis points sequentially to 15.9%, cushioned by strong operating leverage, cost savings and higher profitability in our parts business.

items.statement: Premium motorcycle launches (refreshes and new models) starting this festive season over next 12 months
items.quote: In the next 12 months, you'll see many more coming up. Market will be fully lined up with these models. You'll see a few starting from this festive itself and going up to next few quarters as well.

items.statement: Target to collect Rs. 380 crores from legacy government receivables in remaining nine months of FY27
items.quote: remainder of nine months minimum, and this I am talking minimum, target is Rs. 380 crores will come from that in total

items.statement: Biochar plant started recently; revenue impact expected from next fiscal year
items.quote: You will start seeing because project has recently started any impact on numbers from the next fiscal

items.statement: Hi-Tech margin fell to 14.4% from 16.6% YoY due to unabsorbed fixed costs; expect recovery in H2
items.quote: Hi-Tech division delivered about a 14.4% margin versus similar period at 16.6, so approximately 2% reduction

items.statement: Plastic division margin improved to 11% from 10% YoY
items.quote: plastic, in fact, improved by about a percent or so from 10 to 11

items.statement: Agro-Processing margin declined by 3% YoY due to seasonality
items.quote: Agro-Processing also came down by 3%

items.statement: July revenue growth positive vs Q1; August-September outlook good; institutional pipe demand strong
items.quote: We have registered already positive revenue growth in July as against April to June, significant revenue growth here

items.statement: One large Pune water supply project remains with triple-digit billing pending; other projects 98-99% complete with Rs. 40-50 crores left
items.quote: total billing left is about approximately closer to Rs. 40-50 crores only

items.statement: Government receivables >180 days total ~Rs. 1,100 crores (Rs. 300 crores project EPC + Rs. 800-900 crores state subsidy orders)
items.quote: about Rs. 1100 crores is about 180 days

items.statement: FY27 order inflow guidance of INR 22,000-25,000 crores, revenue growth 8-10%, EBITDA margin 8.5-9%
items.quote: The order inflow for this financial year is a band INR 22,000 crores to INR25,000 crores. I repeat, INR 22,000 crores to INR 25,000 crores; revenue growth of 8% to 10% and EBITDA margin in the range of 8.5% to 9%.

items.statement: Order book stands at INR 81,214 crores as of June 30, 2026 with book-to-bill of 3.5x
items.quote: As of 30th June ' 26, our order book stands at INR 81,214 crores. During the quarter, we have booked new orders worth INR 3,889 crores, mainly from our Buildings and Water & Railways divisions. This order book provides us a book-to -bill of about 3.5 x, giving healthy multi -year revenue visibility.

items.statement: Capex guidance for FY27 remains INR 500 crores, Q1 FY27 capex was INR 170 crores
items.quote: Yes. Guidance remains the same for the CAPEX, INR 500 crores, whatever we have given.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin at 9.38% vs 8.81% YoY
items.quote: At consolidated level: We achieved EBITDA of INR 545.12 crores, which is 9.38%, and PBT of INR 311.64 crores, which is 5.33%.

items.statement: 81% of contracts have price escalation clauses partially compensating commodity price increases
items.quote: We have almost like 81% of the contracts, we have the price escalation. So, w hatever price increase is coming, it gets partially compensated with the price variation clauses that are existing in our contracts

items.statement: Prospective bid pipeline of INR 2.5 lakh crores as of Q1 FY27
items.quote: In the 1st Quarter, we have shared this number, Mr. Sahu. The prospective pipeline of projects is about INR 2.5 lakh crore as of 1st Quarter.

items.statement: Order book mix: Buildings 28%, Transportation 20%, Electrical T&D 16%, Mining 16%, Water & Railways 14%, Irrigation 6%
items.quote: The broad components of this order book as of the end of the 1st Quarter is the Buildings division stands at INR 22,357 crores, which is about 28% of the total order book. The Transportation division has an order book of INR 16,344 crores, which is about 20% of our order book. The Electrical T&D stands at INR 13,312 crores, which is about 16% of the order book. The Mining division stands at INR 13

items.statement: Ken-Betwa project order value INR 3,390 crores, executed INR 116.35 crores so far, fully mobilized at site
items.quote: As far as the Ken -Betwa is concerned, the total order value is INR 3,390 crore s, and so far we have executed about INR 116.35 crore. And thirdly, the Ken-Betwa project, we have already completely mobilized at the site. All the equipment has been received.

items.statement: Unbilled revenue INR 7,414 crores (38% of revenue) expected to smoothen over next two quarters as BharatNet billing starts
items.quote: But we are expecting that unbilled revenue should get smoothened over the next quarters because the BSNL billing also will start. Where we are executing for BharatNet, the billing also will start. It will get converted from unbilled revenue to revenue. This is what we are expecting. Over the next two quarters, it should smoothen.

items.statement: Order book client mix: Central govt 14%, State govt 19%, PSUs/state entities 60%, ADB/AIIB/banks 5%, Private 4%
items.quote: The central government orders constitute about 14%, and state government orders constitute about 19%. PSUs and state government entities, they were about 60%. And ADB, AIIB, and banks, it is about 5%. And from the private clients, we started taking the orders, which constitute about 4%.

items.statement: Expect all remaining quarters to be similar or better than Q1 FY27 performance
items.quote: We expect all quarters to be similar or better than this.

items.statement: EBITDA margin improved to 8% in Q1 FY27 from 7.4% in Q4 FY26
items.quote: EBITDA margin improved to 8% compared with 7.4% in Q4 FY26 and 6.9% in Q1 FY26.

items.statement: Gross profit margin expanded to 39.8% in Q1 FY27 from 37.4% in Q4 FY26
items.quote: Gross profit margins expanding to 39.8% from 37.4% supported by favorable product realization, better inventory management and efficient raw material utilization.

items.statement: PET food-grade chip project (50,000 MT/yr) to complete trials in Q4 FY27, commercial production in Q1 FY28
items.quote: This project is on ground in reality. So, we have the civil construction on. We have placed orders for all critical machines and project is likely to be completed in fourth quarter of this year for trials and commercial production may happen in quarter one of next financial year.

items.statement: Knitting capacity expansion from 650 to 900 tons/month including 150 tons printing, benefits from Q3 FY27
items.quote: Currently we have capacity of 650 tons. So, after this expansion probably we will be touching around 900 tons per month. So, in 900 tons, 150 tons will be printing, which is not there as of now.

items.statement: Denim garmenting JV approved, Phase 1 up to 5 lakh pieces/month, RSWM majority stake
items.quote: In the first phase, we may go up to 5 lakh pieces per month, which may further be added in two more phases in the coming period. So, this is in line with what we have been discussing in last 4-5 investor call meetings that we see potential in garmenting and downstream expansion from RSWM.

items.statement: Power cost reduction target ₹40 Cr for FY27 at same utilization, renewable share reached ~60% in Q1
items.quote: I think that should give us advantage to the tune of 40 crores for the year. The rest overall number will depend on if we increase more units and add more spindles or add more machines.

items.statement: Polyester fiber prices rose ~30% in March 2026, impacting April-June volumes
items.quote: The prices for polyester fiber went up as high as to the tune of 30%. So, thereby, uncertainty did prevail in terms of buying from customers.

items.statement: Domestic demand healthy and less volatile; export demand softer sequentially but in line with expectations
items.quote: Demand within India remained healthy across several customer segments supported by stable consumption and improved order execution. Export demand, while relatively softer on a sequential basis remained in line with expectations.

items.statement: Graphene fiber development with Birla Cellulose progressing, expect commercial traction within FY27
items.quote: I expect within this financial year we should get it rolling.

items.statement: Geopolitical issues (West Asia conflict), crude volatility, and US tariff developments creating supply chain and cost uncertainties
items.quote: Geopolitical developments including the West Asia conflict contributed to supply chain disruptions and volatilities in energy costs as well. Elevated crude oil prices have influenced input costs for synthetic yarn particularly.

items.statement: Strong demand continues across domestic power generation, data centers, railways, and mining; construction flat; exports challenged by geopolitics
items.quote: For the domestic market, we see from an end market perspective, power generation growth to be pretty strong. We have seen that in this quarter. I am basing my optimism based on the orders we are generating today.

items.statement: One price hike taken at start of Q2; commodity inflation (steel, pig iron, aluminum, copper) and freight costs unprecedented; price realization lags by a quarter; not all cost increases recovered
items.quote: We have taken one, and we will continue seeing how the market adjusts to this price increase and then see how best to manage the cost inflation and the price increases going forward.

items.statement: Gross margin improvement targeted but historic highs uncertain due to unprecedented commodity inflation and supply chain issues; focus on cost control and value engineering
items.quote: Will we be able to improve our margins? Yes. I will not be able to say whether we will hit historic highs or not, because these are unprecedented times in terms of commodity increases and inflation coming at the same time.

items.statement: Data centers contributed 40% of domestic power generation revenue in Q1 FY27 vs 23% in Q1 FY26; HHP exports strong; LHP exports weak due to Middle East crisis
items.quote: And data centers out of this, in this particular quarter, was 40% of overall power generation revenue.

items.statement: Utilization at 70-75%; capital investment in line with recent years in existing plants; no new capacity yet for QSK78/QSK95 as India volume still largely QSK60
items.quote: Our utilization level is between 70% to 75%. So it has been consistently going up. And the capital investment is in line with what we have been doing in the last few years in our existing plants.

items.statement: Strong order velocity in domestic power generation across manufacturing, data centers, residential, commercial realty; mining tenders improving; railways strong; order books build 2-3 months ahead
items.quote: Across be it manufacturing, data centers, residential, commercial realty, all those, we see decent order velocity in the power generation space in domestic market.

items.statement: Data center inquiry momentum continues strongly; customers prioritize lead times and site readiness over price; pipeline extends to next year and year after
items.quote: The data center inquiries as they had picked up in the last few quarters, the momentum continues, very strong momentum on the data center side. And our execution has also been strong.

items.statement: Related party transaction approvals for exports to UK subsidiary are for current fiscal year only, taken as prudent governance practice; not indicative of specific order book
items.quote: This is purely in anticipation, Jonas, just as a prudent governance practice and order books don't get built this early in the year, they get built 2 to 3 months in advance only.

items.statement: Distribution business (DBU) has potential for 20% growth this year and next; Q1 growth of 14% due to higher base and supply disruptions; reach includes 3,500 engineers and 450 touchpoints with 2/4 hour service guarantee
items.quote: DBU business absolutely has the potential to grow at 20% growth over this year and the next few years as well.

items.statement: Rail segment growing on power cars and diesel-electric tower cars; hotel load converter acceptance good; working on other Indian Railways products
items.quote: Rail has been growing good order board and good execution from our end. So largely, the applications where we have been getting orders are power cars and diesel electric tower cars.

items.statement: BESS demonstrator installed at Phaltan rebuild center; very close to getting orders but nothing to announce yet
items.quote: We have already installed the BESS at one of our own plants, our own rebuild center in Phaltan. We have installed this BESS as a demonstrator and we are getting our customers to see and experience that.

items.statement: No specific numeric guidance given; management expects strong demand to sustain but inflation and supply chain constraints to continue; focus on operational efficiency and cost management
items.quote: As we look ahead, we believe that strong demand in various end markets will sustain. At this time, inflationary pressures and supply chain constraints are like ly to continue and are sha ping our operating environment

items.statement: Management does not provide earnings guidance or market forecasts
items.quote: We are not forecasting the market. We don't give earnings guidance either.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 consolidated profit INR 1,309 crores, standalone profit INR 1,157 crores, most profitable quarter ever
items.quote: We've had our most profitable quarter ever by a significant margin. The consolidated profit is INR 1,309 crores, while the stand-alone profit is INR 1,157 crores.

items.statement: Order book: crude tankers 27%, VLGCs 35%, product tankers 20-21%, bulk carriers 14%
items.quote: The order book now for crude tankers is at 27%. The order book for VLGCs is currently at 35%, which is a huge number for product tankers continues to be at about 20%, 21%, while bulk carriers are at about 14%.

items.statement: Strait of Hormuz disruption caused all-time high freight rates, ton-mile demand surged as Asian countries sourced oil from US/Brazil instead of Middle East
items.quote: We saw freight rates going to all-time highs during the last quarter because of all the disruption which was caused in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.statement: Fleet strategy is to replace not expand; invested INR 1,200 crores last year, INR 300 crores in Q1 FY27, INR 250-300 crores in July for modernization transactions
items.quote: last year, we invested about INR 1,200 crores in changing the fleet mix. So, we have invested INR 1,200 crores. This year, in the first quarter, we invested INR 300 crores in doing those transactions. Last month, already, we have invested between INR 250 crores and INR 300 crores

items.statement: Order book increased dramatically over last 12-18 months especially for crude tankers, increasing oversupply risk as cycle progresses
items.quote: You may have seen the order book data and the order book has increased very, very dramatically over the last 12 to 18 months, especially for crude tankers.

items.statement: Buyback treated as capital allocation decision, no target price/multiple policy, board will evaluate vs other options including ship purchases
items.quote: The way we look at buyback is as another capital allocation. And we will treat it exactly the same way. So this will be discussed. We don't have a policy as such, which is on a target or a target price or a target multiple.

items.statement: Cash position: $700 million in Great Eastern Shipping, ~$600 million net of debt; last debt maturity Nov 2028
items.quote: We have $700 million in cash in Great Eastern Shipping. about $600 million net of the debt.

items.statement: VLGC repricing: one done at 25-30% higher rate, one with base rate plus profit sharing, third comes off charter early 2027 Q1
items.quote: The second is a time charter, which is coming off now and where we've already got the repricing done, which is at about 25% to 30% higher than the previous charter rate. Repricings have got done. There's one third VLGC, which we have, which comes off charter early 2027, first quarter

items.statement: Rig utilization stable globally; Saudi Aramco suspended rigs slowly returning to work; one rig idle since April, bidding for short-term work post-monsoon
items.quote: The utilization of jack-up rigs is a global number, remains where it was 3 to 6 months ago. The headline news is that rigs which were temporarily suspended during these hostilities by Saudi Aramco are slowly coming back on contract and going back to work.

items.statement: Fuel savings on newer eco-ships up to 20-25% vs pre-2013 vessels, translating to $1,000-$2,500/day earnings improvement
items.quote: If you compare the ship built in the 2020s compared to what was built prior to 2013, fuel savings could be up to maybe 20%, 25%. And then depending on the size of the ship, it can translate from $1,000 to maybe even $2,000, $2,500 per day on the earnings.

items.statement: No ships transiting Strait of Hormuz after fleet exited; one vessel remains on time charter to ADNOC operating within the Strait
items.quote: We have one ship in the Strait currently, but she's on time charter to ADNOC. So she continues to do business there. G. Shivakumar: She doesn't have to come through the Strait of Hormuz. She's employed on a trade, which is within the Strait

items.statement: Newbuilding deliveries expected broadly on time, no reason to believe 6-12 month delays
items.quote: I think broadly, they should be delivered on time. G. Shivakumar: There's no reason to believe that they will be delayed

items.statement: Panama Canal transit restrictions due to water levels may benefit LPG and dry bulk; Suez Canal unaffected
items.quote: In the Panama Canal, while it's not been a large impact, we have seen certain water levels starting to drop off. G. Shivakumar: And the number of transits actually being restricted because of that in the Panama Canal. The Suez Canal has not had this problem, never had this problem

items.statement: Reaffirmed FY27 revenue guidance of over INR2,500 crores with EBITDA margin range of 25% plus/minus 2%
items.quote: Accordingly, we reaffirm our guidance of achieving over INR2,500 crores in revenue for FY27 while maintaining EBITDA margin in the range of 25% plus/minus 2%.

items.statement: Medium-term target of 15% to 20% revenue CAGR supported by capacity expansion and value-added products
items.quote: Over the medium term, we continue to target 15% to 20% revenue CAGR, supported by capacity expansion, increasing contribution from value-added products and backward integration through the TPU project.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded 544 bps to record 30.3%, crossing 30% milestone for first time
items.quote: EBITDA increased 56% year-on-year to INR192 crores with EBITDA margin expanding by 544 basis points to a record of 30.30%, crossing the 30% milestone for the first time in company's history and significantly exceeding the upper end of our long-term guidance range.

items.statement: TPU backward integration expected to add 1.5% to 2% margin expansion in FY28
items.quote: Yes. So we have given a guidance of 1.5% to 2% after this line comes into stream, of course, for FY28. So the guidance is already given to that.

items.statement: Architectural films revenue share increased from 5% to over 25% in recent years
items.quote: At the same time, the strategic focus of the company is towards architectural business. If you really see like from 5% revenue percentage of architectural today stands more than 25%.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 product mix: Sun Control 55%, PPF 20%, Industrial Products balance
items.quote: And this quarter, Sun Control was around 55% and PPF was 20% and balance was industrial product.

items.statement: Healthy demand across Sun Control and Paint Protection Films supported by improving export markets and India momentum
items.quote: On the business front, demand remained healthy across our key specialty segments, particularly Sun Control Films and Paint Protection Films, supported by improving demand across our key export markets and continued momentum in India.

items.statement: Garware Application Studios network expanded to over 250 locations in India; Garware Home Solutions at 9 studios, targeting 50 by end of FY27
items.quote: In India, our Garware Application Studios network has now expanded to over 250 locations, while Garware Home Solutions continues to scale steadily with 9 studios currently operational. We remain firmly on track to expand this network to 50 studios by end of FY27.

items.statement: Company remains debt-free with INR850 crores cash and liquid investments after investing over INR700 crores in strategic expansions
items.value: INR850 crores cash and liquid investments
items.quote: Our balance sheet continues to remain one of our greatest strength despite investing over INR700 crores towards strategic expansions over the past few years, the company remains debt-free with a healthy cash and liquid investment balance of INR850 crores.

items.statement: DGTR recommended antidumping duty on TPU-based PPF imports from China, creating level playing field for domestic manufacturers
items.quote: Another important development during the quarter has been DGTR's recommendation for antidumping duty on TPU-based paint protection film imports from China. We believe this represents an important step towards creating a more level playing field for domestic manufacturers.

items.statement: Expect raw material inflation of about 8% sequentially into Q2
items.quote: Based on the current outlook, we expect raw material inflation of about 8% sequentially into Q2.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin 11.7%, down 150 bps YoY due to RM cost pressures
items.quote: The consolidated revenue for the quarter stood at INR 74 billion with an EBITDA margin of 11.7%, down about 150 basis points year-on-year, primarily on account of RM cost pressures.

items.statement: India Operations EBITDA margin 12% vs 13.6% YoY
items.quote: The EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR 6.5 billion, a margin of 12% compared to 13.6% in the corresponding period last year.

items.statement: Europe Operations EBITDA margin 8.9% vs 10.8% YoY
items.quote: The EBITDA for the quarter stood at EUR13 million, a margin of 8.9%, lower than the previous year 10.8%.

items.statement: Europe margin would be ~11% without Enschede transition overlap costs
items.quote: if those overlaps were not there, we would have been at about 11% odd margin levels, okay?

items.statement: Target high-teens EBITDA margin for Europe Operations on full-year basis post restructuring
items.quote: on a full year basis in E urope, with this change, we would look to deliver high teens EBITDA

items.statement: India RM costs up ~17% in Q1; price hikes of 7-9% implemented staggered; further hikes announced for Q2
items.quote: Raw material costs escalated sharply during Q1 by the magnitude of nearly 17%. Despite this, we largely successfully defended margins through a combination of calibrated price increases and disciplined cost control.

items.statement: India needs 15-16% total price increase to cover RM inflation; currently at 11%+; 1-2 more hikes needed
items.quote: overall, what we need is about a 15% to 16% price increase, whereas we are currently at the 11%- plus zone. So at least one to two more price increa ses are needed

items.statement: Europe RM basket up 8% in Q1; total 10% price increase needed for Q1-Q2; only 3-4% implemented so far
items.quote: Europe, the impact immediately was smaller because the first hike up was on account of natural rubber. So in this quarter, Europe raw material basket went up by 8%, but they are getting the hit in the second quarter. Europe, the price increases total for Q1, Q2 needed is about 10-odd percent. As of now, only 3% - 4% has been implemented.

items.statement: India demand healthy across categories; July strong start; momentum to carry into Q2
items.quote: Looking ahead, demand remains healthy across categories and channels. July already delivered a strong start, providing confidence that the momentum will carry into Q2.

items.statement: India replacement volume growth 13%, OEM 10%, exports 15% in Q1; all double-digit
items.quote: Replacement was 13% OEM was 10% and exports was 15%. So fairly in a narrow range, but all in double digits.

items.statement: Consolidated Q1 capex INR 650 cr; India Q1 capex INR 500 cr; capex to increase in Q2-Q3; net debt/EBITDA to rise slightly
items.quote: So the full CapEx for Q1 was INR 650 crores at a consol level. The net debt to EBITDA at the consol level was 0.4.

items.statement: Net debt-to-EBITDA ratio to go up slightly in current year; will be a net borrower
items.quote: we anticipate that our net debt -to-EBITDA ratio will go up slightly in the current year. We will be a net borrower.

items.statement: Europe UHP mix remains in similar levels of 40s
items.quote: I think it's remained in the similar levels of 40s.

items.statement: Geopolitical situation in West Asia creating headwinds in select international markets, cost volatility across RM, energy, logistics
items.quote: The geopolitical situation in West Asia continued to create headwinds in select international markets, leading to heightened uncertainty and cost volatility across raw materials, energy and logistics costs.

items.statement: Enschede plant stopped production June 2026; financial/operational benefits from restructuring to materialize from H2 FY27
items.quote: The Netherlands plant stopped production as planned in June 2026, and we expect the financial and ope rational benefits of the restructuring to start materialising from H2 of the current fiscal

items.statement: Spent INR 1,200 crore on the INR 11,500 crore polycarbonate project; will spend another INR 1,000-1,500 crore this year, taking total spend to ~INR 3,200 crore.
items.quote: Pending now, we have spent around INR 1,200 crore. I mentioned yesterday also. Further this year, we'll spend around another INR 1,000 crore to INR 1,500 crore this year further. So total spend will be around in the range of INR 3,200 crore.

items.statement: Entire debt of INR 6,800 crore for the polycarbonate project tied up at competitive rates; 25% equity already infused; peak debt seen at INR 8,000-8,500 crore including working capital.
items.quote: We have already tied up with the banks for debt funding. We were required to put in around 25% of the equity, which we have already done. So the next tranche comes from the bank.

items.statement: MIBK and MIBC pre-commissioning runs met stringent consumption norms; MIBC exceeded designed capacity; both to be commissioned with acetophenone in August, rest in Q2.
items.quote: MIBK as well as MIBC will be commissioned along with acetophenone in August itself, and the rest of them will be commissioned within Q2.

items.statement: Polycarbonate project targeting H2 FY28-29 commissioning; BPA plant a couple of months later; phenol debottlenecking to 4 lakh tonnes with INR 70-100 crore investment.
items.quote: I would anticipate that we would target H2 for our polycarbonate commissioning. And we would target BPA, which would be commissioned maybe a couple of months after that.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded to 21% from 11% YoY and 18% QoQ; Phenolics EBIT margin 24%, AI EBIT margin 8%.
items.quote: EBITDA margin expanded to 21% compared to 18% in previous quarter and 11% in Q1 FY26.

items.statement: Domestic phenol demand strong; government reimposed import duty on phenol; India short on phenol supply; AI demand improving across domestic and select export markets.
items.quote: In fact, whatever you are saying there's a lot of demand in India, supplies are actually limited. So we have a great opportunity today. So to answer your question, there is no worry as such.

items.statement: Raw material volatility in Q1; propylene sourcing challenges in April; freight and insurance cost escalation impacting exports; managed via agile logistics and customer engagement.
items.quote: There is disruption , there is an escalation in freight rates, insurance rates, et c. The way that we've approached this problem is with a degree of agility.

items.statement: Capex plan: ~INR 3,000 crore spent till now (last year + this year); another ~INR 3,000 crore in FY27-28; total project cost INR 11,500 crore at 60:40 debt-equity.
items.quote: around INR 3,000 crore investment we would have done till now on the projects, last year and this year combined up till now. Plus further, whatever we are going to spend i n 2027, 2028 will be another INR 3,000 crore

items.statement: Ammonia-to-amines integration chain completed; no longer buy nitric acid; backward integration improves structural cost competitiveness and enables new downstream chemistries.
items.quote: We're no longer a nitration company that buys nitric acid. We're now a nitrogen company that nitrates. This commissioning, along with the expansion of our nitration and reduction capacity has materially strengthened our footprint.

items.statement: Confident in sustainable growth from improving demand, commissioned capacities, downstream expansion, customer qualifications; no quantitative guidance given.
items.quote: We remain very confident in our ability to deliver growth profitably while continuing to invest in the future.

items.statement: AI margin profile of new products in line or better than segment average; integrated asset fungibility improves site-level profitability; commercial volumes from January.
items.quote: The margin profile is either in line or better than the average margin profile that Advanced Intermediates has. And many of them have the advantage of integrated asset fungibility.

items.statement: No new global phenol capacity coming; China self-sufficient; India demand-supply balanced to short; Deepak focused on domestic market with diversified end-use applications.
items.quote: No new capacities are coming up. New capacities have come up in the last couple of years in China, but that is now all done and China is largely self-sufficient. So no new capacity.

items.statement: Flow chemistry platform reduces reaction time from 16-18 hours to 45-52 seconds; enables multi-product campaigns, smaller footprint, lower hazardous inventory; commercial impact from next financial year.
items.quote: One product that we're making currently in a batch or in a semi batch, it takes us about 16 to 18 hours from feedstock to finished product. This gets completed in roughly between 45 to 52 seconds.

items.statement: Debt-to-equity comfortable at 0.27x; net worth INR 6,214 crore; peak debt-to-equity post polycarbonate project will not cross 1x.
items.quote: But debt-to-equity ratio will be very, very comfortable. It will not cross even 1. So that's what I can say as of now.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth target >30% YoY, EBITDA margin ~6%, PAT margin 3.5-4%
items.quote: Based on the current demand environment and our execution roadmap, we remain confident of delivering more than 30% revenue in the current financial year '27 along with the EBITDA margin of around 6% and a profit after tax in the range of 3.5 % to 4%.

items.statement: Rights issue proceeds: INR100cr working capital, INR50cr Nakoda CP plant, INR23cr debt repayment, INR22cr solar plant
items.quote: The board has approved the allotment of 16.84 crores equity shares at an issue price of INR11.86 per share, raising INR199.75 crores with net proceeds of approximately INR194.90 crores available for deployment towards our strategic growth initiatives.

items.statement: Q1 EBITDA margin 3.24% impacted by raw material volatility; expect gross margins >25% and EBITDA 6% for FY27
items.quote: We are very confident that we will be able to achieve our gross margins over 25% and maintain the same so that we can achieve our EBITDA levels.

items.statement: Geopolitical tensions caused crude/PTA/MEG volatility and freight cost spikes; raw material prices not yet at pre-war levels
items.quote: Due to the geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and US, there was a sharp increase in the crude oil prices, which resulted in significant volatility in our raw material, such as PTA and MEG, along with elevated freight and logistics costs.

items.statement: No tax losses or unabsorbed depreciation available; all settled during NCLT process
items.quote: No, no, it was everything was used up and we had cleared the balance sheet. When the liabilities were written off, in that everything was settled.

items.statement: Expect margin pressure in short term due to elevated costs from war; will pass on some but not all cost increases
items.quote: So, in the short term, margins are likely to be impacted.

items.statement: Taken 7-10% price hikes in non-household segments; household cooler segment hikes pending; further hikes depend on war duration and cost normalization
items.quote: In the other segment, we have taken 7% to 10% of a price hike. And in others, we will be taking hikes in the days to come.

items.statement: Mexico expects significant growth in summer FY27 after two consecutive mild summers; USA growth continues if summer remains robust; China momentum to continue on export orders
items.quote: So, we hope and we expect that the summer of '27, statistically, it will be almost impossible for it to be a mild summer. It should be certainly a fairly robust summer, and the sales should grow significantly.

items.statement: Middle East exports still affected by geopolitical issues; other regions face high shipping costs impacting buyer sentiment and demand
items.quote: So, the Middle East, which was primarily impacted, continues to remain affected.

items.statement: BISP (Beyond India Summer Products) contributed ₹560 crore (48% of consolidated TTM revenue) and ₹179 crore (23% of standalone TTM revenue)
items.quote: BISP segment i.e. Beyond India Summer Products i.e. the sales, product wise or segment wise, not dependent upon Indian summer, constituted about ₹560 crore on a consol basis in trailing 12 months i.e. almost 48% reinforcing our strategic derisking and diversification from Indian summer.

items.statement: Consolidated gross margin improved to 49.8% and EBITDA margin to 12.6% in Q1 FY27 despite commodity pressure and inventory overhang
items.quote: we have marginally increased the gross margin percentage to 49.8% , while EBITDA margin percentage to 12.6%.

items.statement: Geopolitical war and shipping disruptions causing elevated costs and export headwinds; Middle East exports remain affected
items.quote: it all depends on how long the war lasts and when the costs begin to normalize.

items.statement: Interim dividend of ₹1 per share (face value ₹2) announced, total payout ~₹7 crore
items.quote: For June '26 quarter, the Board of Directors had announced interim dividend of ₹1 per share on a face value of ₹2 with a total payout of about ₹7 crore.

items.statement: Standalone ROCE at 164% and consolidated ROCE at 67% after capital rationalization from CTPL impairment; treasury at ₹345 crore after repaying ₹225 crore Australia loans
items.quote: core capital employed on standalone is ₹73 crore versus ₹136 crore, translating into ROCE percentage of 164, while return on net worth at 22% and treasury stands at ₹345 crore versus ₹363 crore.

items.statement: Q1 domestic sales grew 15% despite inventory overhang; no inventory overhang at trade or company level as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: domestic sales i.e. India revenue grew by 15%, despite huge inventory overhang before the summer and importantly all different segments of modern trade grew in excess of 100%.

items.statement: Australia strategy: no new capital deployment, no new product introductions, just optimizing existing operations
items.quote: First and foremost, our strategy is not to deploy any additional capital and whatever best can be done without deploying any additional capital in our Australian business.

items.statement: Reaffirmed FY27 PAT guidance of INR200-220 crores, representing 34-48% growth over FY26
items.quote: we remain confident of delivering our FY '27 profit after tax guidance of INR200 crores to INR220 crores, representing the healthy growth of 34% to 48% over FY '26.

items.statement: Board authorized additional INR190 crores for new expansion projects, bringing total FY27 capex to INR340 crores plus INR150 crores carryforward from FY26
items.quote: The Board has authorized additional investments towards new expansion projects of INR190 crores, bringing the total for FY '27 to INR340 crores. This is in addition to the INR150 crores worth of projects carried forward from FY '26.

items.statement: Expect to commercialize manufacturing capacities exceeding INR500 crores during FY27 including projects under implementation
items.quote: Including these investments and the projects already under implementation, we expect to commercialize manufacturing capacities exceeding INR500 crores during FY '27.

items.statement: Signed projects totaling around INR340 crores in FY27 so far
items.quote: Reflecting the continued confidence of our customers and the robust demand outlook across our bu sinesses, we have already signed on various projects totaling to around INR340 crores in this financial year

items.statement: Footwear order book and capacities full from Q2 FY27 onwards for rest of financial year
items.quote: Our order book and capacities starting from Q2 FY '27 onwards are full for the rest of the financial year.

items.statement: Footwear business faced INR6 crores impact in Q1 FY27 from higher raw material costs and revised wage rates
items.quote: The quarter numbers were impacted due to cost pressure faced in our footwear business arising from higher raw material costs and revised wage rates, which totaling to around INR6 crores impact for Q1 FY '27.

items.statement: Footwear contracts have fixed pricing 6-12 months in advance with no pass-through mechanism unlike other businesses
items.quote: In case of shoes, the arrangement is slightly different. And that's the reason why we've been saddled with not being able to pass on those costs.

items.statement: Successfully passing on increased material and wage costs in footwear starting from current quarter
items.quote: However, we've been successful. Our customers are understanding this. And starting from this quarter, we have been able to successfully pass on the effect of both the increase in material as well as the wage increases.

items.statement: Home and Personal Care business at maximum capacity with consistent demand across all categories and sites
items.quote: Our Home and Personal Care business remains at maximum capacity, supported by consistent demand and efficient manufacturing operations.

items.statement: Beverages validated as major growth avenue with excellent season performance
items.quote: The Beverage division had an excellent season and validates our belief that beverages will be one of the major avenues of growth for this division.

items.statement: Added Greek yogurt facility in Goa marking entry into high-growth category
items.quote: We are also expanding our manufacturing platform with addition of a Greek yogurt facility in Goa, marking our entry into another high-growth category.

items.statement: Initiated Class III medical devices certification at Chennai facility for regulated international markets
items.quote: We also initiated the certification process for Class III medical devices at our Chennai facility, which will support our expansion into regulated international markets over time.

items.statement: Silvassa facility partially restored after record rainfall, expected fully operational by end of August with no material impact
items.quote: Production has already been partially restored, and we expect the facility to be fully operational by the end of August. The facility is adequately insured, and we do not expect this incident to have any material impact on our long-term operations or growth plans.

items.statement: Footwear raw material prices increased 50-60% and freight rates up 4x due to Middle East crisis
items.quote: Right now, we have seen an increase of almost 50% to 60% in raw material prices -- polymer prices, fabric prices have increased. Even the freight rates have gone up by 4x.

items.statement: Project pipeline of nearly INR1,000 crores under discussion with customers across business units
items.quote: I kind of gave some indication this time around, which, of course, my team was not very happy about. But the pipeline is about INR1,000-odd crores.

items.statement: Full year revenue target to cross INR15,000 crores with high-teens EBITDA growth and aspiration for 20% EBITDA growth
items.quote: We are confident of achieving high -teens EBITDA growth and aspire to touch 20% EBITDA growth during this year.

items.statement: India volume growth expected at high single-digit; international business at mid-teens constant currency growth
items.quote: We expect India to deliver high single-digit volume growth and international business to deliver mid -teens constant currency growth.

items.statement: Parachute volume growth guidance maintained at mid-single digit for the year despite Q1 aberration of 10%
items.quote: We would want to maintain the guidance of mid-single digit for the Parachute.

items.statement: Tax rate guidance of about 18% for FY27 and 19% to 20% for FY28 at consolidated level
items.quote: I think from a full year perspective, you can take a guidance of about 18% for FY27 and maybe about 19% to 20% for FY28.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expected to expand 140-150 basis points for full year FY27 versus last year
items.quote: EBITDA margin would expand in the range of about 140 to 150 basis points as compared to last year.

items.statement: No specific capex guidance mentioned; focus on profitable growth and digital platform scaling
items.quote: We are building larger growth engines by strengthening core categories through sustained investments and wider portfolio participation across consumer cohorts, formats and channels.

items.statement: Gross margin expanded 30 bps YoY in Q1 FY27; aim to hold gross margin percentage for full year despite mixed input cost trends
items.quote: gross margin expanded 30 basis points year -on-year

items.statement: EBITDA margin improved 40 bps YoY to 20.7% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: EBITDA margin improved 40 basis points year-on-year to 20.7%.

items.statement: Copra prices expected range bound at 30-35% below last year peak; crude and vegetable oils showing upward bias with higher input costs expected in Q2
items.quote: we believe that it will stay range bound with maybe a slight upward bias at this 30% - 35% kind of a level below the peak

items.statement: Domestic demand remained healthy with India delivering 11% volume growth in Q1 FY27
items.quote: The India business delivered one of the strongest quarters in recent years with 11% volume growth

items.statement: International business delivered 15% constant currency growth led by Vietnam (27%) and MENA (24%)
items.quote: International business reported 15% constant currency growth, led by outperformance in Vietnam and MENA.

items.statement: Foods portfolio crossed INR1,300 crores ARR growing 43%; Premium Personal Care at INR450 crores ARR; Digital-first brands at INR1,100 crores ARR
items.quote: Foods continued its strong growth trajectory, reporting a 43% growth and crossing annualized revenue run rate of INR1,300 crores.

items.statement: Almond oil franchise target INR100 crores+ ARR by FY28; Parachute shampoo target INR100 crores revenue in first year
items.quote: Our aim is to build it to INR100 crores plus ARR franchise by FY28.

items.statement: International geographies may experience macro headwinds due to inflationary pressures; monitoring monsoon progress and inflationary conditions
items.quote: Some of the international geographies, however, could exp erience macro headwinds due to the inflationary pressures.

items.statement: Reiterated FY27 guidance of 9-11% revenue growth with EBITDA margin expansion of 50-100 bps over FY26
items.value: 9-11% revenue growth; 50-100 bps EBITDA margin expansion
items.quote: On the outlook front, we reiterate our FY '27 guidance of 9% to 11% revenue growth with EBITDA margin expansion of 50 to 100 basis points over FY '26.

items.statement: Mid-to-long-term target of 12-15% growth and INR 5,000-5,500 crore revenue by FY30
items.quote: Looking further ahead, we remain confident in our journey towards achieving 12% to 15% growth in mid - to long-term as we continue to scale our digital platforms across geographies, brands and channels.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded to 11% from 9.2% in Q1 FY26; gross margin at 67%
items.quote: EBITDA came in at INR102 crores, up 37% year-on-year with EBITDA margin at 11%, a strong improvement from 9.2% in Q1 FY '26.

items.statement: Macro volatility (wars, oil prices) cited as reason for conservative FY30 guidance; US discretionary spending weak due to fuel/grocery inflation
items.quote: The macroeconomic environment is very volatile. It keeps on changing with how the world is moving towards different war, oil prices up and down. So considering all in our mind, we have kept our number like that.

items.statement: Music vertical revenue growth guidance maintained at 20% to 23% year-on-year for FY27
items.quote: If I have to look at on a full year basis, we maintain our guidance of the music vertical growing between 20% to 23% year-on-year.

items.statement: Annual music EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 60% to 65%
items.quote: For the music vertical, we maintain our medium-term guidance of 20% to 23% revenue growth and an annual music EBITDA margin guidance of 60% to 65%.

items.statement: New music content spend expected between Rs. 300 crores to Rs. 350 crores for FY27, mostly committed
items.quote: Our spend on new music content this year is expected to be anything between Rs. 300 crores to Rs. 350 crores. Most of that is already committed.

items.statement: Major upcoming albums include Love and War (January), Rajinikanth's Dharman, Paradise, Naagzilla, and Bhansali Productions film with Tiger Shroff
items.quote: Big albums lined up including Love and War, which is coming out in January, Rajinikanth's Dharman, which is a Kamal Haasan's Company's production; Telegu Cinema's most awaited film Paradise; Dharma's film with Kartik Aaryan called Naagzilla and another Bhansali Productions film with Tiger Shroff are some of the albums which are expected to release in this financial year.

items.statement: Music EBITDA margin impact from mix change as Artiste Management grows faster but at lower margins; core licensing margins stable
items.quote: If you see the segmental results that people have declared, you will see Artiste Management piece is also growing. And Artiste Management is always a lower margin. It takes zero investments. Artiste Management part of the revenue is always a lower margin part.

items.statement: Paid streaming penetration in India at 3% vs 67% in Sweden; believes 100 million subscribers at Rs. 100/month achievable if free content stops
items.quote: We believe in Indian market, if the subscription is priced correctly, which means closer to Rs. 100 and if the supply of free content somewhere are curtailed, we should not have a problem touching 100 million paid subscription mark pretty soon.

items.statement: 64% of free music users ready to shift to paid service if free content stops per E&Y-IMI study; subscription growth bullish
items.quote: A recent Indian consumer study done by E&Y and the apex music body called IMI s tates that 64% of free music customers in India are ready to shift to a reasonably priced paid service if the free content stops

items.statement: 60% of FY26 music revenue from post-2000 releases, 45% from post-2020; catalog growing 5,000-6,000 new releases annually
items.quote: In FY'26, 60% of all music revenue at Saregama came from music released post 2000. I'm repeating. 60% of the revenue in last financial year came from music of the 21st century.

items.statement: Video/films business being wound down by design; revenue declined 52% to Rs. 17 crores; will clear pipeline over 3-4 quarters
items.quote: This quarter saw the video vertical revenue declining by 52% to around Rs. 17 crores. Ladies and gentlemen, please keep in mind this is by design and not by chance.

items.statement: AI initiatives: two dedicated teams for content creation (podcasts, music videos) and process optimization; impact expected by year-end
items.quote: We have created 2 AI-dedicated teams in Saregama to optimize both cost and speed of delivery. The first is a content team that's using third-party GenAI tools to create neighboring audio content like podcast using Saregama's songs and also building new age music videos around our older songs.

items.statement: Live Events expanding: 23 Carvaan Live shows, 22 devotional shows, 48 standard packs in Q1; US tours with Ilaiyaraaja and Arjan Dhillon planned
items.quote: 23 such shows were produced in quarter 1. We further built up our devotional format with 22 shows featuring Manoj Muntashir, Backstage Siblings and Jaya Kishori during the quarter. We also staged 48 standard packs during this quarter.

items.statement: Pocket Aces reached breakeven in FY26, moving towards profitability in FY27; controls 400-450M Gen Z follower footprint
items.quote: Pocket Aces reached breakeven in financial year '26 and is now moving towards profitability. This year, we should be seeing further building on the profitability of Pocket Aces.

items.statement: Artiste Management represents 309 artists with 440M+ combined followers; revenue run rate ~Rs. 40 crores/quarter; margins at 10% with improvement scope
items.quote: At the end of this quarter, we represent 309 artists with more than 440 million follower and subscriber base for these artists on Instagram and YouTube combined.

items.statement: Brand partnerships vertical growing with HUL, Godrej, Lux; unified team managing cross-vertical brand sales
items.quote: This quarter, we partnered with leading brands such as Hindustan Uni lever, Godrej, Lux, etc. Regarding our p artner companies, Pocket Aces reached breakeven in financial year '26 and is now moving towards profitability

items.statement: Other income declined due to cash diverted to Bhansali Productions investment
items.quote: The fact of life is that the cash that the people had right now has been diverted towards specific investments of us, namely Bhansali Productions. And that's why you see a reduction in the other income.

items.statement: Music vertical growth guidance 20-23% CAGR maintained despite Q1 39% growth; evaluates performance on rolling 12-month basis
items.quote: We hold on to our sho rt- to medium-term guidance that the Music vertical comprising Licensing, Artiste Management and Retail is going to grow between 20% to 23% year-on-year

items.statement: Remain firmly on track to deliver full-year FY27 guidance with confidence to exceed in select areas
items.quote: We remain firmly on track to deliver our guidance for the full year with the confidence to exceed the same in select areas.

items.statement: Expect to exceed revenue growth guidance significantly; EBITDA and volume growth may exceed slightly; cash may be squeezed
items.quote: We'll certainly exceed it on revenue growth pretty significantly. On EBITDA, we may exceed by a little bit the original number that we had set of double-digit EBITDA growth may go up a little bit.

items.statement: India EBITDA margin target 22-26% even in weak quarter; expect to return to normative margins by H2 FY27
items.quote: But look, our target is to be in this 22% to 26% kind of margin for India even in a weak quarter. So that kind of target remains unless you have an exceptional quarter like West Asia or some exceptional palmer.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin 19% in Q1 FY27; India gross margin fell sharply due to 3x cost inflation in LPG, kerosene, LABSA
items.quote: At a consolidated level, revenues grew 19% year-on-year with underlying volume growth of 9%. EBITDA grew 14% with margins at 19%.

items.statement: Took ~5% weighted average price increase in India in Q1; may take similar increase in Q2; priced for Brent at $80-85 range
items.quote: We've taken up prices by about 5%. We probably will still take up a little bit more, but you see we have to be prudent because now costs have come down again, and the last thing you want to do is to take down prices.

items.statement: LPG price went from INR60/kg pre-war to INR190/kg peak, now back to INR90/kg; kerosene and LABSA also trebled in Q1
items.quote: LPG before the war was INR60 a kilo. At the peak of the war, it went to INR190. I think our average consumption was about maybe, I don't know, a little lower than that, and it's now back to INR90 a kilo.

items.statement: India underlying volume growth 7% in Q1 (lower end due to poor HI season and fill rates); expect ~100bps improvement per quarter to ~8%
items.quote: I would say that 7% volume in India is probably at the lower end of the range that we may get. So, I think we'll probably be in and around maybe 100 bps more than this is around about where we should be in India this year.

items.statement: Consolidated underlying volume growth 9% in Q1 FY27; expect to be a few quarters away from consistent double-digit volume growth
items.quote: This quarter, consolidated underlying volume growth reached 9%, supported by increasingly broad-based momentum across geographies and categories.

items.statement: Speedboats (Fab, GK Incense, Godrej Air) growing strongly; new entries in toilet cleaners, body wash, face wash, pet care meeting milestones; launched Godrej Rizz in liquid dishwash (INR2,500-3,000 cr category)
items.quote: Our Speedboats, Godrej Fab, GK Incense Sticks and Godrej Air globally continue to grow strongly and are becoming increasingly meaningful contributors to the overall company.

items.statement: GAUM FMCG portfolio doubled media investment; air fresheners scaled across region; incense sticks pilot in Nigeria strong; EBITDA improved from high single-digit to consistent mid-teens
items.quote: There has also been a structural improvement in EBITDA from high single digit to a consistent mid-teens level, and we are confident of holding this going forward.

items.statement: Anticipate continued commodity volatility (crude, palm unstable) and El Nino impact on rural demand; geographically diversified sourcing provides resilience
items.quote: While prices have cooled off from the highs, going ahead, we anticipate volatility to remain with both crude and palm being unstable and El Nino impacting demand across a few categories.

items.statement: El Nino: negative for India HI in H1 (poor June), positive in H2 (warmer winter); positive for Indonesia HI; portfolio diversified enough to manage
items.quote: In India, probably quarter 2, as quarter 1 June was terrible for household insecticides. So, the results we delivered in India is with a terrible June with poor fill rates and extremely high costs.

items.statement: Committed INR500 cr to pet care business; expanded from Tamil Nadu to rest of South India after achieving product-market fit
items.quote: I think the important thing is that when we launched the pet care business, we committed INR500 crores of capital to pet care.

items.statement: GAUM constant currency growth 25% in Q1; mid-to-high teens constant currency growth seen sustainable for rest of FY27
items.quote: I think for FY27, rest of the year, possibly so. I would say in the longer term, you may or may not get 17% volume growth may not be what we may sustainably get even with FMCG growth.

items.statement: HI market share gained after almost a decade; driven by incense stick share gain and deinfluencing illegal incense; structural share gain expected to continue
items.quote: After almost a decade, we gained overall market share in the household insecticide category in Q1 FY27. This improvement is consistent with the actions we have been taking to win in this category.

items.statement: Muuchstac acquisition grown 70-80% from run rate; EPS accretive from day 1; digital-first profitable brand; capabilities being leveraged for other brands
items.quote: I think since we took over the acquisition itself, I think we have grown by about 70% or 80% from the run rate. So this rate of growth continues. It's also, as we told you at the time of acquisition, a highly profitable business.

items.statement: Board approved INR90 crores capex for advanced materials adoption capacities funded through internal accruals
items.quote: The Board has approved a new capex of INR90 crores funded through internal accruals towards setting up adoption capacities for our advanced materials business.

items.statement: Phase 2 cGMP4 capex of INR125 crores initiated for CDMO business, expected to operationalize by Q4 FY27
items.quote: In addition to the capex in the advanced materials, we have initiated in our CDMO business, Phase 2 cGMP 4 capex of INR125 crores funded through internal accruals, expected to operationalize by Q4 FY '27.

items.statement: HFC capacity expansion of up to 15,000 metric tons R32 on track for commissioning in Q3 FY27
items.quote: The HFC capacity expansion, the additional HFC capacity equivalent to up to 15,000 metric tons of R32 remains on track for commission ing in Q3 FY '27

items.statement: MPP debottlenecking at Dahej facilities expected to complete by Q3 FY27
items.quote: MPP capacity expansion, debottlenecking activities at our Dahej MPP facilities are progressing well and are expecte d to be completed by Q3 FY '27

items.statement: Renewable energy investment of INR15.73 crores for 14.9 MW hybrid project to meet over 60% energy needs
items.quote: An investment of INR15.73 crores in a group captive hybrid renewable project for 14.9 megawatts of renewable power supports our sustainability and decarbonization goals.

items.statement: Target 35-45% of R32 capacity contracted for five-year period
items.quote: Our idea is, as we've said before, to look at about 35% to 45% of the total capacities will be contracted for the five-year period.

items.statement: Normalized EBITDA margin expected in 32-33% range plus/minus 1% over next 1-2 years
items.quote: So we've got enough to have confidence from a point of view of operating leverage that what we are talking about wi ll be in the range of that 32%, 33%, plus/minus 1% here or there

items.statement: CDMO business has 30-40 molecules in pipeline, 10 in late stage, 3-4 with FDA readout in 8-12 months
items.quote: Today, if I talk about my molecule pipeline, we are talking about 30 to 40 molecules that I'm actively working on. About 10 molecules are into late stage, of which I'm sa ying three to four molecules have got an FDA readout in the next 8 to 12

items.statement: R32 long-term demand constructive, demand to double over decade while quota-driven supply shrinks to half
items.quote: The important part here is to understand that 32, the long-term demand environment remains constructive. We all know that over a decade, the demand for 32 is going to double, while the supply -- quota-driven supply is going to sort of shrink to half.

items.statement: Specialty chemicals growth driven by 5 new molecules including 3 patented molecules with less pricing pressure
