items.statement: CGD segment capex guidance of close to INR1,000 crores maintained.
items.quote: There is no capex on the gas trading segment, but there will be capex on the CGD segment, which practically we are giving a guidance of close to INR1,000 crores. We still stick with that.

items.statement: Plans to set up own propane import and storage facilities near Morbi market.
items.quote: Yes, we have plans to have our own propane import facility. We have basically shortlisted a few sites in Gujarat where we can put up our own terminal.

items.statement: Expects to sustain CNG growth of around 12-13% for next couple of years with more stations.
items.quote: I think we have been growing at close to 12 percentage, and this growth has continued and this quarter growing at 13 percentage now. Basically, we are expecting that. And as the MD told that we are going to add on more stations now. So we'll be able to sustain that growth for the next couple of years.

items.statement: Expects non-Morbi industrial volumes to reach at least 3 mmscmd in 1.5 to 2 years.
items.quote: As we expect LNG prices to become stable maybe in a year from now, we expect these volumes to be at least 3 mmscmd by 1.5 years to 2 years from now.

items.statement: Expects to do close to 3 mmscmd of gas in Morbi this quarter.
items.quote: Gas prices would be at a premium to propane. And our expectation is that we'll continue to do close to 3 mmscmd of gas at least in this quarter.

items.statement: Expects long-term third-party volumes of 4.5 to 5 mmscmd.
items.quote: Yes. I think it should be in that range, 4.5 million to 5 million.

items.statement: Expects to do at least 4 million tons LNG on term contract basis in 2030.
items.quote: So basically, as of today, around 28% would be like 2 million ton LNG equivalent on term contract basis. We expect to do close to at least 4 million tons in 2030.

items.statement: Morbi gas price is close to Rs 78/scm and propane close to Rs 65/scm.
items.quote: Ours is close to 78 Rs/scm and propane is close to 65 Rs/scm.

items.statement: Non-Morbi industrial gas price close to INR70 in Q1.
items.quote: It close to INR70 for the non-Morbi segment.

items.statement: Sourcing mix: 20% long term, 12.5% domestic gas, rest spot.
items.quote: Long term is 20%, domestic gas is 12.5%, and rest is spot, close to 67%. Out of these long terms, almost 20% is Henry Hub.

items.statement: Morbi volumes may bottom at 1.8 to 2 mmscmd due to lack of propane infrastructure.
items.quote: I think so. I think 1.8 million to 2 million would be a fair number to assume because in the past it had reduced to 1.8 mmscmd, around that number.

items.statement: Cash of around INR7,200 crores; concrete deployment plan by Q3.
items.quote: Yes, we have cash of around INR7,200 crores, so we have a capex plan of around INR1,000 crores for the CGD business. And with respect to the rest of the cash to be utilized, basically, we are working on certain programs with respect to the strengthening of the present business with respect to the CNG and the pipelines.

items.statement: GSPL transmission listing expected towards early September.
items.quote: We expect this towards early September.

items.statement: Blended revenue growth of 30-35% for next 3 years from new brands, vintage business, and capacity expansion
items.quote: So a blended growth of somewhere around 35% to 30% for the next 3 years is kind of on the charts and it's going to be a combination of all the new brands and our existing ones, plus the increase in the capacities that we are building currently at our own facility.

items.statement: GX domestic business expected to grow 30-35% annually for next 4 years from small base
items.quote: But for the next 4 years, we can easily consider around 30% to 35% growth on the GX line as well.

items.statement: Capex of INR30-40 crores planned for FY27 and similar for FY28, targeting INR35-45 crores per year for next 2 years
items.quote: We have a plan of about INR30 crores to INR40 crores of CapEx in this financial year from now. From onwards, maybe the same plan for the next year as well, about INR30 crores to INR40 crores.

items.statement: Revenue target for FY27 around INR800 crores, on track to overachieve; INR1,000 crores not committed
items.quote: This year, our target was somewhere around INR800 crores. I think we are in line to achieve that. We will cross that hopefully. INR1,000 crores, I do not want to comment.

items.statement: Pet care 45-55% gross margin, mobility 40-50%, nutrition 35-50%, dermaceutics 70-75%; margin expansion expected over 8-11 quarters as high-margin products scale
items.quote: Pet care works at around 45% to 55%. Mobility works at around 40% to 50%. Nutrition has a higher intrinsic margin, but right now, we are expansion. So we are looking at around 35% to 45%, maybe even 45% to 50%. Dermaceutics has a gross margin of 70% to 75%.

items.statement: Pet care targeting 40-50% growth for next 3-4 years from INR40-45 crore base; cat food launch by Q3/Q4 FY27, diagnostics and OEM to add revenue
items.quote: So overall, we are looking, again, at 40% to 50% growth in those numbers for the next 3, 4 years. We have a very small base of INR40 crores, INR45 crores overall with this.

items.statement: Inventory days targeted at 135-140 currently, aiming for 120 days within 4 quarters, long-term range 110-125 days due to SKU count
items.quote: We are looking at around 140, 135 days of inventory. Hopefully, within the next 4 quarters, it will come to around 120 days. It will always hover between 110 to 125 days because of the nature of the business and the number of SKUs that we have.

items.statement: Working capital at INR170-175 crores with 50% as cash; absolute working capital will rise with revenue but comfortable with internal cash flows
items.quote: We have a working capital of somewhere around INR170 crores, INR175 crores, which is not a high working capital for a company our size. We also have a lot of debtors. We have a good stock, and we have almost 50% of our working capital as cash on hand.

items.statement: Functional foods adding 42 variants; Jain variant performing well in pockets; cat biscuits launching in 6-7 months; Wagr pet platform beta live, full launch in 60-90 days
items.quote: We are also coming up with cat biscuits. I think we will be the second or the third one to have cat biscuit treats coming in, in the country. So that is also coming in, and we are creating a functional line even for the cats in the coming 6 to 7 months.

items.statement: FY27 consolidated revenue expected INR 11,000-13,000 crores, EPS INR 8.75-9.5 per share
items.quote: So far as our F Y27 outlook is concerned, our company expects F Y27 consolidated revenue to be in the range of INR 11,000 crores to INR 13,000 crores, that is growth of around 35% and above and also expects the FY27 EPS to be in the range of INR8.75 to INR9.5 per share, which is based on the proposed post corporate action face value of INR10 per share.

items.statement: Cost base front-loaded investing in AI infrastructure, international expansion, financial services
items.quote: Our cost base remains front -loaded as we invest in AI infrastructure, international expansion and our new financial services capabilities.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guardrail set at ~15% of gross revenue; Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 68% of net revenue
items.quote: The guardrails that you can establish is about 15%. That's like a guardrail, if you ask me. We always want to have guardrails, which is we never want to go below that certain amount rather than going into how much EBITDA we can improve and so on and so for th, we want to set up certain guardrails that enable us to ensure that we continue reinvesting into our future and maintain certain profitabili

items.statement: Transaction processing volume grew 74% YoY to INR 1,479 billion in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Our transaction processing volume for the quarter grew 74% year -on-year to INR 1,479 billion with continued strength across utility payments, government payments, retail, B2B and hospitality.

items.statement: RediffPay exiting CUG this month into production; RediffOne expanding into commerce, compliance, intelligence
items.quote: RediffPay is progressing well as our UPI -based consumer payments platform. It will be out of CUG this month and into production. RediffOne is evolving into an operating platform for businesses bringing together commerce, communication, compliance and intel ligence.

items.statement: UPI MDR monetization expected on large merchants/high-value transactions; 22% of transactions on UPI
items.quote: Today, almost 22% of our transactions are on UPI. So any kind of monetization on that UPI will add additional revenues definitely to our platform. Right now, as we stand, the act has been passed by the Lok Sabha. It still awaits Rajya Sabha and still awaits President's approval and then the gazette and then we will know what kind of pricing and monetization that NPCI and RBI is allowing to be done

items.statement: Enterprise AI demand for on-prem SLMs ($1-10B params) for data sovereignty; revenue impact expected in 9-18 months
items.quote: In terms of impact to our business is concerned, I think it's about anywhere from 9 to 18 months out, where you'll have -- you'll start seeing some good impact, we believe.

items.statement: Net revenue declined 3% YoY due to take-rate compression and competitive payments; core profitability focus with reinvestment
items.quote: Yes, typically, first quarter is a slightly low quarter. Second, third quarter is slightly better because of festival season than others. And we believe that as more and more transactions happen through our platform, we have slightly compression as far as our margins are concerned. If you look at our take rates, they have compressed slightly and that has impacted our net revenue.

items.statement: Strategic investments up to 2.5% in RatnaFin Capital NBFC and up to 7% in Online PSB Loans platform
items.quote: We have progressed well in proposed investments of up to 2.5% in RatnaFin Capital, which is an RBI registered NBFC with a very strong SME lending franchisee. We also approved a strategic investment of up to 7% in online PSB loans, India's largest public sector-backed digital credit platform.

items.statement: Neuromind AI subsidiary merging into AvenuesAI; share face value reverse split from INR 1 to INR 10
items.quote: First, Nueromind, which is our fully owned AI-based subsidiary is being merged into AvenuesAI. This will give us synergies and seamless operations and lead to cost benefits and data consent also. The second we are doing is a reverse split, which is a face value of share, which was INR1 now is being increased to INR 10 per share.

items.statement: UAE Central Bank in-principle approval for Retail Payment Services Cat III license; RBI authorization for PPI issuance
items.quote: We received in-principle approval from Central Bank of UAE for Retail Payment Services, which is a Cat III license for Avenues. UAE is already one of our strongest international markets. The license will allow us to broaden our customer reach and product suite and strengthen our long-term international payment strategy. In India, RBI authorized AvenuesAI to set up payment system for issuance and o

items.statement: PayCentral agentic payment platform launched on Google Agent Payments Protocol; early commercial traction
items.quote: Through Phronetic AI, we launched PayCentral, which we believe is India's first agentic payment platform built on Google's Agent Payments Protocol. It enables AI agents to transact directly with one another without requiring a person to manually initiate every payment.

items.statement: AI infrastructure strategy avoids large data center capex; focuses on SLMs, transaction intelligence scores, application layers
items.quote: We may invest selectively in smaller capacities, but not the large ones. So that's one. As far as the -- we've recently, in our release, mentioned that we want to build out transaction intelligence score and think of it as, in some ways, alternative risk score.

items.statement: FY27 consolidated revenue guidance of INR 2,000 crores maintained with growth weighted to second half
items.quote: Based on current customer discussions, our receipt order visibility, expected capacity ramp-up and planned utilization levels, we remain confident of achieving our previously stated consolidating revenue guidance of INR 2,000 crores for FY27.

items.statement: Garment division EBITDA margin guided above 15% for full year including Sri Lanka
items.quote: See, with respect to margins, we have already guided for a consolidated like garment division that is between Young Brand and S.P. Apparels put together, we will be anywhere above 15% for the whole year. Even including Sri Lanka business, we should be 15% EBITDA margin.

items.statement: Standalone adjusted EBITDA margin improved to 17.5% in Q1 FY27 from 15.2% in Q1 FY26
items.quote: Adjusted EBITDA margins improved to 17.5% compared to 15.2% Q1 FY26.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 15.3% in Q1 FY27 from 13.1% in Q1 FY26
items.quote: Consolidated EBITDA for Q1 FY27 stood at INR 61.4 crores compared to INR 52.9 crores in Q1 FY26, reflecting a growth of 15.9% year-on-year. EBITDA margin improved 15.3% compared to 13.1% in Q1 FY26.

items.statement: Young Brand adding luxury bra products as value-added line; customers encouraging expansion into molded bras
items.quote: Young Brand being in intimate wear, we do a lot of underwear, which is the bottoms for the existing customers. And it's a value add in terms of doing the luxury products. And all the customers have been encouraging and pushing Young Brand for a while to do those value-add products.

items.statement: Consolidated interest cost FY27 guided INR 30-35 crores excluding exchange loss; Q1 higher due to INR 1.75 crore exchange volatility hit
items.quote: On a consolidated basis, we should be anywhere between INR30 crores to INR35 crores. Bhavin Chheda: For the full year? V. Balaji: Yes, for the full year. Yes, correct. Without the exchange loss

items.statement: Board approved INR 3 per share dividend and stock split from INR 10 to INR 2 face value
items.quote: I'm pleased to inform our shareholders that the Board has approved a dividend of INR 3 per share for the year and has also proposed a stock split of the company's equity shares from a face value of INR 10 per share to INR 2 per share, subject to the necessary approval.

items.statement: Revenue visibility strong for next 3-5 years in smart metering and 12-18 months in C&I with high double-digit growth expected
items.quote: If you look at smart metering they have a you know a a strong visibility. If you look at this year Next year, the next 3 to 5 years seem to be a strong visibility.

items.statement: Order book stands at 3,200 crores as of 7th August 2026 with metering and systems accounting for more than 96% of total orders
items.quote: Our order book stands at 3,200 CRS as on 7th August 26 with metering and systems accounting for more than 96% of the total orders.

items.statement: EBITDA margins moderated to 12.26% in Q1 FY27 due to input cost volatility and changing revenue mix; pricing actions initiated to progressively improve margin quality
items.quote: On profitability, EBITDA grew during the quarter although EBITDA margins moderated to 12.26%.

items.statement: Price increases being passed on in wire and cable and lighting; design changes and alternative materials being pursued in smart metering to offset cost inflation
items.quote: Plus the prices are the price increases are also getting passed on to the consumer. So like we've just had couple of increases in the wire and cable.

items.statement: C&I demand diversified across builders, industrial OEMs, solar, telecom, retail and institutional customers; wire and cable volumes up 1.5-2x year-on-year
items.quote: Demand remains diversified across builders, industrial OEMs, solar, telecom, retail and institutional customers.

items.statement: Capex mainly maintenance for metering; automation investments ongoing with 7-8 new machines commissioned including MCB automation; ROI 3-4 years
items.quote: Right now I think from a metering perspective it is going to be more on the maintenance part because we have the capacities now.

items.statement: Geopolitical conflicts driving metal and industrial plastic cost volatility; minimum wages in Haryana up 40% in May adding to manpower cost
items.quote: This reflected an input cost volatility volatility particularly across metals and industrial plastics due to the geographical disruptions.

items.statement: Smart metering 2.0 replacement cycle and export opportunities (Middle East utility approval) seen as long-term growth vectors beyond current order book
items.quote: We are also in export we are also looking at certifications. In fact you just mentioned Middle East one of the the utilities in Middle East has just approved our metering.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin target is double-digit, dependent on geopolitical situation and overseas demand
items.quote: See consol business, we are trying to achieve double-digit EBITDA margin, and it all depends on how the geopolitical situation stand and overseas demand stand with us.

items.statement: Mag carbon brick and casting flux new lines can add INR150-200 crores revenue at peak capacity
items.quote: What I said that in past, we have spoken about the addition of two new product lines, mag carbon brick and casting flux, we can add around INR150 crores to INR200 crores on account of these two new product lines at the peak level.

items.statement: Hofmann Ceramic order book maintained at similar levels to corresponding periods
items.quote: At Hofmann Ceramic, we have been able to maintain order book at similar levels compared to corresponding periods.

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA declined 17% YoY to INR31 crores due to higher raw material and LPG costs
items.quote: EBITDA for the standalone business stood at INR31 crores in the current quarter, a decline of 17% year-on-year.

items.statement: Price increases implemented across customers and products but time lag in passing on cost increases; benefits expected progressively over coming quarters
items.quote: To mitigate these pressures, we have implemented appropriate price increase across customers and product categories. However, given the nature of our business, there is typically a time lag in passing on cost increases with some of the elevated costs being absorbed in near term.

items.statement: Geopolitical uncertainties, supply chain disruptions, elevated LPG costs, and British Steel blast furnace issues impacted Q1; Liberty Steel dues unlikely to be recovered
items.quote: We faced multiple challenges in FY26, including geopolitical uncertainties, supply chain disruptions, delays in capex spending and rising input costs.

items.statement: Hofmann Ceramic targeting breakeven by end of FY27; Monocon UK moving towards breakeven; Sheffield Refractories expected to normalize in Q2 with British Steel blast furnace restart
items.quote: Turning around the business remains a key priority, and we are taking multiple measures to improve performance with the objective of reducing losses and achieving breakeven by the end of financial year '27.

items.statement: Revenue growth target of 11% to 13% and EBITDA margin target of 11.5% to 12.5% for FY27
items.value: 11% to 13% revenue growth; 11.5% to 12.5% EBITDA margin
items.quote: So, for the revenue growth, it would be somewhere between 11% to 13%. That is the kind of growth we are looking forward to during this fiscal. And at EBITDA level, it would be somewhere between 11.5% to 12.5%.

items.statement: Targeting double-digit volume growth for FY27, aiming to close the fiscal with 11% to 12% overall growth
items.quote: So, that is our internal target as well. So, we are very hopeful and aggressive towards the fact that in the next three quarters coming ahead, we will be, overall at a company level, we will close this particular fiscal with a double-digit growth, which will be a combination of volume plus value growth. And so, this year, we are targeting to grow at around 11% to 12%.

items.statement: Implemented 4% to 5% price hike in Q1 FY27; no further price hikes planned as yarn and cotton prices have stabilized
items.quote: So, till date, we have taken just 4% to 5% of price hike. And no other price hike is in picture right now. And the yarn prices and the cotton market is also stagnant, and they are stabilized right now. So, we don't see any reason why we should need to have a price hike again.

items.statement: Quick commerce channel grew 59.4% value and 15.1% volume YoY, contribution increased to 5% of revenue in Q1 FY27 from 3.1% in Q1 FY26
items.value: 59.4% value growth; 15.1% volume growth; 5% revenue contribution
items.quote: The quick commerce channel sustained its strong growth trajectory, recording 59.4% value growth and 15.1% volume growth year-on-year, with its contribution to revenue increasing to 5% in Q1 FY '27 from 3.1% in Q1 FY '26.

items.statement: No major capital expenditure commitment in near term; focus on improving free cash flow generation and reducing debt
items.quote: Given that we have no major capital expenditure commitment in the near term, our capital allocation strategy remains clear. We stay focused on improving free cash flow generation and reducing debt.

items.statement: Thermal season booking conferences in July show good traction for upcoming season
items.quote: The conferences that we do in the month of July, pan-India basis and the booking that we got for the thermals is really, it shows the trajectory for this year as well.

items.statement: Export business grew 16.2% value and 15.5% volume YoY to INR 19 crore across 15 countries; contribution increased to 4.9% from 4.2%
items.value: INR 19 crore; 16.2% value growth; 15.5% volume growth; 4.9% contribution
items.quote: Our export business also continued to perform well, recording 16.2% value growth and 15.5% volume growth year-on-year, with its contribution increasing to 4.9% in Q1 FY '27 from 4.2% in Q1 FY '26. During the quarter, we generated export revenue of INR 19 crore across 15 countries and will continue to focus on expanding our international footprint.

items.statement: Internal business plans pegged at 25% growth; external stakeholders modeling at around 20%
items.quote: When we execute all our business plans, internally they are pegged at 25% growth and we are convinced and seeing the right kind of momentum on the ground to realistically peg ourselves internally on that.

items.statement: Combined entity expected to deliver at least 20% growth and be accretive on bottom line after larger M&A
items.quote: I would only sign on the dotted line and invest if I am convinced that under the Affle leadership, the existing business as well as the new inorganic acquisition would continue to deliver combined at least 20% growth and will deliver a meaningful bottom-line performance.

items.statement: Aim to close larger M&A by early 2027; targets to accelerate Developed Markets expansion
items.quote: We aim to close the larger M&A by early 2027 and the identified targets shall accelerate our expansion across Developed Markets by providing deeper and differentiated access to customers and verticals.

items.statement: Expect better margin expansion within this financial year, especially in Developed Markets
items.quote: I believe you will see that within this financial year, we will see better margin expansion, especially in Developed Markets.

items.statement: EBITDA margins stable at 22.4% in Q1 FY2027, up from 22.3% sequentially
items.quote: Our EBITDA margins also improved from 22.3% to 22.4% q-o-q.

items.statement: 95% of revenues grew over 25% y-o-y on adjusted basis, excluding RMG and FinTech headwinds
items.quote: On an adjusted basis, 95% of our revenues have actually seen over 25% growth y-o-y.

items.statement: Encouraged by demand environment across key markets for upcoming festive quarter
items.quote: As we look ahead to the upcoming festive quarter, we remain encouraged by the demand environment across our key markets.

items.statement: Direct advertiser revenue contribution at 79% in Q1 FY2027 vs 74% in FY2026; 100% of business has direct advertiser technology integration
items.quote: What is most important for us is that whether the advertiser is having a billing relationship with us directly or through its agency, it must have a direct Affle 3i Limited August 10, 2026 21 technology integration with us

items.statement: Category E and F robust across board; Category G (RMG) in recovery; Category H (healthcare, hospitality) doing well in India/EM; Developed Markets led by E and G
items.quote: Overall, in categories E, F, G and H, I would say you can order it as category E, F, H and G in terms of qualitative ranking on how we are doing in India and Emerging Markets.

items.statement: Activating over 100,000 mobile apps to reach over 500 million connected devices in Developed Markets this year via AdColony assets
items.quote: We aim to unlock significant competitive advantage by activating over 100,000 mobile apps to reach over 500 million connected devices in Developed Markets this year.

items.statement: Bobble investment (INR 136 crore) under insolvency; impairment testing pending NCLT appeal outcome; decisive step expected in next few quarters
items.quote: We will be very prudent. We will take a decisive step in the next few quarters.

items.statement: Raised appropriate funding to prepare for larger M&A; third-party due diligence advisors appointed
items.quote: We have also raised the appropriate amount of funding to get ourselves ready for that. We have given you a consistent timeline that now we have third-party due diligence partners working on it.

items.statement: OCF to PAT ratio expected to normalize to 80-85% by Q3 FY2027 after 110% in FY2026 due to upfront cash collection in March
items.quote: You will see about 80%-85% OCF to PAT ratio by Q3.

items.statement: Currency impact stable this quarter; 72% business from Emerging Markets/India with cross-currency ROI adjustments; 20% US dollar-to-dollar
items.quote: This quarter had a stable USD to various currencies, not only INR. So we didn't see any additional impact what we had in Q4 or Q3.

items.statement: No impact from slowing smartphone adoption; consumer time spent on digital content increasing across markets
items.quote: No, we are not seeing any impact. I believe what we are seeing instead is a lot more time that the consumers are spending on their devices.

items.statement: Developed Markets growth expected at 20%+ consistently; US is largest focus area both organically and inorganically
items.quote: We see that we will be growing at least at 20%+ in Developed Markets consistently.

items.statement: INR3,000 crore revenue target by 2030 remains the endeavor
items.quote: The INR3,000 crore target continues to be our endeavor and we will update you on that progress.

items.statement: Bharat Seats revenue target of INR3,500 crore by 2030
items.quote: That should be about INR3,500 crore for Bharat Seats by 2030.

items.statement: Order book of INR650 crore to ramp incrementally till 2030
items.quote: So, the INR650 crore order book should come incrementally till 2030.

items.statement: Order book dominated by seat frames and covers; new products include seat insert, latch, seatbelt reminder, ambient lighting
items.quote: Most of the products are from the seat frames and the seat covers. In addition to that, we are also going to set up a plant for seat insert, so that is going to be there. There is going to be seat latch and there is going to be a new plant for seatbelt reminder system. In addition to that, there are some new ambient lighting orders that we have received, but that is a smaller part of the order boo

items.statement: Annual capex of INR40-50 crore for next couple of years
items.quote: The capex should be about INR40 crore to INR50 crore for the next couple of years annually.

items.statement: Asset turnover of approximately 4x on INR150 crore combined capex
items.quote: So, it should be approximately 4x.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expected at similar 11-12% level; commodities indexed
items.quote: Our EBITDA margin should be at the similar level, should be at about 11% to 12% and all our commodities are indexed and that is why we are able to maintain these margins

items.statement: Non-seat products expected at similar margins to seating
items.quote: Non-seat should be at similar margins.

items.statement: Sales volumes to all partner OEMs improving; bidding for Toyota and Kia business
items.quote: Sales volumes to all our partner OEMs continue to improve, reflective of both capabilities and encouraging environment.

items.statement: NDR South plant SOP in Q2 FY27; revenue potential INR70-80 crore at full capacity
items.quote: The revenue potential for that plant is about INR70 crore to INR80 crore, subject to how the model performs.

items.statement: NDR Hayashi sunshade business started; ambient lighting from 2028; JV revenue potential INR200-300 crore over 5-6 years
items.quote: The potential that we were targeting is about INR200 crore to INR300 crore, but that was over the course of five to six years.

items.statement: NDR Hayashi JV to continue losses for some quarters until break-even at INR100-150 crore revenue
items.quote: So, we will continue to have losses for some quarters until we touch a break-even point for sales.

items.statement: No customer pressure to reduce selling prices; cost increases offset by operational efficiencies
items.quote: We are not facing any pressure from customers to reduce selling price. We have actually been able to set off our cost increases with operational efficiencies.

items.statement: Marketing, R&D, and hiring expenses to continue as company grows aggressively
items.quote: These expenses will tend to continue as we are trying to grow aggressively. In addition to that, we have also hired some people for our growth.

items.statement: Aurangabad plant land acquired; will set up plant only after securing Toyota business
items.quote: So, we have got the land at the moment. We are still acquiring business from Toyota. Once we acquire the business, that is when we will look to set up the plant.

items.statement: Revenue generation from strategic manufacturing agreement anticipated from calendar year 2029
items.quote: Once all products are commercialized, revenue potential is expected to be approximately USD90 million to USD100 million. Technology transfer activities are planned for completion within 2 years with revenues expected to commence from calendar year 2029.

items.statement: Commercial opportunities and meaningful revenue contribution from liposomal product in-licensing expected from FY30
items.quote: Given the development time lines involved, we expect commercial opportunities and meaningful revenue contribution to start from FY30, creating another important long-term growth driver for the company.

items.statement: New high capacity ampoule line at Fontenay facility expected to enter production in early 2027 adding 30 million ampoules annual capacity
items.quote: This new line is expected to enter production in early 2027 and will add approximately 30 million ampoules of annual capacity for enhancing efficiency, competitiveness and growth potential for the site.

items.statement: Overall gross margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 65% reflecting favorable product mix and operational efficiencies
items.quote: Overall gross margin for the quarter stood at 65%, reflecting the benefits of a favorable product mix, increasing contribution from CDMO projects, improved operational efficiencies and procurement initiatives.

items.statement: Adjusted EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 was 28%
items.quote: Adjusted EBITDA for this quarter stood at INR5,102 million with margins of 28%, while profit after tax was INR3,170 million, reflecting a healthy growth of 47% year-on-year with PAT margin of 18%.

items.statement: Healthy demand across existing products supported by volume expansion and improved competitiveness from cost optimization
items.quote: In addition to these launches, we are seeing healthy demand across several existing products. Growth has been supported by volume expansion from existing customers and improved competitiveness enabled through our cost optimization initiatives.

items.statement: Secured multiple new CDMO contracts including a new GLP-1 collaboration and expanded pipeline across complex injectables, peptides and drug delivery platforms
items.quote: During the quarter, we secured multiple new CDMO contracts, including a new GLP-1 collaboration and expanded our pipeline across complex injectables, peptides and drug delivery platforms.

items.statement: Executed strategic manufacturing and supply agreement with leading global pharmaceutical company for 55 SKUs across 3 sites
items.quote: The current agreement covers 55 SKUs to be manufactured across the 3 sites with scope of adding more products soon.

items.statement: Secured prefilled syringe manufacturing program for injectable orphan drug at Braine-l'Alleud facility
items.quote: In Braine-l'Alleud, we secured a prefilled syringe manufacturing program for an injectable orphan drug for European customer.

items.statement: Revenues in rest of world markets impacted by supply disruptions in Saudi Arabia and delayed NUPCO tender awards
items.quote: While demand across several key markets remain healthy, revenues in the quarter were impacted by supply disruptions in Saudi Arabia, one of our important markets. The award of NUPCO tenders has been delayed, and we expect the results to be announced shortly.

items.statement: Actively progressing multiple brownfield and greenfield expansion initiatives across manufacturing network to support growth

items.statement: Constant currency revenue growth of 15% clearly achievable for current year

items.statement: Cenexi revenue guidance maintained at near EUR200 million with high single-digit margins for FY27

items.statement: INR2,000 crores capital expenditure program commenced with ongoing projects on track

items.statement: Cenexi EBITDA target of double-digit by end of FY27 from current 4%

items.statement: CDMO target of 30% of consolidated revenue near term, potentially larger than B2B by CY29

items.statement: Complex ANDA pipeline major opportunities post FY29, microsphere products
items.quote: It's post '29. Some of the big products, especially on the microsphere products, there are a couple of big ones, which is post '29.

items.statement: US revenue run rate USD110-120 million, growth above market 3-4%

items.statement: Complex products will take larger chunk of US business post FY29
items.quote: Because most of the complex products is post FY29. And our base business is also very large now compared to that, right? So while it takes — probably it will take a larger chunk of the U.S. business.

items.statement: Growth 20-25% for next 4 years, complex products become next growth driver
items.quote: But when you're saying the growth, what we're saying about 20%-25% [or] 20% when you're growing next 4 years, at the end of those 4 years, probably these products will get launched and probably the next growth driver will be these products as well.

items.statement: Profit share about 9% this quarter

items.statement: Impairment charge expected in range of ₹22-24 crores for WtE asset damage from monsoon; insurance recovery may offset part
items.quote: Based on our current assessment, we expect an impairment charge in the range of around ₹ 22 crores to ₹ 24 crores, which we will treat as an exceptional extraordinary item separate from our core operating performance.

items.statement: New Greater Noida contract for electric road sweepers worth ₹243 crores over 5 years with 2-year extension; expected to start Q3 FY27 and contribute ~₹46 crores in first year

items.statement: Andhra WtE projects at Kadapa and Kurnool: land possession secured, civil designs complete, civil contractor mobilized at Kadapa, Kurnool in next couple weeks; financial closure at last stage

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA ₹45 crores, down 27% YoY and 33% QoQ; margin 16.8% vs 24.4% YoY and 22.8% QoQ; compression from higher vehicle hiring/transport costs at CIDCO, 18% YoY employee cost increase (now 34% of revenue), and ₹10 crore deferred waste

items.statement: Management expects margin improvement from Q2 onward; transport cost renegotiation underway; labour cost pressure from DA hike but escalation clauses in most contracts; target to return to historical 20-22% EBITDA margin range
items.quote: We expect those margin profile to slightly improve going forward. It will not be as bad as what we have encountered in Q1. We'll see some respite coming in because of re-negotiation on the terms with the transport entities.

items.statement: Labour cost spike to 34% of revenue (historically 30-31%) due to Maharashtra DA rate revision and Labour Code changes; bulk expected to be passed through annual escalation clauses with 6-month timing mismatch
items.quote: Bulk of it would be a part of the escalation adjustment as per the tender condition, but that will be a timing mismatch because we get an annual escalation and the cost will be incurred today. So maybe after 6 months from now based on the annual life of th at particular contract, we'll go for an escalation as per the tender condition

items.statement: BMC C&T contract (7 wards) started with 1 ward in Q1; will ramp through Q2-Q4 adding ~1,500 tons/day; Atkoli project adds 600-800 tons/day by Q4; existing portfolio gives 6-9% growth from escalations, new contracts add 10-15%
items.quote: Our existing portfolio gives us a scope of anywhere between 6% to 9% depending upon the tipping fee escalation that gets registered and clocked in. The new businesses, new scope of additional growth will give us around 10% to 15% additional growth coming from that.

items.statement: Targeting 50-50 portfolio split between Collection & Transportation and Processing/WtE (from 70-30 historically); focus on margin-accretive waste processing/WtE projects
items.quote: We used to be essentially 70% Collection and Transportation and 30% of processing. We are actually moving towards 50-50 kind of portfolio, and that's our target.

items.statement: Force majeure at PCMC WtE from extreme monsoon (650mm rain); legacy waste mound collapse killed 9; WtE suspended pending OEM/Hitachi certification; MRF/composting resumed July 28
items.quote: On July 8, the region received exceptionally heavy rainfall of approximately 650 mm, well above anything recorded historically in the area. During this event, a mound of legacy waste at the dumping site adjacent to our facility collapsed onto the company's administrative building.

items.statement: Refinanced Antony Lara Renewable Energy term loan of ~₹140 crores from 10.25% to 8.25% (200 bps reduction); incurred ₹7 crore one-time prepayment charge; net benefit ₹14 crores over 15-year tenure
items.quote: The refinancing reduced the interest rate by 200 bps from 10.25% to 8.25%, and we expect it to deliver recurring interest savings and support stronger cash flow generation from the WtE facility going forward.

items.statement: RDF sales ~40,000 tons, down 28% YoY due to CIDCO bio-mining completion; realization improved to ₹300+/ton from ₹250/ton; compost sales stable ~6,000 tons
items.quote: RDF sales stood at approximately 40,000 tons, down around 28% year-on-year. This is not directly comparable to Q1FY26 which has benefited from a meaningful contribution from the CIDCO bio-mining project now completed.

items.statement: C&D waste recycling at 600-650 tons/day (capacity 600±10%); 96% recycling rate; BMC policy mandates builders send waste to plant
items.quote: Now we are getting close to 600 to 650 tons per day, and we have a capacity of 600 tons per day, plus or minus 10% that we can process.

items.statement: Gross debt ~₹435 crores, cash ~₹111 crores, net debt ~₹324 crores, net D/E 0.4x; weighted avg cost of debt ~10.1%, expected to trend lower post-refinancing; DSOs stable at 114 days
items.quote: On the balance sheet, as of June 2026, gross debt stood at approximately ₹435 crores with cash and bank balances of around ₹111 crores, translating to a net debt of approximately ₹324 crores and a net debt-to-equity ratio of 0.4x.

items.statement: Evaluating compressed biogas (CBG) as part of integrated waste projects (wet fraction to CBG, dry fraction to WtE); not viable standalone
items.quote: Yes, we have evaluated and we are indeed looking at CGB project, but it's a part of the integrated waste project. items.statement: Management expects at least 15% sustainable growth going forward, with 20-22% looking doable depending on new product success and international environment.
items.quote: So, moving forward, I believe that our growth level should be at least that or more because now we have larger facilities, a stronger company, much larger product line and a lot of new products to offer as well.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 growth exceeded 15% and demand is recovering well, suggesting FY27 could achieve 15% growth.
items.quote: For now, it looks like we could with our Quarter 1 having exceeded 15% growth, and it looks like the demand is recovering well, and we are growing strongly.

items.statement: Remaining CAPEX of INR 20 crores capital advances and INR 160 crores CWIP to be completed by Q2 or Q3 FY27; no major new CAPEX planned, only maintenance CAPEX of INR 20-25 crores per year.
items.quote: Currently, in our balance sheet, total capital advances lying is around INR 20 crores and CWIP is around INR 160 crores. So, our major objective is to complete this whole pending CAPEX. Apart from that, some maintenance CAPEX will only fall in place.

items.statement: Peak incremental revenue from 4-year CAPEX plan estimated at INR 400 crores, targeting total peak sales of INR 750-800 crores.
items.quote: So, on a fixed asset basis, we should be able to turn in at around 0.8times. So, we are looking at somewhere around INR 400 crores of incremental revenue over and above what we have in our facilities existing through the entire 4-year CAPEX plan.

items.quote: For now, it looks similar to what we have achieved in Q1. But if input costs, because see, it is a direct hit of about 4.5%, 5%, 500 basis points almost on the gross margin or the material margin.

items.statement: Domestic demand recovery is meaningful and sustainable with notable uptick in customer inquiries; export demand recovering with healthy order pipeline conversion.
items.quote: We have seen a meaningful revival and improvement in the demand and momentum across end-to-end industries we serve, with a notable uptick in customer inquiries during this quarter.

items.statement: New products (including cell culture) expected to contribute INR 65-70 crores in FY28; Panchla and Amta facilities to contribute 20-25% of standalone revenue in FY28.
items.quote: We would ideally expect Panchla and Amta to at least contribute to 20% to 25% of our standalone revenues in FY'28.

items.statement: Raw material prices highly volatile (25-50% increase, recent sharp decline then sharp rise again); geopolitical tensions in West Asia and US tariff uncertainties persist; Chinese competition intense internationally.
items.quote: But over the last two weeks, again, we have started seeing input costs move up sharply. So, to be honest, it is a very volatile situation. And it is supposed to be tracked week-on-week basis.

items.statement: Gross debt ~INR 380 crores, net debt ~INR 330-340 crores; targeting INR 40-50 crores net debt reduction in FY27; peak depreciation INR 105-110 crores in FY27.
items.quote: The gross debt for the company is about to be INR 380 crores, and the net debt is about to be INR 330-340 crores, something like that.

items.statement: FY27 guidance: revenue ~INR670 crores, EBITDA ~INR260 crores, PAT ~INR144 crores

items.quote: While the non-commerce business are expected to contribute revenue of approximately INR220 crores with EBITDA of INR46 crores and PAT of INR34 crores based on our current business plan and historical quarterly trends.

items.quote: We expect the offline, online split to be about like our offline sales are at almost INR 330 crores and the offline at -- online is INR120 crores . So we are a major into off -line split with a hybrid brick -and-mortar model.

items.quote: So currently, the debt is at a cost of about 9% to 9.5%, bringing it down from a 17.5%, which we had last year.

items.quote: So it will be INR8 crores, it will be INR7.5 crores to INR8 crores. Okay.

items.quote: Debt on the commerce is INR125 crores and the debt on the non -commerce is INR145 crores, INR125 crores and INR145 crores.

items.quote: Our order book for the quarter also stood strong at more than INR600 crores without considering the LOI of INR185 crores with a strong mix of domestic and export reflecting strong demand for our products.

items.statement: Export order book shows >40% export mix; geopolitical tensions creating near-term uncertainty

items.quote: The intent is to do it in Q2. But again, we all know there are a few geopolitical and container issue in this quarter, Q2 primarily.

items.quote: The project is progressing well, and we remain on track to commence the spooling facility by end of this year.

items.statement: Margin improvement expected post Q2 FY27 as fittings and spooling scale up

items.statement: Data center demand strong with India capacity targeting 8x growth to 10.5 GW in 5 years
items.quote: India data center capacity, what we believe was around 1.3 gigawatt roughly in 2025, which is targeting to grow by 8x around 10.5 gigawatt in coming 5 years.

items.statement: Volume growth expected to be higher than 15% in FY27 including fittings and spooling contribution

items.statement: Net debt at INR325 crores as of June 30, 2026

items.statement: Stamping sales targeted at ~30% growth to ~Rs 78 cr in FY27

items.statement: Large-size Cages targeted at 50% growth to ~Rs 73.5 cr in FY27

items.statement: Combined foreign subsidiaries loss to reduce to low single digits (Rs 2-4 cr) in FY27

items.statement: FY27 capex guidance Rs 50-80 cr; total Rs 180-200 cr over FY27-28 for Bhayla Phase-2 and China Phase-2
items.quote: we at least expect in the range of Rs. 50 crores to Rs. 80 crores as a year-over-year CapEx but we will give a better guidelines in the coming quarters.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 consolidated Engineering EBITDA margin ~16.6% (Rs 69.8 cr on Rs 421 cr)

items.quote: Combination of two factors, Rahul, one is AI-driven productivity in engineering, AI-driven productivity in managed services, and second, very importantly, efficiency in our support operations.

items.quote: One of the important investments being considered is a heavy capacity hydraulic Extrusion press. The proposed press and other machines would enable us to manufacture a wider range of copper as well as copper alloy products.

items.statement: Order book of Rs 20 crore as on 31st July 2026 expected to convert into approved sales.
items.quote: We still have a 20 crore order as on 31st July 2026, expected to convert into approved sales.

items.statement: EBITDA margin sustainable around current levels with variation of plus/minus 1-2% due to controlled overheads and consistent business.
items.quote: We are firm that it should vary by 1% or 2% plus minus, but it will continue, because we are in a very smooth working and, business, we have a short business with such expenses.

items.statement: Favorable long-term demand environment from electrical infrastructure, power equipment, transformers, switchgears, data centers, and EV vehicles.
items.quote: The increasing requirement for reliable electrical infrastructure, power equipment, transformers, switch gears, data centers, EV vehicles, and other electrical applications provides a favorable long-term environment for copper demand.

items.statement: Targeting revenue of Rs 1,000 crore in 3 to 5 years from current ~Rs 200 crore, driven by market opportunity and new capacity.
items.quote: Going to 1,000 crores, we are very much aware that whatever points should we keep in mind that should not affect us or not make us down now in future. And, we are from the 3 to 5 years. I'm on the plus side. It will be possible.

items.statement: Targeting 3-4x top-line growth and even more bottom-line growth in FY27 vs FY26
items.quote: But at least this year we are targeting to grow at least 3 to 4 times than what we have done in last year in the top line growth as well as even more in the bottom-line growth.

items.statement: Expect to easily cross Rs. 30+ crores per quarter in FY27 excluding Odisha plant
items.quote: I think this year, we will be able to easily cross about Rs. 30 plus crores per quarter.

items.statement: Targeting Rs. 12-15 crores revenue from Odisha epi wafer sales in H2 FY27
items.quote: We are estimating and targeting revenue out of sale of epi wafers in the range of Rs. 12 crores to Rs. 15 crores for the second half of this year.

items.statement: Total Odisha plant capex Rs. 618 crores: Phase 1 Rs. 225 crores, Phase 2 Rs. 395-400 crores
items.quote: So, the total expected CAPEX for the Orissa plant is Rs. 618 crores. For the first phase we expect the CAPEX to be around Rs. 225 crores. And for the second phase we expect the CAPEX to be around Rs. 395 crores-Rs. 400 crores.

items.statement: FY27 Phase 1 capex budget Rs. 100-120 crores; Phase 2 budget under discussion
items.value: Rs. 100 crores to Rs. 120 odd crores
items.quote: So, we expect a CAPEX of around Rs. 100 crores to Rs. 120 odd crores for the phase 1. And for phase 2 we are still under discussion.

items.statement: First overseas order received for 120 numbers of 125 mm 5 kV SCR thyristors
items.quote: RIR continues to strengthen its international footprint following its first overseas order for 120 numbers of 125 mm 5 kV SCR thyristors.

items.statement: Q1 EBITDA margin improvement driven by 80-85% raw material cost pass-through and cost control
items.quote: I can say almost about 80 %-85% passed it on to the customers. Maybe some old orders which we have accepted with the schedules which we were not able to. But all the new schedules are with the new prices.

items.statement: Long-term EBITDA margin target 15-17%
items.quote: Yes, our always aim is to be there where what you mentioned the numbers. Our aim is to be always there on those numbers.

items.statement: Epi wafer EBITDA margin expected 20-25%; SiC devices higher than epi
items.quote: So, we expect an EBITDA somewhere in the range of 20%-25% on sale of epi wafers.

items.statement: Growth drivers: High Power Devices in India, new products, equipment division; LPD at saturation
items.quote: The growth drivers will be HPD in India going forward and new products and equipment.

items.statement: West Asia disturbances making cost pass-through and value-add pricing difficult
items.quote: But today also because of this West Asia disturbances, pushing the cost increase to the market itself is becoming a bit difficult. Then now adding some more value addition and then charging more to the customer is going to be a little tough till the things stabilize at West Asian issues.

items.statement: Margins depend on geopolitical environment; not fully controllable
items.quote: But these are all depends on geopolitical issues are going to be going forward. So, margins is not always only on our control. It is sometimes on the control of external environment also.

items.statement: Odisha Phase 1: Clean room done, transformer charged, power draw in 1-2 days, machinery install by end Aug/mid-Sep, epitaxy ops end Q2 FY27
items.quote: The clean room construction is completed for epitaxy. Infrastructure for sourcing the power supply through 33 kV line has been completed. Further, the transformer is also charged yesterday by the authorities, and we will be able to draw the power in next 1 or 2 days. The plant and machinery installation is under progress and estimated to be completed by end of this month or mid -September. We expe

items.statement: Odisha Phase 1 funding: Govt subsidy Rs. 58 crores received, company contributed ~Rs. 70 crores, Rs. 70 crore bank loan applied for
items.quote: So, till now government has provided a subsidy of Rs. 58 crores. And company has also made an equivalent contribution. And on top of it we have spent maybe Rs. 8 crores-Rs. 10 crores more which would not qualify CAPEX. So, maybe our contribution would be somewhere around Rs. 70 odd crores and government has provided a subsidy of Rs. 58 crores. Till now.

items.statement: R&D spend philosophy: 8-10% of revenue as long-term investment
items.quote: We always have been from the very beginning since my first company in US till RIR. I always believed in about 8 %-10% spending in R&D as a long -term investment.

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 10.5% to 11% for full year
items.quote: we are maintaining our full year guidance of 10.5% to 11% EBITDA

items.statement: FY27 capex guidance revised upward to INR 200-250 crore due to new order wins
items.quote: For FY 27, our capex guidance updated to INR 200 to 250 crore, mainly due to new order wins

items.statement: Order book stands at around INR 2,500 crore with approximately 90% LED lighting composition
items.quote: The order book stands at around INR 2,500 crore with LED (Light Emitting Diode) lighting composition of approximately 90%.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin at 9.2%, impacted by ~120-130 bps net commodity cost impact; expect recovery in Q2
items.quote: EBITDA margin stands at 9.2%, in line with Q1 FY 26 despite external headwinds. There is approximately 120 to 130 bps (basis points) net impact of commodity and other costs in Q1 FY 27.

items.statement: Q2 margins expected above 10% as Q1 realizations materialize; full year guidance 10.5-11% intact
items.quote: In Q2, we do expect the margins to be higher because a lot of the Q1 realizations will actually get realized in Q2. So yes, I'm not sure whether it will be 10.5%, but it definitely should be above 10% for Q2.

items.statement: FY27 capex split: INR 40-50 crore maintenance, remainder for new business capacity expansion
items.quote: Bifurcation is the maintenance capex, as we mentioned, would continue to be some INR 40 crore to INR 50 crore. The rest would go to the new business wins or capacity expansion for new business.

items.statement: FY28 capex guidance indicated at INR 150-200 crore, but considered premature
items.quote: FY 28 capex will depend how the business wins will happen, but our guidance would be in line with what we mentioned earlier, somewhere INR 150 crore to INR 200 crore at this moment.

items.statement: Demand expected to remain healthy into festive season, though monitoring commodity prices and geopolitics
items.quote: As we move into the festive season, demand is expected to remain healthy, although the industry continues to closely monitor commodity prices, input cost inflation and geopolitical developments.

items.statement: LED lighting 63% of Q1 revenue (up from 61% YoY); 90% of order book LED-based
items.quote: In Q1 FY 27, LED lighting accounted for 63% of our total revenue, up from 61% in the same quarter last year. Importantly, approximate 90% of our current order book is now LED based

items.statement: Medium-term revenue target INR 9,000 crore+ by FY30-31 from current INR 4,500-5,000 crore base; CAGR 15-20%
items.quote: from a current base of, let's say, INR 4,500 crore to INR 5,000 crore, we should be looking at probably a INR 9,000 crore or upwards revenue in FY 30-31

items.statement: Medium-term EBITDA margin target upwards of 13% in 3-4 years from current 10.5-11% guidance
items.quote: 3 to 4 years, I think our endeavour is to hit the 'teen' EBITDA upwards of 13% or so.

items.statement: OEMs not agreeing to monthly price amendments; only quarterly/six-monthly; commodity recoveries delayed to Q2
items.quote: However, that has not happened for most of the industry. I believe only commodities like aluminium was something they were willing to give, which does not affect this company. So as of now, we are still looking at quarterly or six monthly amendments.

items.statement: China sourcing continues for cost competitiveness but group opened China office to manage risks; localization of electronics components targeted 70-90 bps margin gain in 2-3 years
items.quote: We actually do source a lot from China and as the whole supply chain does. But we are also cognizant of the fact of the risks. We continue to actually now in our engineering drawing, look at alternatives than to China

items.statement: Mould revenue target INR 250-300 crore for FY27 vs INR 180-185 crore last year, weighted to H2 (Q3/Q4)
items.quote: last year, our mould sale was somewhere around INR 180 crore to INR 185 crore. And this year, we are hopefully targeting INR 250 crore to INR 300 crore.

items.statement: Bengaluru plant expansion for Maruti/Toyota models on track for Q4 FY27 commissioning; Sanand and Bawal brownfield projects underway
items.quote: our Bengaluru plant expansion to support Maruti and Toyota's upcoming models is progressing satisfactorily and is expected to be commissioned from Q4 of FY 27. We also have a brownfield project underway at Sanand and Bawal

items.statement: Expect to operate close to full run-rate utilization across lines, other than downtime for TOPCon upgrade
items.quote: As we move through the year, we expect to operate close to full run-rate utilization across our lines, other than any downtime associated with the TOPCon upgrade.

items.statement: TOPCon upgrade estimated at INR270 crores, completion by March 2027, funded via internal accruals or debt
items.quote: The TOPCon upgrade will take our cell capacity from 1.2 gigawatt to 1.35 gigawatt and is expected to be completed by March 2027. The project entails an estimated capital expenditure of approximately INR270 crores.

items.statement: Confirmed order book of INR1,278 crores as on 30th June 2026, up from INR1,161 crores at end of March 2026
items.quote: On the order book, we closed the quarter with a confirmed order book of INR1,278 crores as on 30th June 2026, against INR1,161 crores at the end of March 2026.

items.statement: EBITDA margin 34% in Q1 FY27 vs 47% year ago due to higher module mix; absolute EBITDA grew 21%
items.quote: EBITDA margin for the quarter was 34% against 47% in Q1 last year. The principal reason is the change in our sales mix. We sold substantially more modules during the quarter, and module margins are lower than cell margins.

items.statement: Silver consumption reduced 20% in FY26, targeting further 10% reduction; evaluating alternative metallization pathways
items.quote: On input costs, we brought silver consumption down by 20% during financial year '26 and have set our cells a further 10% reduction target. For the longer term, we continue to evaluate alternative metallization pathways.

items.statement: No reduction in demand for DCR products (PM-Surya Ghar, PM-KUSUM); expect demand increase from AI, BESS, night-time solar
items.quote: So, if you see the how the solar industry is structured, we see that there will be increase in demand, considering that the impact of the AI, the impact of the BESS and also the night-time solar requirement that will be generated through solar BESS.

items.statement: Module production more than doubled to 103 MW (81% utilization); cell production 259 MW (92% utilization); module share of revenue mix materially larger
items.quote: Module production more than doubled from 50 megawatt to 103 megawatt, and module utilization moved from 39% to 81%. The capacity we have built is now being used more fully, and that is the most important operating development of the quarter.

items.statement: Repaid INR110 crores IREDA term loan from internal accruals; promoter pledge to drop from 80% to 16% of promoter holding
items.quote: On 4th August, we repaid the entire INR110 crores outstanding on our IREDA term loan from internal accruals. We did this without raising fresh capital and without slowing any of our ongoing growth investments.

items.statement: Phase 3 expansion of 4 GW cell and 4 GW module in two 2 GW phases; land shortlisted in West Bengal near existing facility, awaiting approvals; construction expected to start mid-September
items.quote: We have shortlisted land close to our current facility and are currently awaiting the requisite approvals for the same. There is no change in our capex plans. Whatever capacity we have announced is what we are confident of executing.

items.statement: TOPCon upgrade payback expected between 2 to 3 years; cell efficiency target ~25% post upgrade
items.quote: So, sir, we expect the payback between 2 to 3 years of this capex expansion.

items.statement: Q1 realization: cells ~USD0.125/Wp, modules ~INR20.50/Wp; current cell prices ~USD0.13/Wp, modules ~INR20.50-21/Wp
items.quote: So, I think the Q1 realization is hovering around INR0.125 per watt peak for solar cells and it is around INR20.50 for solar modules.

items.statement: ALMM mandate deferred from June to December indicates solar cell capacity still lower than module capacity; deadline movement depends on capacity additions by December
items.quote: So, basically, definitely the ALMM mandate got postponed from June to December, which is an indication of the fact that the solar cell capacity still remains much lower than the module capacity, because of which they had to move this deadline.

items.statement: Inventory increased ~7% Q4 to Q1 due to cyclicality and monsoon slowdown; not alarming as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: So, sir, the overall inventory has increased by roughly 7% if we compare the Q4 inventory versus Q1. So, there has not been a very sharp increase in overall total inventory

items.statement: No financial outflow on Andhra Pradesh land; shift to West Bengal for faster execution via supply chain, manpower, operational synergies
items.quote: There had been no financial outflow in regard of the Andhra Pradesh land, so from that perspective, it felt prudent to do it here.

items.statement: Expect to maintain current margin levels for a year or two; cell margins higher than module margins
items.quote: I mean, it's difficult to say how long it will be there, but as of now, it seems that the margins we are holding for this quarter, we should be able to hold it for a year or two.

items.statement: Machinery lead time 4-6 months; equipment finalized, advances to be released per project schedule; no capital blocked currently
items.quote: Machinery is the lead time is close to four to six months. So, right now, there is no requirement of blocking capital on account of advance of machinery.

items.statement: Confident of reaching 25% revenue growth this year and maintaining it.
items.quote: We will reach. We are confident of reaching that 25% level, and we'll maintain that for now.

items.statement: Maintains about 25% revenue growth for this year and next year.
items.quote: So we still maintain the similar trend of about 25% on the revenue growth for this year. And for next year also, that's the visibility that we see as of now.

items.statement: Aiming to move margins up and above about 13%.
items.quote: And the margins, last year, we reported about 12.5%. We are aiming to move it up and above about 13%, and that could remain stable or slightly improve in the next year.

items.statement: Export composition to remain about 50% to 55% or slightly higher.
items.quote: And in terms of our export component -- sorry, composition, I think it will still remain in the order of about 50% to 55% or even slightly higher, given the orders that we see on the growth that we see in EMS, but it could be in the same range also, nothing much expected to change.

items.statement: Semiconductor equipment revenue expected to reach USD 25-30 million in coming 1-2 years.
items.quote: And we expect this to get to in the range of USD 25 million to USD30 million in the coming 1 to 2 years. And this is where we are seeing a strong visibility, and we -- it's in line with our expectations.

items.statement: Semiconductor equipment revenue expected to double or triple in next 2 years.
items.quote: We expect this to kind of double or triple in the next 2 years. So you will see that coming in this year as well as it will further ramp up in the next year.

items.statement: EMS business margins in range of about 10% EBITDA, cost-plus model.
items.quote: With the EMS business, considering the sectors that we are addressing, these will be in the range of about 10% EBITDA. They can vary slightly a little bit up and down depending on the customer and segment a little bit.

items.statement: Semiconductor business is EMS, margins stay at 11%.
items.quote: No, I didn't talk about higher margins in semiconductor. I said the revenue growth, we have a good visibility on semiconductor, but this is fundamentally EMS business. So the margin stay at 11%.

items.statement: Stand-alone order book approximately INR1,800 crores, up 31% year-on-year.
items.quote: We also closed the quarter with a stand-alone order book of approximately INR1,800 crores, up 31% year-on-year and strong order inflow for the quarter stood at INR360 crores approximately, that grew by approximately 70% year-on-year, which was mainly influenced by BTS registering a robust 150% year-on-year growth at INR120 crores.

items.statement: Expects strong order intake from SBS program this year.
items.quote: And with regard to your question regarding the SBS program, this is moving well. We have started to book some good orders from this program, and we expect in this year that we will have a very strong order intake coming from this program essentially.

items.statement: Capex estimate INR50-70 crores, starting towards end of next fiscal.
items.quote: And on the whole, high-level estimate is about, I can say, anywhere between INR50 crores and INR70 crores, but we'll get to know more as we do the budgeting for the next fiscal.

items.statement: Revenue mix may marginally favor BTS over 70-30 split short term.
items.quote: We may see in 1 year -- maybe in the very short term, 1 year or 2 years, you may have slightly a little bit higher contribution from the BTS. But I would not say it is hugely different.

items.statement: Expects strong revenue growth in BTS this year and coming years.
items.quote: With the increased order intake that we've had, we expect to have clear strong revenue growth in the BTS business this year and the coming years also.

items.statement: Electrification and grid automation NPI programs to contribute meaningfully over next 2 years.
items.quote: These programs are expected to start contributing meaningfully to revenue growth over the next 2 years and provide another important growth avenue for our EMS business.

items.statement: No further liabilities expected from overseas subsidiaries restructuring.
items.quote: Importantly, with the operating businesses now transferred and restructuring process substantially completed, we do not expect any further liabilities in relation to these subsidiaries.

items.statement: Export BTS opportunities can have higher margin profile beyond BTS.
items.quote: But when those come, which are system-level opportunities for exports, yes, those can absolutely have a higher level of margin profile even beyond BTS.

items.statement: FY27 bookings expected to show strong growth over FY26's INR 745 cr; FY28 onwards pivotal change in trajectory
items.quote: FY27 would show, again, it's not sales, INR 745 crores is the booking value, like you correctly said. So we hope that, that number should show strong growth. And moving forward in FY28 -29, there should be a much larger uptick.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth expected to be reasonably strong over FY26's INR 176 cr topline
items.quote: FY27 will show a reasonably strong growth from FY26. But I think FY28, FY29, I can't comment on five-year numbers.

items.statement: Imperia Phase 2 has INR 170-180 cr of inventory available for sale
items.quote: So approximately INR 170 crores to INR180 crores depends on where we can land the inventory finally at what rate, that much of the inventory is available.

items.statement: Legacy ready unsold inventory stands at INR 75 cr
items.quote: Around INR 75 crores of inventory is available in our legacy projects.

items.statement: Target to liquidate 40-60% of legacy inventory in FY27
items.quote: I think it will be safe to assume that we'll try for as much as possible, but it's safe to presume, let's say, 40% to 60% of this inventory getting liquidated in the current year.

items.statement: Latitude 27 tower-wise completion targeting revenue recognition of 15-20% of GDV between March and May 2027
items.quote: our internal estimates give us to believe that between March and May, somewhere we will be able to recognize approximately 15% to 20% of this.

items.statement: Almost 100% of forthcoming projects pipeline (3.4 msf) to be launched within FY27
items.quote: Almost all of this, I'm tempted to say 100% of this, but almost all of this will be launched within FY27.

items.statement: Solano Gardens group housing and extension launch targeted within FY27
items.quote: even the group housing , hopefully, depending on how the markets are, should be launched within this year. The extension, we would attempt to do within this year, but again, no commitments on that.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 37.1% driven by high-margin horizontal development (Imperia Phase 2 at ~60% gross margin)
items.quote: EBITDA came in at INR 18.7 crores, which is up 243% year-on-year and a healthy margin of 37.1%.

items.statement: Management aims to maintain balance between vertical and horizontal developments; horizontal projects expected to deliver higher margins
items.quote: Those are bound to deliver higher margins and the management is cognizant of trying to maintain a reasonable balance between vertical and horizontal developments on an opportunistic basis, and we'll continue doing that.

items.statement: Executed legally binding contract for 50+ acres contiguous prime land in Lucknow; 15 acres land aggregation completed
items.quote: During the quarter, the company executed a legally binding contract for more than 50 acres of contiguous land in a prime location in Lucknow. In addition, land aggregation approximating 15 acres was also completed

items.statement: Lucknow housing market seeing transformation with new areas opening up and inbound migration from Kanpur-Lucknow Expressway
items.quote: housing itself is undergoing transformation, a lot of new areas opening up, a lot of inbound migra tion with the opening of the Kanpur-Lucknow Expressway, there is a lot of interest in the Lucknow housing

items.statement: Project timelines subject to RERA extensions and commodity/labor disruptions (e.g., 4-month extension already received)
items.quote: A lot of this is a function, as you might understand, of what happened in the Middle East, for instance, four months, a lot of commodity pressure, a lot of labor displacement is that and all projects have received four-month extension under RERA.

items.statement: Buybacks and capital allocation tools under active consideration; will deploy capital where it optimizes structure
items.quote: all the steps that you have mentioned are under active consideration of the management. I am not going to make any comment on those, but be rest assured that our objective is to also bring shareholder delight apart from only bringing customer delight.

items.statement: Eldeco City Courtyard commercial component is a very small proportion of salable area within integrated township
items.quote: So we've designed a small commercial development within the Eldeco City township. And therefore, as you might see in the forthcoming projects, it constitutes a very small proportion of the salable area.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth expected in lower single digit, dependent on cycle and industry.
items.quote: You see, as we stated earlier, we are looking at a positive trajectory, and in the lower single digit as indicated earlier. But again, depends on the cycle and the industry, it could go one way or the other, but tha t is what we are confident for right now and maintain the same as we said earlier.

items.statement: FY27 expected to be better than FY26 on export recovery, new launches, pharma and biologicals scale-up.
items.quote: We expect FY27 to be better over FY26 driven by recovery in exports in second half supported by new product launches and gradual scale up of pharma and global biologicals businesses.

items.statement: Full-year capex guidance of Rs. 700 to Rs. 800 crore; present investment Rs. 250 crore.
items.quote: We have given a guidance of Rs. 700 to Rs. 800 crore, which is the standard capex as you rightly said. Our present investment is Rs. 250 crore.

items.statement: Objective to sustain gross margins at best possible levels by optimizing and being agile.
items.quote: So, to answer objectively, very precisely, our objective is to keep and sustain our gross margins at the best possible levels by optimizing and being agile given the best situation to be managed for the industry scenario, in a volatile world that we are in today.

items.statement: Pricing pressure exists due to challenged demand cycle and input cost; balance is a challenge.
items.quote: On the other hand, you have the challenge of the input cost. So striking that fine balance is a challenge in the industry today.

items.statement: Domestic business delivered 12% volume growth and 3% revenue growth in the quarter.
items.quote: Despite a challenging operating environment in the domestic market, we delivered a 12% volume growth in this quarter, translating into a 3% revenue growth.

items.statement: ETR for FY27 expected around 24%.
items.quote: We expect ETR for FY27 to be around 24%.

items.statement: Pioxaniliprole expected to launch in India within the year, other geographies next year and year after.
items.quote: Hopefully, depending on the regulatory framework, we expect to have early start this year. We are hoping within the year we should get the launch for India.

items.statement: Exports face pressure from soft commodity prices, muted crop economics, rising costs, genericization and tariffs.
items.quote: Soft commodity prices, in-line with impact of the previous year's industry downturn, and muted recovery in crop economics, consumption patterns continue to exert pressure on growth and pricing. This is further compounded by rising costs due to geopolitical uncertainties, genericization pressures and tariffs.

items.statement: R&D investments at 3% to 4% of revenue, seen as value creation not loss.
items.quote: So that is the way we are seeing and I think we remain at that level of a certain percentage, at 3% to 4% investments of our revenues into research.

items.statement: Net working capital reduced by 19 days, releasing INR 300 crore cash.
items.quote: Despite the challenging environment, the team delivered an impressive reduction of 19 days in net working capital, releasing INR 300 crore of cash.

items.statement: Net cash of INR 38 billion on debt-free balance sheet.
items.quote: Our strong debt -free balance sheet, supported with net cash of INR 38 billion, provides resilience and flexibility for strategic investments.

items.statement: Biologicals grew 50% with three-year CAGR of 15%.
items.quote: Biologicals have shown an aggressive growth of 50% with a three-year CAGR of 15%.

items.statement: Global biologicals targeting aggressive growth across Brazil, Mexico, Europe, US with 500+ field trials.
items.quote: We are on a track for aggressive growth across Brazil, Mexico, Europe, and US supported by 500 plus field trials.

items.statement: Distillery segment margins expected to remain around 10%-12% for the year
items.quote: But overall, I think our margins remain around 10% - 12%.

items.statement: Supreme Court order provides incremental 4.5 crore liters ethanol allocation until November
items.quote: if I'm correct, it's around 4.5 crores liters that we get from that order. So for the next 2, 3 months, I think we'll have a good order book.

items.statement: 250 KLPD grain-based plant at Fatehabad on hold; machinery orders finalized but awaiting policy clarity
items.quote: pretty much the machinery orders are finalized and everything. All we have to do is press the start button, but we want to wait and just evaluate for a bit more.

items.statement: Malt plant for IMFL entry still under conceptualization; no set timelines
items.quote: The malt unit is still under consideration and conceptualization. I think the first step should be entering the IMFL business which we are working on.

items.statement: CBG plant from paddy straw being actively evaluated; central policy favorable, Haryana has state subsidy
items.quote: It is being actively being evaluated. We want to study all aspects because paddy straw for CBG is a relatively tricky raw material.

items.statement: Distillery EBITDA margin improved to 12.4% in Q1 FY27 from 10% in Q1 FY26
items.quote: Despite the challenging environment, the Distillery segment margin improved to 12.4%, supported by the operational efficiencies and the vertical integration.

items.statement: ENA realizations declined to INR58/liter in Q1 FY27 from INR70/liter in Q1 FY26 due to oversupply
items.quote: While realizations of ENA and ethanol supplies to private buyers remained under pressure due to oversupply, with ENA realizations declining to INR58 per liter in Q1 FY27 from INR70 a liter in Q1 FY26.

items.statement: Ethanol sold to private players (primarily Reliance) at average INR58/liter ex-factory
items.quote: Ethanol to private players is primarily Reliance. And I think the average price is INR58 ex-factory.

items.statement: Maize procurement cost was INR22-23/kg in previous quarter; current maize price INR25/kg
items.quote: for previous quarter, I think the procurement cost was around INR 22 to INR 23 a kg.

items.statement: DDGS prices steady with slight decrease; maize-based DDGS at INR24-25/kg, rice-based DDGS similar
items.quote: prices of maize-based DDGS are currently hovering around INR24 to INR25 a kg and rice-based DDGS are about the same.

items.statement: Grain ethanol demand expected to improve slightly next year as sugarcane ethanol likely not allowed; flex fuel, isobutanol, SAF, cooking fuel are long-term demand drivers
items.quote: the demand for grain ethanol next year should improve slightly because ethanol from sugarcane will most likely not be allowed and only molasses-based ethanol will be there.

items.statement: Country liquor volumes grew 42% QoQ and 46% YoY to 6,37,993 boxes in Q1 FY27; targeting 30 lakh cases this year in Punjab market of 1.25 crore cases
items.quote: We sold 6,37,993 boxes in Q1 FY27 with our volumes increasing 42% quarter-on-quarter and 46% year-on-year.

items.statement: Fire at 200 KLPD ethanol storage tank at Bathinda on 19 June 2026; 90,000 liters stock lost; plant shut, expected to restart in 15 days; insurance covers stock loss and P&L
