items.quote: The stock in the tank was 90,000 liters during the accident. The plant is still shut. The tank is being repaired. So I think in the next 15-odd days, hopefully, we'll bring that plant into production again.

items.statement: Debt reduced to ~INR360 crores including working capital; working capital utilization ~INR60 crores; further reducing working capital limit by INR50 crores in August; 75 lakh pledged shares released
items.quote: I think including the working capital around INR 320 crores. No, sorry, working capital is separate, and I think we are utilizing about INR 60-odd crores in working capital, so INR360 crores.

items.statement: Exited packaged oil business; recognized INR199.47 lakhs profit on sale of fixed assets from dismantled unit
items.quote: This quarter results include INR 199.47 lakhs, representing profit on the sale of fixed assets, comprising building materials and scrap from our dismantled unit.

items.statement: Acquired remaining 25% stake in Svaksha Distillery on 30 June 2026; 150 KLPD unit commercially commissioned in first half of July
items.quote: on 30th June 2026, we completed the acquisition of the remaining 25% stake in Svaksha Distillery Limited, making the 350 KLPD distillery in Kharagpur, West Bengal, a wholly-owned subsidiary.

items.statement: PAT guidance for FY27 remains around INR750 crores
items.quote: Our guidance still remains around INR750 crores. I am not changing the guidance.

items.statement: Domestic formulation volumes expected to increase about 25% in FY27
items.quote: I think this year, we expect that domestic will increase by about 25% in volumes alone.

items.statement: Gross sales guidance for FY27 between INR3,300 crores to INR3,400 crores
items.quote: I will stick to the same guidance that we gave earlier in the year that we end the year with about INR750 crores and our gross sales will be between INR3,300 crores to INR3,400 crores in that region.

items.statement: Crop Health Sciences target to break even for FY27
items.quote: But the goal and our expectation for the year is to break even.

items.statement: Crop Health Sciences revenue expected to be close to last year's INR138 crores
items.quote: See, last year, we did about INR138 crores total, and we are about INR40 crores in Q1. By Q2, Q3, I think we should be fairly close to that number.

items.statement: Organic capex run rate of INR250-300 crores per year
items.quote: Organically, I think every year, we have around INR250 crores to INR300 crores of capex year-on-year. That's the run rate anyway we have.

items.statement: Planning to raise INR2,000 crores for acquisitions, short-term loans and capex
items.quote: we are also looking at a couple of very interesting opportunities of acquisitions and some kind of an M&A opportunity. And we believe that this cash would be reall y required, and we believe that this would be helpful at the right time. And hence, we want to raise the money from the market

items.statement: Two US launches planned for next financial year with exclusivity
items.quote: Yes, of course. We intend to launch with our exclusivity. We can't name them because of the confidentiality agreements. But yes, we have two launches in the next financial year.

items.statement: Semaglutide brand doing around INR2 crores per month in India with third-party orders
items.quote: I think our brand per month is doing around INR2 crores roughly. But we have a lot of other third-party business, which I don't think will get repeated.

items.statement: EBITDA margin improved QoQ to 30.9% due to international, domestic performance and lower operating costs
items.quote: EBITDA, including other income for the quarter, stood at INR245.7 crores with EBITDA margin of 30.9%. There has been an improvement in EBITDA margin quarter-on-quarter, which can be attributed to the performance of our international and domestic business and lower and measured operating costs.

items.statement: Brazil revenue grew 180% to INR178 crores driven by oncology pipeline
items.quote: Revenue from Brazil stood at INR178 crores, representing a growth of 180%.

items.statement: Carfilzomib plant upgrade on track for completion by end of year, launch timing confidential
items.quote: The plant is on the upgrade right now, and we think the upgradation should be completed by end of the year, and we believe that we'll be able to launch it at the time when the launch date is set.

items.statement: Olaparib litigation trial scheduled in next few months, exclusivity determination pending
items.quote: I think the trial date. I think it's sometime in the next few months. Top of my head, I'm not able to remember what date it is. We have a tentative, of course, so it is good. And then the issue of exclusivity is there because it took more than 30 months.

items.statement: Adcock Ingram stake increased to 49% in July 2026 for INR1,060 crores
items.quote: In July 2026, we acquired additional stake of 13.25% in Adcock Ingram, taking our total holding to 49%.

items.statement: Crop Health Sciences demerger delayed by 2-3 months to around March due to fundraise
items.quote: So it could probably delay by about 2 to 3 months. Yes, I think probably instead of December, it could be about March.

items.statement: Achieved highest ever gross margin of 39.7% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: As a result, we achieved our highest ever gross margin of 39.7% during this quarter.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expanded 480 bps to 8.7% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: At the operating level, EBITDA increased to INR17.6 crores from INR5.6 crores in corresponding period last year, with an EBITDA margin of 8.7%.

items.statement: Took price increase of 18-19% versus pre-war levels and retained almost all of it
items.quote: So in totality we have taken a price increase of around 18 % to 19% vis -a-vis pre-war situation and we were able to basically get almost all of that.

items.statement: No price cuts taken yet; will watch gas prices and market before deciding
items.quote: So as of now this situation is very volatile, the gas prices continues to remain volatile , people are not very sure of that the continuity on availability of propane. So as of now there are no price cuts that we have taken.

items.statement: Volume grew 22.9% YoY in Q1 FY27 driven by Morbi supply gap and OBL demand generation
items.quote: Overall volume grew by 22.9%, while revenue increased by 42.8% year -on-year to INR203 crores, supported by an ASP increase of around 15.9%.

items.statement: Sellout of primary sales volume improved to ~40% in Q1 FY27 from 26% last year
items.quote: Our demand generation initiatives have ensured a sellout of approximately 40% of the primary sales volume in Q1 versus 26% sellout last year.

items.statement: Plan to invest ~INR10 crores to convert 1 million meters of ceramic capacity to GVT
items.quote: We plan to invest around INR10 crores to convert 1 million meters of existing ceramic capacity to GVT.

items.statement: Small capex of ~INR15 crores over next 4-5 months for equipment upgrades and ceramic-to-GVT conversion
items.quote: So, we have there are some small capex we are currently undertaking over the next, you know, four-five months and all, which will cost us maybe broadly about INR15 odd crores, which will be internally financed.

items.statement: GVT share of sales by value was 47% in Q1 FY27; 15-20% of GVT from Dora plant
items.quote: So we have about 47% by value of our sales in quarter 1 was GVT. So I think about 15% to 20% of that would be coming from Dora and balance -- bulk of the rest would be coming from SKD.

items.statement: Geopolitical volatility in Middle East creates uncertainty on gas prices and exports
items.quote: Operating environment for the industry has been volatile, as you all know, and the geopolitical developments in Middle East continue to create global uncertainty.

items.statement: Exports down sharply in April-May due to 5-6x freight cost increase from Gulf tensions
items.quote: Exports in whatever data that we have for first couple of months for the year, exports is down, which was somewhere around INR1,500 crores to INR1,600 crores a month. April was somewhere around INR500 crores, and May was somewhere around INR1,000 crores.

items.statement: Working capital cycle improved to 18 days from 20 days sequentially in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Our working capital cycle further improved to 18 days from 20 days sequentially, reflecting our continued effort to enhance operating efficiency, optimize inventory and receivables, and maintain a lean balance sheet.

items.statement: Company remains debt-free with cash and liquid investments of over INR47.7 crores net of debt
items.quote: From a balance sheet perspective, the company remains debt free, supported by a strong cash position and liquid investments of over INR47.7 crores, net of debt.

items.statement: Management does not provide revenue or margin guidance for FY27
items.quote: As a policy, we do not give any guidance for future.

items.statement: Project revenue share was 18% in Q1 FY27; retail growing faster than enterprise segment
items.quote: So even if you were to do the split, I think for quarter 1, our project revenue was 18%.

items.statement: FY27 underlying volume growth guided at 12% to 15%
items.quote: I can see a growth of approximately 12% to 15% coming in this financial year, which is neutralized to the material effect.

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin improvement of at least 1% expected
items.quote: On the other, we are also expecting at least 1% improvement in the EBITDA margins.

items.statement: Rs. 125 crore investment over two years at leased Shikrapur facility
items.quote: Recently, we announced an investment of approximately Rs. 125 crore over a period of next two years at our leased facility at Shikrapur.

items.statement: FY27 capex plan of approximately Rs. 150 crore including Rs. 70 crore for new facility
items.quote: For quarter 1 FY27, capital expenditure was approximately Rs. 40 crore and for the full year, the plan is for approximately Rs. 150 crore.

items.statement: Executable order book of Rs. 8,450 crore as of 30th June over six years (2026-2031)
items.quote: Including the recent order wins in the quarter, Alicon's executable order book stands at approximately Rs. 8,450 crore as on 30th June, which represents executable orders over a period of six years from 2026 to 2031.

items.statement: New business wins of over Rs. 450 crore potential revenue over next five years acquired last quarter
items.quote: During the last quarter, we acquired businesses across both automotive and non-automotive segments, which together have the potential to generate more than Rs. 450 crore of revenue over the next five years.

items.statement: Visibility of Rs. 850 crore over next five years with two new large Indian OEMs
items.quote: And together, we currently have visibility of approximately Rs. 850 crore of business over the next five years with these two customers.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 9.5%, adjusted margin 11.4% excluding aluminium impact
items.quote: The EBITDA was Rs. 55 crore with the EBITDA margin of 9.5%.

items.statement: Raw material inflation contractually pass-through with timing lag; manufacturing cost recovery discussions progressing
items.quote: The first is raw material inflation, primarily aluminium and related alloys. These costs are contractually pass -through in nature and are fully recoverable from customers, albeit with the timing lag.

items.statement: Secured price increase approvals from some customers for manufacturing cost inflation; further closures expected in current quarter
items.quote: We have already secured approvals from some customers, while discussions with others are progressing well, and we expect further closures during the current quarter.

items.statement: Indian auto industry structurally strong; PV up 11.3%, 2W up 21%, CV up 19.5% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: The passenger vehicles recorded their highest ever first quarter sales at approximately 1.57 million units, growing to around 11.3%. 2 -wheelers grew 21%, and commercial vehicles grew 19.5%.

items.statement: Hybrid segment potential 25-30% CAGR; EV segment 20-22% CAGR over 4-5 years; well positioned in both
items.quote: Our current assessment is that the hybrid segment could grow an approximate 25% to 30% CAGR over the next several years, while EVs could grow at approximately 20% to 22% CAGR over four to five years of time.

items.statement: Non-auto order book currently 2% (~Rs. 126 crore); targeting expansion by year-end with wins in HVAC, defence, tractor segments
items.quote: Out of this order book of Rs. 8,450 crore, we see at this moment, the non-auto visibility is 2%. So, this is roughly around Rs. 126 crore.

items.statement: European operations in transition; legacy programs ending, new programs ramping up; recovery expected from Q4 FY27
items.quote: we see a reversal trend from the last quarter of this financial year. And next year, definitely, we want this p lant to be coming back to the normal state

items.statement: New Shikrapur facility expected to generate Rs. 500 crore annual revenue in 4-5 years
items.quote: Based on our current programs, we expect this facility to generate approximately Rs. 500 crore of annual revenue over a period of four to five years of time.

items.statement: Expecting 1% margin improvement in FY27
items.quote: Yes. I explained to you, in this year, we are expecting to improve by 1%.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 reported margin 9.5% vs 11.4% last year; adjusted margin 11.4% excluding aluminum impact
items.quote: This quarter, we have the margin of 9.5% against 11.4% for the last year. But I have also explained that the adjusted margin is 11.4% for this quarter when we remove the impact of the aluminum.

items.statement: Aluminum price pass-through is immediate from 1 April; no future lag impact
items.quote: So, as we are sitting end of the quarter, there is nothing which is going to be impacting us in future, as compared to what we have already shown.

items.statement: Freight cost increases partly passed through; some OEMs pick up material, rest under discussion to conclude this quarter
items.quote: But it does affect in rest of the cases, and these are the cases which are already in discussion with the customer as a part of all the inflationary increases. And as we have already said, some increases are already accounted for, which we have already got a confirmation, but some are in discussion, which we should be able to conclude in this quarter.

items.statement: JLR EV dispatches started; currently supplying 600 sets/week, expected to increase from Jan 2027, peaking by Q3 calendar year
items.quote: Currently, we are expected to supply them at a rate of 600 sets per week. And we already have an indication from JLR that this number would further increase from Jan 2027.

items.statement: New Pune plant (Rs 125 cr capex) has committed orders for all business; revenue potential Rs 500 cr in 4-5 years
items.quote: as of now, every single business which we will do in this factory, we have already committed order. So, we are not going to be looking for new orders to Alicon Castalloy Limited’s Q1 FY2027 Earnings Call Transcript come into this

items.statement: New Pune plant possession 1 Sep 2025; SOP by March 2027; capacity 3,000-7,000 tons; Rs 125 cr investment for Rs 500 cr revenue potential
items.quote: In terms of timelines, we are looking for going in SOP into this factory by March 2027 or just towards the end of the financial year. And in terms of capacity, as I have said, we are looking for generating a revenue of around Rs. 500 crore in this factory.

items.statement: ROCE was 10.7% last year; targeting 15% via portfolio changes and JLR turnaround; payback on capex typically 3-4 years
items.quote: The last financial year, our ROCE was as low as 10.7%, which already is looking at 15% by only minor tweaks, which we have done in the business process.

items.statement: JLR investments made but SOP delayed causing losses; expected turnaround in FY27
items.quote: So, you know, we have put up the investments and we are not able to finish the orders. So, there is a delay in the SOP. So, those areas where investments are there, but there is no return, even we are in the losses. So, those are going to be turned around in this year.

items.statement: Data center opportunity: one customer confirmed India, Europe in 2 quarters, then Mexico; 7-8 aluminum parts identified; special project for futuristic growth
items.quote: They have already confirmed in the next 2 quarters, they are going to open up the Europe market and thereafter Mexico. So, this is just to start with one customer, but we have done a survey, and we see a great potential.

items.statement: Capacity utilization >90% in Q1; new facility being set up; freeing capacity from low-margin 2-wheeler business over next 2 quarters
items.quote: Currently, in the last quarter, we have reached close to 100%. It is more than 90% for sure. And that is exactly the reason that we are now quickly setting up a new facility.

items.statement: No one-time expenses visible currently; development spend ~Rs 18-20 cr last year (Rs 3-5 cr/quarter) for critical parts, alloys, dedicated teams
items.quote: Intangible, I think maybe in the last year, I do not remember the exact figure, maybe Rs. 18 crore-Rs. 20 crore like that. So, quarterly, Rs. 3 crore to Rs. 5 crore we are spending on this.

items.statement: Non-auto revenue aspiration unchanged; expect positive pie change by end of next financial year but not fully reaching target
items.quote: by end of next fin ancial year, definitely, this pie will positively change towards the aspiration numbers but not actually reaching there completely

items.statement: Targeting at least 10% total turnover growth, with consultancy over 50% of turnover.
items.quote: Revenue growth rate, definitely, we are targeting -- in the last year, we were having total turnover of INR3,850 crores. This time, we are targeting at least 10% growth -- and we are keeping close watch on the progress of the projects.

items.statement: Expects consultancy turnover around INR2,300-2,400 crores, more than 50% of total.
items.quote: And we are expecting more than 50% turnover from the consultancy segment. As I have already said it may be around 55% also. So definitely, our consultancy segment turnover will be more than INR2,000 crores. It will be around INR2,300 crores and INR2,400 crores.

items.statement: Maintains FY28 revenue target of INR5,000 crores and will try to improve it.
items.quote: We are still maintaining that. And definitely, we will try to improve it.

items.statement: Confident of meeting INR8,000 crores order inflow target and will try to cross it.
items.quote: We are very hopeful that we should be able to meet the target of INR8,000 crores. We'll in fact, try to cross that cap.

items.statement: Current business inflow at INR2,750 crores, with about INR1,100 crores overseas.
items.quote: With respect to the current business inflow, as of today, we are sitting at INR2,750 crores worth of business and out of which INR1,000 -- around INR1,100 crores is from the overseas and rest is from the domestic segment.

items.statement: Targeting 16% operating margin for the year, may exceed if change orders settle.
items.quote: This year, we are targeting the operating margin of 16%, which we have achieved the last year also. There may be a possibility if we settle the order with our clients, we may achieve more.

items.statement: Confident of maintaining 24-25% segment profit in consultancy.
items.quote: And we are sure to keep 24%, 25% segment profit in the consultancy segment.

items.statement: Expects consultancy to contribute 50-60% of revenue, balance from LSTK Turnkey.
items.quote: In the financial year -- current financial year, we are expecting more than 50%, but definitely, around 50% to 60%, we are still expecting from the consultancy segment and balance will come from the LSTK Turnkey segment.

items.statement: Strategy to keep consultancy business higher due to strong margins.
items.quote: Definitely, it is the strategy of the company to keep consultancy business on higher side since we are having margin -- strong margin in the consultancy segment. So management efforts are always there to grab the consultancy business first.

items.statement: Turnkey segment turnover expected to increase in Q3 and Q4 FY27 as new projects gain momentum.
items.quote: As execution progresses, the Turnkey se gment turnover is expected to increase during third quarter and fourth quarter of financial year '26 -'27 once these projects reaches their planned execution

items.statement: Middle East market grim; new mega projects under hold, but existing projects continue.
items.quote: In the Middle East, the market situation is still very grim. Nothing is stabilized. Still there's not much is happening on the new project side.

items.statement: Secured over INR500 crores business from Middle East in Q1 FY27.
items.quote: Recently, we have received order of more than INR500 crores from the Middle East region itself. In this quarter itself.

items.statement: Coal gasification inquiries increasing after government's INR34,000 crores VGF policy; bidding for feasibility studies.
items.quote: The government -- as soon as the government has revised this policy and they have said that they will be giving gap funding of INR34,000 crores, many inquiries are there with respect to putting up the feasibility study. So we are bidding for th ose ones at this point of time

items.statement: Nuclear segment seeing many inquiries; doing environmental studies for 3 private and 1 government project.
items.quote: So we have seen a lot of inquiries coming from the nuclear side. In fact, we are doing various environmental studies at this point of time. 3 projects we are doing from a private investor. And one is from the government side also, we are doing environmental studies.

items.statement: No write-back of provisions expected; provisions reversed only after defect liability period.
items.quote: No, we are not expecting any write-back of provisions. So all the provisions kept for guarantee and warranty are write-off as per accounting standard and as completion of projects only.

items.statement: No plans to distribute entire cash reserves; investment plans under consideration.
items.quote: Definitely, we are having cash reserves, but certain other investment plans are also under consideration with management. Whenever these plans will be concreted, definitely, we will let you know. But as of now, there is no such plans to distribute the entire reserves to the shareholders.

items.statement: Maintains strong double-digit revenue growth guidance for the year.
items.quote: So, thank you for the wishes and I think , we continue to stay with the guidance that we will deliver strong double-digit growth for the year, starting with the first quarter.

items.statement: India business expected to grow mid-teens, outperforming market by 300-500 bps.
items.quote: I think, our India business is poised to deliver significantly good traction, better than market, at least by 300 -500 basis points. So, we see mid -teens growth continuing for that business.

items.statement: US and international markets expected to grow around single digit.
items.quote: So is our international markets and US being around single-digit growth. So, looking at that, we will still see good growth for the coming year in revenues.

items.statement: Maintains 24% EBITDA margin guidance despite Saro investment increase in second half.
items.quote: So, Saro, there is already certain costs that have started but we will see an increase in the second half of the year. And owing to that meaningful increase that we'll see in the second half, we are still guiding towards the 24% kind of margin.

items.statement: Aims to improve EBITDA margins to 28-30% over five years as branded share rises.
items.quote: But ideally, we would want to be improving our EBITDA margins to 28-30% range as we move closer to the 5-year period.

items.statement: Guides FY27 capex of ₹1,500-₹1,600 crores.
items.quote: So, right now, we are guiding for around ₹1,500-₹1,600 crores capex.

items.statement: Other expenses run rate of ₹1,900-₹2,000 crores per quarter excluding R&D.
items.quote: So, our current run rate of about, you know, ₹1,900-₹2,000 crores, I think that kind of a run rate we should assume as a part of other expenses, excluding R&D on quarterly basis.

items.statement: Branded portfolio share to exceed two-thirds of total revenue over medium term.
items.quote: As our branded business continues to gain scale across markets, we expect their share to exceed two-third of our overall revenue over the medium term.

items.statement: US branded business share to cross 15% by end of year, up from 10%.
items.quote: And as I said, today, it's only 10% of our business and probably by the end of the year, it will cross 15% or more, and we can only see that increasing meaningfully.

items.statement: Saro launch planned for April FY28; first two years investment phase with no significant revenue.
items.quote: So, on Saro, I mean, we are building for next FY28 launch right now, so April launch. And we are investing for that. The first 3 years, I mean, first 2 years will be just a buildup of this, so we won't see any significant revenue in the first year, at large.

items.statement: Saro peak sales potential of $200-$300 million conservatively, $400+ million optimistically.
items.quote: So, as I always said, on a conservative side, we are looking at a $200-$300 million range. And maybe more optimistic, we can cross the $400+ million range.

items.statement: Rolvedon expected run rate of $15-$20 million per quarter starting next quarter.
items.quote: So, I think, we have just begun. So, it seems to be on track. We are looking at around $15-$20 million per quarter run rate.

items.statement: US launches planned between 30 to 40 for the year, including specialty.
items.quote: Between 30 to 40 depending on multiple scenarios, but at least 30+ launches.

items.statement: Consumer Wellness business expected to deliver double-digit growth.
items.quote: Yeah, we are looking at a double-digit growth.

items.statement: US biosimilars meaningful scale-up expected in calendar year 2029.
items.quote: Yeah, US is more like a ‘29 kind of timeline when we will see that business scale up. We will have a couple of products before, but real meaningful scale up will come in the calendar year ‘29.

items.statement: Desidustat China opportunity large but reimbursement approval needed; no meaningful scale factored this year.
items.quote: We have not factored in any meaningful scale in terms of our current year. But as we get experience in terms of it getting reimbursement through, then we can see it importantly doing well.

items.statement: Full-year revenue growth guidance of 15% to 20% and EBITDA margin around 14%
items.quote: We look at overall revenue guidance of around 15% to 20%.

items.statement: Q1 EBITDA margin at 13.5%; full-year margin guidance around 14% with raw material cost pass-through expected over the year
items.quote: The margin guidance for the year is around 14%. You would see that the first quarter has been generally a quarter where there is cost increase around employee cost and so on. But for the full year, we believe that we should be averaging around 14-odd percent.

items.statement: Full-year capex guidance of around INR 100 crores, mostly for Hosur capacity expansion for EV customers
items.quote: This year, we should target around INR100-odd crores. We did about INR110-odd crores last year. This year, again, it should be INR100 crores.

items.statement: Strong order book and pipeline across 2-wheeler and 4-wheeler; new EV model wins with Ather, River, Royal Enfield; capacity expansions by TVS and Hero support growth
items.quote: With a strong order book and pipeline, we are well-positioned to deliver the next phase of growth.

items.statement: LED share in automotive lighting at 63% on value basis; expected to move toward 70% in next 24-30 months as new models shift to LED
items.quote: We think we must -- we should move towards 70% kind of a figure going forward in the next 24 to 30 months towards LED.

items.statement: Raw material cost increased ~80 bps in Q1; pass-through to customers occurs with a lag of a couple of quarters; employee cost up due to minimum wage hikes (35% in Haryana)
items.quote: There is this 80 basis points of raw material cost increase and overall increase, like you mentioned of 120. All of that, we should be able to hopefully pass on and recover over the next few quarters.

items.statement: 4-wheeler business ramp delayed by ~2 quarters; meaningful revenue now expected from FY28; conversion cycles with OEMs taking longer than anticipated
items.quote: What we expected for it to fully materialize in FY27 will spill over in 2028 and which is why we believe that 4-wheeler business at a headline level will still be around 2.5% of our revenue, which is slightly lower.

items.statement: Hands-off detection system POC completed and presented to customers; Light Control Module (LCM) under development with 2-3 OEMs; in-house EMI/EMC lab accelerating validation
items.quote: Hands-off detection is -- POC is being already done, and it is being presented to our -- almost all the customers. And very closely, we are working with them. Other than that, LCM, the light control module, which is very closely we are working with 2 or 3 customers, which will be launched soon.

items.statement: Mercedes prototyping done; samples submitted for testing and validation (1.5-2 years); RFQ for mass production to follow
items.quote: Mercedes prototyping is already being done. The samples we have submitted for their testing and evaluation. This is almost 1.5 year to 2 years time to need for their testing and validation at the vehicle level.

items.statement: Sole supplier for new Ather Konarc model; supplying to River RX02 and Royal Enfield Flying Flea EV; not sole supplier for existing Ather models
items.quote: The project which is being launched, we will be the sole supplier for that model.

items.statement: Yamaha revenue expected to meet full-year target despite Q1 export softness; domestic models R15, XSR, Aerox to recover
items.quote: We hope the time to come, these all models will run good, and we will be achieving the target, which is being required for this year -- financial year.

items.statement: No debt raise planned currently; strong internal accruals and cash (~INR 280 crores) to fund organic/inorganic growth including potential 4-wheeler capex and electronics
items.quote: Given that the internal accruals right now are strong, we'd like to use that. But at some point of time, if this cash is utilized for other organic, inorganic or other electronic-related activities, then we might -- if that is required, we shall absolutely take.

items.statement: Maintains 20% revenue CAGR over FY27 and FY28; no immediate inorganic plans.
items.quote: For the current year, it would be unfair to say that we should be looking at INR 6,000 crore mark because again from INR 4,870 crore, I would say given a two-year horizon, FY 27 and FY 28, it is very safe to presume that we should be able to deliver a 20% CAGR.

items.statement: Able to sustain current Q1 margins for remaining part of the year.
items.quote: On the margin front, I think I can only say that we will be able to sustain these current margins achieved in Q1 for the remaining part of the year as well.

items.statement: Targeting 15.5% to 16% EBITDA margin for FY28, inclusive of other income.
items.quote: If you do the mathematics, it comes out as any number between 15.5% to 16%, which we are targeting for FY 28.

items.statement: Full-year capex guidance around INR 300 crore, including greenfield expansions.
items.quote: The guidance for the full year continues to remain around INR 300 crore, which will include the upcoming greenfield expansions of Mechatronics as well as new plants of IAC division.

items.statement: Order book of INR 1,600 crore; 24% to be executed in FY27, 56% in FY28, 20% in FY29.
items.quote: We are pleased to report a robust order book of INR 1,600 crore, which provides a healthy visibility for the business going forward. Of this order book, approximately 24% is expected to be executed in this FY 27 itself, 56% in FY 28, and the remaining 20% in FY 29.

items.statement: Mechatronics division expected to reach close to INR 1,000 crore top line by FY2030-31.
items.quote: I think, to me, by FY 2030-31, we should definitely be looking at close to INR 1,000 crore top line from Mechatronics division.

items.statement: Mechatronics basket expected to operate at 14-15% EBITDA over next 12-24 months.
items.quote: the intended path is that over the next 12-24 months, the Mechatronics basket will be operating in anywhere between 14-15% EBITDA.

items.statement: Greenfuel normalized operational EBITDA margin expected at 19-20% going forward.
items.quote: Excluding that, the product or the operational margin is at 20% for Q1, and which is expected to hold at similar levels of 19% to 20%-odd way forward for the specific Greenfuel business.

items.statement: Aftermarket expected to grow 15% or upwards, with full-year guidance intact.
items.quote: That’s why I said earlier, I think if we were growing at about 10-12% in the Aftermarket, we are now looking at perhaps 15% or upwards of growth in the Aftermarket.

items.statement: Five new intelligent and connected products launching in 18 to 24 months; first BCM already launched.
items.quote: There are five new products completely new to Lumax Auto Technologies, all in the intelligent and connected and software-driven space, which are being launched in 18 to 24 months. The first such launch has already happened, Body Control Module (BCM).

items.statement: Industry growth rates to reduce significantly in Q3 and Q4 due to high base.
items.quote: However, as we get into Q3 and Q4, for overall as an industry, the growth rates will reduce significantly because last year, post the GST rationalization, H2 was really a very hyper-growth already delivered.

items.statement: 80-90% of plastic commodity inflation realized from OEMs within same quarter.
items.quote: But I would say to a great extent of 80% to 90%, we get the realization within the same quarter.

items.statement: Minority interest expected to remain in 11-13% range going forward.
items.quote: Going forward, this minority interest will remain in similar range between 11-13%-odd, considering the existing structure which is at the present moment.

items.statement: Aims for 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031 and upwards of INR 10,000 crore revenue by FY2031.
items.quote: In the long term, our compass remains our “20.20.20.20 Vision”, aiming for a 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031, inching closer to 20% EBITDA margin over the next 5 to 7 years. And by FY 2031, we aspire to more than double our current revenue base to upwards of INR 10,000 crore, fueled by a blend of organic excellence and strategically inorganic opportunities.

items.statement: Sealing order book with top four OEMs in commercial vehicle space for V2X solutions by end of Q3.
items.quote: Happy to share with you that we are now in the process of sealing the order book with all the top four OEMs in the country in the commercial vehicle space for these solutions, and you will see them coming to the market by the end of Q3.

items.statement: Advanced Plastics division operates between 16-20% EBITDA margin, expected to continue.
items.quote: So, as I said, consolidated Advanced Plastics is at about 16-20%, and we expect that to continue.

items.statement: Cash EBITDA guidance of 3x over next 3 years continues, with revenue CAGR of 16.8%.
items.quote: Our guidance for the next 3 years was 3x of the cash EBITDA, which is obviously built with certain a ssumptions on the organic as well as some of the price corrections which will happen. That guidance continues, and we are moving in the right direction as far as that is

items.statement: Capex plan of Rs. 45,000 Crore over next 3 years; orders worth Rs. 9,100 Crore placed, to be deployed in next 2 quarters or less.
items.quote: On the capex, our guidance continues. We are looking at the Rs. 45,000 Crore for the next 3 years, as we have said. The first quarter, because of the supply chain headwinds, we saw a little bit of a muted Rs. 2,000-odd Crore of the capex spend.

items.statement: Intend to deploy all placed capex over next 2 quarters or less, averaging around 3,500 sites per month.
items.quote: We intend to deploy all of this capex over the next 2 quarters or less. So, the intensity continues. We are looking at deploying roughly around 3,500 sites a month on an average hereon.

items.statement: 3-year targets: sustained net addition, double-digit revenue growth, and 3x cash EBITDA.
items.quote: Our 3-year targets are unambiguous sustained net addition, double-digit revenue growth and 3x on the cash EBITDA.

items.statement: Expects to continue ARPU momentum, slightly better than current Rs. 195.
items.quote: We hope to see that we will continue with the similar trend, a little better than where we are today on the ARPU of Rs. 195 at a blended level.

items.statement: Plans 55,000-57,000 4G sites and 86,000-90,000 5G sites; 4G rollout to finish in 18 months, 5G may extend to third year.
items.quote: If you remember in the 3-year guidance, I had said roughly around 55,000-57,000 sites on 4G and 86,000 to 90,000 sites on 5G. So, we are on the guided trend, we intend to finish our 4G rollout over the next 18-odd months so that we are at par on what our target is in the 17 circles.

items.statement: Upgrading 3-4% of customers every quarter from unlimited voice to data or data to NonStop Hero.
items.quote: We are upgrading, I would say, almost 3-4% customers every quarter. So that's the flavour that I can give at this point in time. That's the whole endeavour on the organic ARPU.

items.statement: Sees no structural challenge in postpaid; net additions positive for 6-8 quarters.
items.quote: Even the net addition for us in postpaid has been consistently positive over the last 6 to 8 quarters, and it's growing. There's no dip that we have seen at all.

items.statement: Q1 seasonal migration from urban to rural; some markets network not in line with expectations, but no structural issue.
items.quote: Quarter 1 typically is a seasonal quarter where we see some customers migrating that from urban to rural market. Those are some of the markets where we feel that our network probably is still not in line with expectations.

items.statement: Raised first tranche of Rs. 6,400 Crore including warrants and debt; in discussions with PSU banks led by SBI.
items.quote: I am happy to share that we have successfully raised our first tranche of funding of Rs. 6,400 Crore including partial proceeds of Rs. 1,183 Cr from warrants and debt proceeds including non- fund based facilities through ECB and Indian private

items.statement: Network cost stable despite rollouts; some inflationary pressure from diesel may impact coming quarters.
items.quote: Having said that, we have seen some inflationary challenges from diesel, etc. So, you might see some impact from that. But overall, I would say we've been able to offset some of the increases with internal efficiency and some of it probably might get reflected in the coming quarters.

items.statement: 5G services live in over 200 cities; over 16,000 5G sites; plans to cover another 200+ cities in next 2 quarters.
items.quote: So, we are now, as we speak, over 16,000 sites in 5G, and we intend to kind of cover another 200-plus cities over the next 2 quarters.

items.statement: ARPU upgrade from 2G to 4G is Rs. 230-240; from unlimited data to NonStop Hero is Rs. 20-35.
items.quote: between a customer who is a 2G to a 4G customer, you typically see an upgrade value of an ARPU of roughly around Rs. 230 to Rs. 240. Between unlimited data customer, which is the quota customer, the way we call it, a 1.5 /day GB customer, when you migra te to a NonStop Hero, which is a truly unlimited you see a delta of Rs. 20 to Rs. 35

items.statement: 66% of customers on smartphones (4G/5G), 34% on 2G, providing upgrade opportunity.
items.quote: So, as I had indicated earlier as well, we have 66% of our customers who are on smartphone between 4G and 5G, and 34% of the customers are on 2G. That's a big mix that we see.

items.statement: Copper tube plant targeted for Q1 FY28, copper rod plant FY28, copper refinery Q3 FY29
items.quote: The downstream of copper facilities are planned to be commissioned in phases, with the copper tube targeted by Quarter 1 FY '28, followed by copper rod plant FY '28 and copper refinery in Quarter 3 FY '29.

items.statement: Total project capital requirement estimated at INR 12,000 crore plus supporting infrastructure
items.quote: And the total capital requirement as per the current estimate would be around close to INR 12,000 crores on the project itself. And additional requirements would be related to the infrastructure, the supporting infrastructure that we have been building.

items.statement: MoUs for 1 million ton copper concentrate secured, targeting 1.5 million ton for full production
items.quote: So, as we speak, today, we are having MoUs of 1 million ton of copper concentrate, and if we go for our 100% production, we will be requiring around 1.5 million or 15 lakh.

items.statement: Standalone material margin improved to 31.9% in Q1 FY27 from 23.5% in Q1 FY26 and 20.4% in Q4 FY26
items.quote: During the quarter, our standalone material margin improved to 31.9%, compared with 23.5% in Q1 FY26 and 20.4% in Q4 FY26.

items.statement: Improved average selling realizations across product portfolio with effective pass-through of higher raw material costs
items.quote: However, improved average selling realizations across our product portfolio, together with effective pass-through of higher raw material costs, supported our material margins and helped sustain profitability.

items.statement: Medium to long-term outlook positive for dyes business supported by steady textile demand and tighter global availability favoring non-China supplies
items.quote: Looking ahead, medium to long-term output for our dyes, dyes intermediate and basic chemical business remains positive, supported by steady textile demand, tighter global availability and sourcing trends for favoring non-China supplies.

items.statement: Targeting 70-75% average capacity utilization in dyes business this year from current 60%
items.quote: So, if the market supports, then from 60% to 70%-75%, at least we want to achieve during this year as an average capacity utilization, Manoj ji.

items.statement: First revenue from copper business expected Q1 FY28 (May-June 2027), commercial by Q2 FY28
items.quote: I think Chugh sir just mentioned it could be somewhere around first quarter, end of first quarter, May, June 2027. So, that would be 2027-2028 financial year. First quarter. Q2 you will get commercial.

items.statement: Financial closure not yet achieved; over 50% debt commitments received, rest in process, targeting completion in next few months
items.quote: A complete financial closure has not been achieved yet. We are there on the debt raising. More than 50% commitments have been received. Rest is in process. And we hope that in the next few months, we should be able to reach the complete financial closure.

items.statement: Debt repayment for copper project to start around 2029 considering moratorium period
items.quote: Because today the company has not done any drawdown on the debt, and considering the moratorium which has been allowed, the debt repayment will start somewhere in 2029, not before that.

items.statement: No dividend declared; Board decision to retain capital for growth projects
items.quote: So, just to answer, the dividend is not being declared and there is no decision of the Board to declare any dividend yet.

items.statement: Previous revenue guidance of INR 20,000-25,000 crore for FY28 no longer holds due to dynamic project timelines
items.quote: Number one, that number is dynamically moving numbers. So, that INR 20,000 crore-INR 25,000 crore of revenue in 2027-2028 doesn't hold. Let me first clarify that.

items.statement: Standalone FY2027 revenue expected to increase 10% to 12%.
items.quote: Looking ahead on a standalone basis, we expect FY 2027 revenue to increase by 10% to 12%.

items.statement: Manufacturing EBIT margins should continue in 12% to 13% range.
items.quote: Margins on the manufacturing business should continue in the range of 12% to 13% and in the projects business should improve slightly within the 5% to 6% range.

items.statement: Board approved INR 502 crores for manufacturing capacity additions, presently under implementation.
items.quote: For the manufacturing ~ ISGEC ~ capacity additions, the total investment approved by the Board is INR 502 crores. So that is presently under implementation

items.statement: Completed expansions have potential to add about INR 1,200 crores annual revenue when fully complete.
items.quote: So, all of these together when fully complete, they have the potential to add a total revenue of about INR 1,200 crores per year when fully complete.

items.statement: Standalone orders in hand as on June 30, 2026 were INR 7,727 crores.
items.quote: Total order booking for the first quarter is INR 2,323 crores and the total standalone orders in hand as on June 30, 2026, are very good at INR 7,727 crores.

items.statement: Consolidated orders in hand as on June 30, 2026 were INR 8,958 crores.
items.quote: The consolidated orders in hand as on 30th June 2026 amounts to INR 8,958 crores.

items.statement: Booked more than INR 750 crores of export orders this quarter.
items.quote: We have booked good orders. This quarter, for example, we booked more than INR 750 crores of orders from export markets.

items.statement: Already booked about INR 1,200 crores orders in Isgec Heavy Engineering standalone in current quarter.
items.quote: During the current quarter, which is the July and until today, we have already booked about INR 1,200 crores orders in Isgec Heavy Engineering on a stand-alone basis.

items.statement: Expects increased level of exports to continue.
items.quote: We expect this increased level of exports to continue.

items.statement: Domestic market is strong across almost all product lines with healthy export inquiries.
items.quote: The domestic market is strong across almost all our product lines, and we have a healthy level of export inquiries from customers across various industries.

items.statement: Export and import logistics costs have increased and transit times lengthened.
items.quote: Export and import logistics costs have increased, and transit times have also lengthened.

items.statement: Cost of some materials risen due to war having small adverse effect on profitability.
items.quote: The cost of some materials which have risen due to war are having a small adverse effect on profitability.

items.statement: Most increased costs expected to be absorbed through normal contingency provisions.
items.quote: Most of the increased costs are expected to be absorbed through normal contingency provisions.

items.statement: Isgec Hitachi Zosen expected to do about 10% better than last year in revenue and profits.
items.quote: Isgec Hitachi Zosen is doing better than last year. It will do about 10% better than last year. Last year, it did about INR 670 crores. This year, it will be doing 10% better and its profits will also be about 10% better.

items.statement: Saraswati Sugar Mills revenue is going to be down.
items.quote: So Sarasw ati Sugar Mills actually produced much less sugar. So Saraswati Sugar Mills' revenue is going to be down

items.statement: Order inflow guidance of INR6,000-8,000 crores for FY27 with INR800 crores already won in Q1 and INR1,800 crores as L1
items.quote: Order inflow will be to the tune of INR6,000 to INR 8,000 crores. We have already got INR800 crores in Q1. We are L1 in around INR1,800 crores. That will materialize in Q2.

items.statement: HAM equity investment requirement: INR179 crores in FY27, INR72 crores each in FY28 and FY29; INR638 crores invested till June 2026
items.quote: So for the coming years, for '26-'27, we will have to invest INR 179 Cr on the existing HAM projects including Bowaichandi project. And for '27-'28 and '28-'29 it would be INR 72 crores each.

items.statement: Revenue expected to grow 10% to 12% in coming quarter with EBITDA margin 9% to 10%
items.value: 10% to 12% revenue growth; 9% to 10% EBITDA margin
items.quote: With healthy volume momentum, expanding channels, disciplined cost management and an improving pricing environment, we remain optimistic about the outlook with revenue expected to grow by 10% to 12% in the coming quarter and EBITDA margin expected to remain in the range of 9% to 10%.

items.statement: Yarn prices on upward trajectory; calibrated pricing approach to translate favorable environment into improved margins
items.quote: Yarn prices are currently on an upward trajectory creating a favorable pricing environment for the company. While competitive intensity remains elevated, we continue to adopt the calibrated pricing approach with the objective of progressively translating the favorable pricing environment into improved utilizations and

items.statement: Price hike of 4% to 5% taken in Q1 but offset by competitive schemes; new rates to be implemented in August with further 4% to 5% hike planned
items.value: 4% to 5% hike taken; further 4% to 5% planned
items.quote: We took a price hike of 4%to 5% in Quarter 1. But that was gradually again transferred to trade because of intensive competition in terms of extra scheme and all. So, probably in the august the new rate will be implemented. And we look for a further price hike of 4% to 5%.

items.statement: Healthy volume traction key driver of 10% revenue growth in Q1; value segment led growth, momentum expected to broaden across segments
items.quote: We started FY27 on a positive note with revenue growing by 10% witnessing steady momentum across the portfolio. Healthy volume traction remained a key driver of growth during the quarter.

items.statement: Thermal segment has sound and healthy order book for FY27; expects better contribution than last year depending on winter
items.quote: For thermals, we have a sound and healthy order book. And we expect that this year thermal will contribute better compared to last year. So, the expectations are high.

items.statement: Advertising and marketing spend at 10.5% of revenue in Q1; to be rationalized to 6%-7% going forward to achieve EBITDA targets
items.quote: During Quarter 1, the advertisement and marketing spend comes to around 10.5% of the total revenue and going forward, the same would be rationalized to 6% to 7%. So, this would help in achieving the desired level of EBITDA.

items.statement: Implementing SAP, AI initiatives, and DMS rollout state-by-state for better inventory control and working capital visibility
items.quote: We are doing lot of initiatives in IT where we have better control on the inventory and we have a better visibility of stocks where it is stuck. So, yes. Better implementation of SAP and all will help us to, better implementation of AI also we are taking few initiatives and all.

items.statement: Building e-commerce infrastructure including warehouse, inventory management, dispatches, IT systems
items.quote: On trade, we see huge potential. So, we have been able to appoint senior heads for the e-commerce business and we are building the right infrastructure for that. So, either it is your warehouse, your inventory management, your dispatches and all. So, your IT, so everything is getting in place.

items.statement: Committed to improving profitability through better product mix, efficient channel management, focused investment in high growth categories, disciplined cost optimization
items.quote: We remain committed towards improving profitability through better product mix, efficient channel management, focused investment in high growth categories and disciplined cost optimization initiatives.

items.statement: ROCE and ROE currently suppressed (~10% and single digits); structural improvement expected as company shifts from wholesale to secondary-driven model with focus on LFS, e-commerce
items.quote: Of course, the ROCE and ROE, whatever you mentioned, is not desirable. But as the industry is going through a very tough time in terms of competitive scenario and all. But we are taking a lot of initiatives in terms of moving completely from wholesale driven market to secondary driven market and all. And focusing on a lot of LF Ss, e-commerce and other channels. So, all these initiatives, we are h

items.statement: Continuous cost efficiency and productivity improvement scope exists; not at maximum cost cutting
items.quote: It's always there. That's a continuous process. So, that we are doing efficiency also we are trying to bring in. A better productivity also we are trying to br ing in. So, that's a continuous process. We won't say it's like we have done our best. But there's always a scope

items.statement: Revised FY27 revenue guidance to INR2,600 crores, with a small chance of crossing it.
items.quote: Guidance, we revised our guidance for FY '27 at INR2,600 crores with a small chance that we may even cross this number.

items.statement: Debottlenecking investments around INR500 million to increase output for FY28.
items.quote: As mentioned above, at the moment, we have sufficient capacity for FY '28 around INR22 billion. Although we will do some debottlenecking with investments around INR500 million.

items.statement: FY27 capex expected at INR50 crores.
items.quote: Nishita: Okay. So, what sort of total capex do we anticipate in FY '27? Nikhil Kumar: INR50 crores.

items.statement: Expects order inflow around INR700 crores per quarter, totaling INR2,800 crores plus for the year.
items.quote: Nikhil Kumar: Yes, we are expecting around INR700 crores per quarter. So, we will be somewhere in between. Nishita: Okay. Per quarter order inflow. Nikhil Kumar: Yes, something like INR2,800 crores plus we'll have for the whole year, order inflow.

items.statement: Will maintain gross contribution margin within tolerable range, with factors like price increases, cost reductions, product mix, and exchange rate gains.
items.quote: But overall, the company will be able to maintain plus/minus within a certain tolerable range, the gross contribution margin which we have guided in the market.

items.statement: Price variation clauses with customers have been implemented where applicable.
items.quote: We have contracts with our customers where we have price variation clauses and wherever we have price variation clauses, those have been implemented, yes.

items.statement: Strong demand forecast from customers, no disruption in order inflow.
items.quote: We don't see any disruption in our order inflow. From the market side also, we see no let up in the demand situation. It's the forecast that we have from our customers is still extraordinarily strong, continues to be so.

items.statement: Railway segment not taking fresh orders, will review sustainability at year-end; capacity to be used for generators and motors.
items.quote: In railways, we are not taking any fresh orders in this segment and we will review the sustainability of this segment at the end of this year. Once the Indian rai lway contract is completed, the production spacing capacity that we have will be used for generator and motor products.

items.statement: No major client additions expected; focus on deepening existing relationships.
items.quote: We don't have any major client additions at the moment. We have a couple of smaller client additions which in the pipeline, which we are hopeful to close in this quarter and of course, all the major clients, major engine makers, major turbine makers, we're already working with them very closely.

items.statement: Turkey subsidiary to execute EUR3-3.5 million orders this year, no big pipeline for next year.
items.quote: We have about EUR3 million, EUR3.5 million worth of orders for execution this year, and we will execute that EUR3.5 million this year. We don't see a big pipeline for business for next year right now, but the Turkey facility still continues to be like an insurance facility in case we have to do major client for service.

items.statement: Service revenue remains around 5-6% of overall sales, growing with sales.
items.quote: So earlier, the proportion used to be 5%, 6%. And now since the sales, it still remains around 5%, 6% of our overall sales. So, the sales are also growing at 30%, 40% per year. So, our service business is also still growing at that rate, keeping the percentage remains the same of our overall business.

items.statement: Working capital to remain in line with current levels.
items.quote: Yes. Actually, working capital will continue to remain on the same line because we see a significant growth from last year to this year and on the current liabilities, yes, there are customer advances and also the provision for taxation because of the increased volume of business.

items.statement: No comments on fundraise; Board meeting on Friday to discuss.
items.quote: I'm not going to be able to talk about any fundraise issues. We have issued a notification to the exchange that we'll be having a Board meeting on Friday and I cannot discuss anything before the Board meeting takes place on Friday.

items.statement: Maintains capex guidance of INR80-100 crores per year, including Dalmia modernization, 4PRO machinery, and maintenance.
items.quote: Actually, the long term of whatever we said, INR80 crores to INR100 crores capex every year, we are maintaining still the same statement. It includes modernization of Dalmia plants, some 4PRO machinery robotic solution and maintenance projects.

items.statement: Expects 7-8% volume growth for FY27, not 9%.
items.quote: I still believe we can deliver 7%-8% volume growth but not 9%. I think it's a bit of stretch but definitely if we can get some good order with the high volumes, why not.

items.statement: Maintains EBITDA margin guidance of 13% for the year.
items.quote: we have given a guidance of 13%. We still remain firm with that guidance.

items.statement: MINPRO JV initial investment of INR35 crores over next 2 years, with 51% from RHI and 49% from Khemka.
items.quote: It is roughly INR35 crores initial investment in next 2 years' time. And we believe EBITDA should be around 8% to 10% and payback period should be less than 3 years or so after production.

items.statement: Magnesite prices increased 6-8% in last 2 months; working to absorb or pass on to customers.
items.quote: So magnesite price has already gone up by 6% to 8% from, last 2 months or so. We are trying to see how we can absorb this and how we can pass on to our end user.

items.statement: Flow control products contribute 35% of total revenue.
items.quote: Just to give you an update Rajesh, 35 percentage is coming from core business, our total revenue. I think that has answered your question...

items.statement: Industry faces competitive intensity, excess capacity, and geopolitical uncertainty.
items.quote: Looking ahead, while the industry continues to face competitive intensity, excess capacity and geopolitical uncertainty, we remain confident in our ability to outperform the underlying market.

items.statement: Demand across key end markets remains healthy; steel and cement showing growth.
items.quote: Encouragingly, demand across all our key end markets remains healthy. In the steel sector, major steel producers reported steady growth in production and volumes aided by strong domestic demand and high-capacity utilization levels.

items.statement: Quartzite mines expected to open by end of this quarter, benefits from next quarter.
items.quote: So we are very close to opening up this mine and now our take is, towards the end of this quarter we should be able to open these mines. So this would definitely give us a solid structural benefit in terms of cost structure. The benefits we expect should start coming up from next quarter.

items.statement: MINPRO production expected to start in Q4 of this financial year.
items.quote: Third one where you wanted to understand MINPRO. What are the expected timelines of this project to start? We are very hopeful. We will be looking somewhere towards the quarter 4 of this financial year to start.

items.statement: Coke oven project at final negotiation stage, production to start next month, lasting 14-16 months.
items.quote: So, coke oven project is almost at the final stage of our negotiation. There's a bit of pricing adjustment, which we are doing with our customer s. So it should be concluded anytime. And we will start the production from next month. So, that project is a long -term project, may be for next 14 to 16 months.

items.statement: Glass group projects at advanced discussion stage, expected in Q3 and Q4 of this year.
items.quote: And the second is glass. Glass group projects are at a very advanced stage of discussion. So, that should also happen in third and fourth quarter of this year.

items.statement: Expects to transfer 4-5 more products from parent to India in about 1 year.
items.quote: Yes, from last few years, we were continuously trying to transfer some technology, some products, which we were not producing in India. So, some are already transferred. Some are in the pipeline. We are working on that. And in maybe 1 year's time, we will have 4 or 5 more products being produced in

items.statement: Export performance reduced from last quarter to this quarter; focus remains on domestic market.
items.quote: Yes. But the current performance, Sahil, it's actually reduced from last quarter to this quarter. So it's actually reducing at the moment for us.

items.statement: Steel sector capex expected INR50,000-60,000 crores this financial year.
items.quote: The way we are looking at the capex announced by a lot of steel companies and their commitment to the capex, I think if I just do a very broad-cut number, not to be exact, but I think steel sector itself would be seeing a capex of not less than INR50,000 crores to INR60,000 crores coming up this financial year.

items.statement: Steel sector grew 7-8% in H1; refractory industry should tag along.
items.quote: We all know, steel is growing very strongly in the country right now. If we look into the numbers, the way Indian steel sector has grown in H1, it was 7-8% growth, so that actually puts us into a very good sweet spot with the growth of our end -consuming industry.

items.statement: North American export orders with combined annual value ~US$10.7M and lifetime value ~US$58.5M remain aligned to revised customer schedules; SOPs expected Q3 FY27 and Q4 FY27
items.quote: Our previously announced 3 orders from a North American engine and genset manufacturer with a combined annual value of approximately US$10.7 million and a lifetime value of approximately US$58.5 million remain aligned to revised customer schedules.

items.statement: New Uttarakhand facility involves investment of ~INR 20 crores, planned closer to customer manufacturing location for logistics and JIT alignment
items.quote: Our new Uttarakhand facility is progressing in line with the customer implementation plan. The project involves an investment of approximately INR 20 crores and has been planned closer to customers' manufacturing location to improve logistics, responsiveness and JIT alignment.

items.statement: Gross profit grew 8% YoY to INR 203.9 crores; impact of premium RM procurement due to geopolitical situation already built into gross profit; steel/aluminium on pass-through basis with no lag impact on gross profit
items.quote: Gross profit for this quarter stood at INR203.9 crores, reflecting year-on-year growth of 8%.

items.statement: Domestic automobile production increased over 22% YoY to 93.6 lakh units in Q1 FY27; PV production grew 16.8% to 14.53 lakh units led by UVs up 21.2%; LCV production rose 20.8% to 1.91 lakh units
items.quote: Overall, industry performance during the quarter reflected broad-based momentum with domestic automobile production increasing over 22% year -on-year to 93.6 lakh units, underscoring strong OEM activity and healthy demand visible across automobile value chain.

items.statement: Secured multiple WLTP replacement business orders from leading PV OEMs; temperature control tube order for leading off-highway equipment manufacturer commenced SOP and ramping up as planned
items.quote: During Q1, we have secured multiple WLTP replacement business orders from leading passenger vehicle OEMs.

items.statement: No formal guidance provided; FY27 growth drivers include full-year benefits of lightweighting orders, ramp-up of additional lightweighting programs, temperature-controlled tube adjacencies, North American export order SOPs, and supportive d
items.quote: we do not provide guidance. But having said that, there are 3 factors of growth, which I also mentioned in my opening

items.statement: Mindful of risks from evolving geopolitical conditions; premium RM procurement impact due to geopolitical situation in April-May already captured in Q1 numbers; situation stabilized in July
items.quote: As we move ahead, the operating environment remains supportive, although we remain mindful of certain risks arising out of evolving geopolitical conditions.

items.statement: Lightweighting addressable portfolio assessed at INR 8,000-9,000 crores over ~5 years; aim to build mid-teen to high-teen percentage share via Donghee technology licensing agreement expanding into subframe and torsion beams
items.quote: Our internal assessment on this portfolio is around 5 years from now, it can be between INR8,000 crores to INR 9,000 crores. And we firmly believe that we can actually build a mid -teen to high-teen percentage share in that portfolio.

items.statement: Chakan 3 lightweighting facility commenced SOP and ramping up per customer schedules; designed with modular capacity linked to confirmed programs and future demand
items.quote: Our Chakan 3 lightweighting facility has commenced SOP and is ramping up in line with customer schedules.

items.statement: Purem JV program started Q4 FY26 and will gradually ramp up during FY27; JV provides access to advanced CV technologies above 4L; evaluating options to participate more deeply
items.quote: That program is concerned, it started in Q4 last year and it will gradually ramp up during the course of FY27.

items.statement: Filed 2 additional patents in Q1 FY27, total filings 24 with 4 awarded; R&D supporting WLTP, Euro-7 benchmarking, hybrid solutions, flex fuel readiness, temperature control tubes, lightweighting localization
items.quote: During Q1 FY2 7, we filed 2 additional patents. This takes the total number of patents filing to 24 with 4 patents awarded.

items.statement: Expecting to reach INR100 crore quarterly revenue by Q4 FY27, implying INR400 crore annualized top line
