items.statement: PAT margin for FY27 will be less than previously guided 16% to 18%.
items.quote: I told you that will be lesser. Now depending upon the seasonality, if my plant performs because it is on the seasonality, but it will be less compared to what it wa s earlier

items.statement: Full benefit of newly commissioned plants expected in FY28.
items.quote: H2 will be covering a portion of it. But full-fledged, the benefit of the plant, you can see in '27, '28.

items.statement: IPP segment revenue expected upwards of INR1,000 crore next financial year.
items.quote: Next financial year, I can tell you that you can enjoy and more INR1,0 00 crore. INR1,000 is a very conservative number, I would say it will be upwards of INR1,000 crore I'm saying

items.statement: Sun Drops expected to cross INR1,500 crore top line this year.
items.quote: And Sun Drops, I think this year on the IPP and the CPP side, if I look at, we will cross INR1,500-odd crore of top line in this year.

items.statement: CPP order book approximately INR5,000-plus crore.
items.quote: And the CPP also, I have an order book of approx imately INR5,000-plus crore. So going forward, there is enough order book in hand for the CPP side and the IPP revenue also, as I told in my initial talk that the IPP segment from here will show a be tter strong upward trajectory

items.statement: Total investment may go upwards of INR5,000-6,000 crore in FY27, FY28.
items.quote: We are still capitalizing the assets and everything. The total investment migh t go upwards of INR5,000 - 6,000 crore in the asset side as we go forward in '27, '28 . But it will go in a phase- wise manner

items.statement: IPP business gives EBITDA margin of 85% to 90%.
items.quote: I can tell you my IP business gives me an EBITDA of 85% to 90%. Post EBITDA, there are not too much of cost. So it's depreciation and interest cost.

items.statement: Geopolitical conditions impacted costs; some absorbed and some passed on to customers.
items.quote: We have absorbed some portion of that and some port ion we have passed on to the customers. So that has been a factor for us

items.statement: IPP unit generation grew nearly 4x year-on-year in Q1 FY27.
items.quote: It is also worth noting that our Q 1 FY27 unit generation under the IPP portfolio has grown nearly 4x year-on-year and the generation achieved in this single quarter already exc eeds 65% of the entire FY26 generation

items.statement: Aims to maintain IPP at around 20% of total revenue mix.
items.quote: As we have earlier in our con-calls also said that we will try to maintain IPP at a level of 20-odd percent of the total revenue mix. The reason is that this is a long-term revenue, and it's a very strong revenue.

items.statement: Geopolitical conditions impacting costs of cables, steel, logistics, ROW.
items.quote: If you understand geopolitical conditions, the major impact is from the fuel. Now you understand that a lot of components goes into a solar plant. You have cables, you have steel, you have other ROW issues, you have logistics.

items.statement: India's first externally credit enhanced green bond of INR670 crore listed.
items.quote: We continue to build on the successful listing of India's first externally credit enhanced green bond of INR670 crore, a 5-year instrument carrying 8.50 coupon with quarterly amortization backed by 65% partial guarantee from GuarantCo and which is AA+ rated by CRISIL and ICRA.

items.statement: Portfolio reached approximately 6.94 gigawatts as of June 30, 2026.
items.quote: As of June 30, 2026, our portfolio has reached approximately 6.94 gigawatts, up 71% year-on- year from 4.06 gigawatt a year ago. This comprises an installed capa city of 1.87 gigawatt and work in progress capacity of 5.07 gigawatts

items.statement: Annual interest cost for full year FY27, FY28 around INR450-odd crore.
items.quote: Annual interest cost would be at around our rate of interest is at 8.5% or som ething. So if I calculate 8.5 around INR450-odd crore should be the total full -- my capacity of INR5,000-odd crore of debt and something coming into picture

items.statement: Debt to equity expected to be comfortable at 3:1 max long-term debt to net worth.
items.quote: So going forward, I think the debt to equity will be in the comfortable position of 3:1 max to max, which will be long-term debt to net worth.

items.statement: Spencer's online business full-year cumulative growth expected to steady around 25%
items.quote: we'll see growth rates -- full year cumulative growth rates on that business, which will steady at around 25% as far as the online business is concerned.

items.statement: Spencer's offline business growth expected at mid to high single digits
items.quote: I think on the offline business, it will probably be mid to high single digits on the Spencer's offline business.

items.statement: Nature's Basket expected to show early double-digit growth from Q3/Q4 FY27 after reset
items.quote: I would say from quarter 3, quarter 4, we will start seeing early double-digit growth as far as Natures Basket is concerned once we finish the whole reset and the optimization.

items.statement: Consolidated 13% year-on-year sales growth expected to sustain through FY27 with steady margins and controlled expenses
items.quote: I think we will be able to sustain this through the year. And with steady margins, controlled operating expenses, we will see the full flow-through of it as far as the EBITDA is concerned.

items.statement: Internal target for Spencer's sales per square foot to reach Rs. 2,000 in festive quarter
items.quote: I would set the target as reaching to Rs. 2,000 SPSF in the festive quarter, and that is the internal target.

items.statement: Spencer's store EBITDA target of 7.5% to 8% remains, progress made from 2.5% range
items.quote: We are making good progress towards what we have publicly stated our short-term aspiration of reaching to about 7.5% to 8% store EBITDA.

items.statement: No new store openings for Nature's Basket in FY27; capex focused on store refurbishment
items.quote: We will not see new store openings because we believe we have a decent concentration and a presence of stores. In fact, we will be putting in a little bit of money in terms of refurbishing some of our stores of Natures Basket.

items.statement: Spencer's store additions in FY27 limited to relocations and a few cluster stores; calibrated expansion planned for FY28
items.quote: No, not in this fiscal, we are not ad ding. I mean it's not a large plan. I mean we are opening -- so what we are doing is we are opening stores where we have to kind of relocate a few stores, plus we are trying a couple of stores within existing clusters

items.statement: Spencer's margins steady at 19% like-for-like; EBITDA Rs. 18 crores (4.4% of sales) vs Rs. 15 crores last year
items.quote: Margins were steady. If you see, it will probably be 18.2% versus 19.1%, but this difference is attributable to an accounting treatment of our membership. If I look for like-for-like, margins are steady at 19%.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA doubled to Rs. 9.4 crores (2% of sales) from Rs. 4.7 crores (1% of sales) YoY
items.quote: EBITDA at a consolidated level for the quarter was Rs. 9.4 crores, which is roughly 2% of sales versus Rs. 4.7 crores or 1% of sales in quarter 1 of last year.

items.statement: Spencer's delivered 8th consecutive month of YoY growth; 18% YoY and 8% QoQ growth in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Spencer's had a quarterly growth of 18% year-on-year and 8% versus quarter 4 of the last year.

items.statement: Spencer's category mix stable; staples and liquor up 100 bps each, non-food down 100 bps, fresh flat
items.quote: Staples has gone up by 100 basis points. Fresh has been the same level. So, it's neither gone up or down. Our contribution, we sell liquor. Liquor has gone up by 100 basis points. And our non -food portfolio which is apparel, E&E and GM has kind of gone down by 100 basis

items.statement: Nature's Basket turnaround depends on execution of inventory availability, assortment focus, and online scale-up in 2 cities
items.quote: We've had a change in management at Nature s Basket about 45 days ago, and we've kind of drawn u p a complete reset plan, where fundamentally we're changing nothing. It's -- the proposition remains the same. It is just about disciplined, sharper focused execution

items.statement: Debt refinancing process started; expected to conclude this month
items.quote: The process has started and it will kind of in the next -- in this month itself, we will get some.

items.statement: Consolidated debt at Rs. 1,266 crores (SRL Rs. 1,019 crores, NBL Rs. 237 crores)
items.quote: So, at a consol level, we have a total debt of Rs. 1,266 crores, SRL is Rs. 1,019 and NBL is Rs. 237.

items.statement: Targeting work orders of around INR 20,000 crore this year, with INR 5,000 crore already received in Q1.
items.quote: The company is targeting work orders of around INR 20,000 crore during this year , in addition to the existing order book , out of which approximately INR 5,000 crore has already been received during Q1.

items.statement: Expects top line to grow around 15% and bottom line by approximately 15-20%.
items.quote: Further, the company expects its top line to grow by around 15%, while the bottom line is projected to increase by approximately 15 -20%, reflecting continued business momentu m and a positive growth outlook.

items.statement: Order inflow in Q1 was INR 5,417 crore; total order book as on June 30, 2026 was INR 93,492 crore.
items.value: INR 5,417 crore inflow; INR 93,492 crore order book
items.quote: During the quarter ended April to June 2026, the order inflow stood at INR 5,417 crore. As on June 30, 2026, the company’s total order book is stood at an impressive INR 93,492 crore.

items.statement: Order book split: railways INR 58,000 crore, S&P INR 12,000 crore, ports/roads/highways INR 3,651 crore, metros INR 5,700 crore, power/transmission INR 4,000 crore, hydro/irrigation INR 1,626 crore.
items.value: INR 58,000 crore; INR 12,000 crore; INR 3,651 crore; INR 5,700 crore; INR 4,000 crore; INR 1,626 crore
items.quote: Order book is primarily driven by railways with INR 58,000 crore, followed by S&P at INR 12,000 crores, ports, roads and highways at INR 3,651 crores, metros at INR 5,700 crores, power and transmission at INR 4,000 crores, and hydro and irrigation projects at INR 1,626 crore.

items.statement: Bidding works margins 5-6% in India, management works 8-10%, PMC works about 7%, overseas expected 15-20%.
items.quote: For the last two quarters, we are focusing on the works which give us better margins, and those margins are more than 5-6% for the bidding works. And for management, it is from 8-10%. For PMC work, which we have got from PSU is almost 7%.

items.statement: Expects EBITDA of 5-7% over the next three years.
items.quote: We are expecting an EBITDA of 5-7%.

items.statement: Hopes order book will be equally divided 50-50 between railway management works and bidding works in next three years.
items.quote: We are hoping that in next three years, our order boo k will be equally divided 50 -50% between railway management works and bidding works. So that is how the order book will evolve in next three years.

items.statement: In Q1, almost 63% of revenue was from management works, remainder from bidding or PMC.
items.quote: If you see our Q1 results, almost 60% of the revenue /top line is from the management work, which is almost 63% is from management, and remaining is from the bidding or PMC.

items.statement: Focusing heavily on port, hydro, highway and green energy sectors, expecting good orders in coming quarter.
items.quote: Right now, we are focusing heavily on port sector, hydro, and highway. So, these are the three sectors , and plus green energy also. These are the four sectors we are focusing and expecting good orders in coming quarter.

items.statement: Geopolitical situation, labor availability and client payments are key challenges faced.
items.quote: Definitely. As you know, the present geopolitical situation is a challenge that we faced during Q1 also. And if the similar situation persists, this is a big challenge for us.

items.statement: Most contracts covered by price variation, so inflation impact is limited though some impact remains.
items.quote: Vishal, generally, all the contracts are covered by price variation, which generally covers the price inflation. So, I think it does not have a very big impact, though some impact is always there.

items.statement: Not looking for debt; managing from internal resources, with bank working capital lines at 5.5-5.9% if needed.
items.quote: Currently, we are not looking for any debt from other sources. We are able to maintain from our internal resources only, but we have our working arrangement s with some banks for working capital if required.

items.statement: Dividend policy follows DIPAM guidelines: 30% of PAT or 4% of net worth, whichever is higher.
items.value: 30% of PAT or 4% of net worth
items.quote: We generally follow DIPAM guidelines, which is 30% of the PAT or 4% of the net worth, whichever is higher. So, we'll give that dividend.

items.statement: Onerous project provisions completed; no further loss provisions anticipated.
items.quote: So, we have already provisioned for the onerous project, and we are not anticipating any further provision of the losses.

items.statement: Railway outstanding receivables currently almost INR 2,500 crore, with payments received monthly within 30 days.
items.quote: No. This is actually railway receivable or outstanding is a dynamic process. And presently, our outstanding railway is almost INR 2,500 crores.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth expected to be lower single-digit
items.quote: We are expecting that Q3 and Q4 will be better , so it will be lower single-digit kind of growth this year.

items.statement: Annual capex of INR 100 crores across Sandila and Hamirpur facilities
items.quote: Every year we are doing a capex of about INR 100 crores at Sandila and Hamirpur together.

items.statement: Hamirpur facility capex of INR 70-100 crores per year
items.quote: The capex we already told that we are doing a capex of INR 70 crores to INR 100 crores per year at Hamirpur facility

items.statement: Sustainable EBITDA margin target of 18% over 2-3 years
items.quote: In 2 to 3 years the margin, again we said that we would be trying to maintain around 18%.

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin expected to sustain at 15-16%
items.quote: Sir, we feel that we should be able to get around 18%. 18% if things go alright otherwise at least 15%, 16% we should be able to continue on a sustainable basis.

items.statement: EU fungicide TEQ approval to add INR 30-40 crores revenue
items.quote: at least we feel that we should be able to get another INR 30 crores, INR 40 crores of revenue from this molecule in European Union in addition to what we are already doing.

items.statement: Domestic demand subdued due to erratic monsoon impacting paddy herbicide sales
items.quote: During the quarter, the industry continued to experience subdued demand conditions, particularly in paddy and other crop protection segments.

items.statement: New fungicide production at Sandila targeting 2,000 tons capacity from 4,000-5,000 tons import market
items.quote: the import what we saw from the data last year, it is around 4,000 tons to 5,000 tons and we should be able to get from this at least 2,000 tons of our capacity.

items.statement: Three new products planned for FY27 including fungicide and herbicide at Hamirpur
items.quote: Yes, 3. Including what we already produced, 3 products.

items.statement: Chinese imports at lower prices creating competitive pressure
items.quote: Chinese products are coming at relatively much lower prices. So we are trying to improve our operational efficiency and trying to compete with Chinese imports

items.statement: Hamirpur facility to reach INR 1,000 crores revenue in 3-4 years with 8-10 blocks
items.quote: Overall potential, sir, when we put up roughly 8 to 10 blocks, we comfortably should get almost INR 1,000 crores from our Hamirpur facility. It will take three to four years from now.

items.statement: Sandila facility targeting INR 1,000 crores revenue in 4 years with 5 blocks
items.quote: with this cumulatively, we feel we should be able to get at least INR 1,000 crores in coming four years.

items.statement: Expect improvement in Q3-Q4 FY27 as season starts
items.quote: We are expecting that Q3 and Q4 will be better

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 15.4% impacted by lower volumes, higher employee and fuel costs
items.quote: The margin moderati on was primarily due to lower sales volume, higher employee cost and increased fuel expenses during the quarter

items.statement: Inventory days increased to 200 from 170, expected to normalize to 170 by Q3
items.quote: Inventory days have gone up from 170 days to around 200 days. They will come down in Q3 to around 170 days.

items.statement: Expect to submit operational readiness to RBI by end of Q4 FY27 for SFB transition
items.quote: We continue to expect that all required milestones will be completed within the prescribed 18-month timeline, and we remain on course to submit our readiness to the Reserve Bank of India by end of Quarter 4 FY27.

items.statement: Technology stack for end-to-end customer loan journey expected ready by Feb 2027
items.quote: Technology stack for the end-to-end customer loan journey is under development and is expected to be ready by Feb '27.

items.statement: B2B UPI P2M segment relaunch tentatively in Q4 FY27 depending on ecosystem developments
items.quote: We are preparing to relaunch our high-growth B2B UPI P2M segment. However, this would depend on the ecosystem and other developments, which could result in the relaunch tentatively in Quarter 4 FY27.

items.statement: Expect net revenue margins to be higher than last year with retail focus enhancing
items.quote: With retail focus enhancing, our margins are expected to be higher as compared to last year.

items.statement: Expect NIMs in range of 8% to 9% for SFB, highest in industry
items.quote: So from an SFB perspective, with the kind of asset products which we are looking at, we expect our NIMs, and that may not answer your ROE question fully, but at least NIMs, which is highest in the industry, which we are looking at anywhere in the range of 8% to 9%.

items.statement: Expect blended portfolio yield of around 14% for secured lending portfolio
items.quote: And second, what we are looking at is 90% secured book of lending for our SFB portfolio with an average portfolio yield of around 14%.

items.statement: Expect cost of funds advantage of approximately 300 basis points vs other SFBs
items.quote: Our cost of funds further strengthens our liability franchise as we expect this to translate in approximately 300 basis points advantage as compared to other small finance banks in future.

items.statement: Anticipate INR 10 crores SFB-related opex burn in FY27 P&L including hiring and related costs
items.quote: So, in terms of the burden on opex this year, we are anticipating anything around INR10 crores on this year's P&L in terms of the SFB opex which includes hiring, which includes all the other related opex for the bank.

items.statement: Referral loan disbursements surged 214% YoY to INR 628 crores in Q1 FY27, nearly 50% of FY26 total
items.quote: Referral loan disbursals surged 214% on year-on-year to INR 628 crores, nearly 50% of the total disbursals in FY26, indicating growing demand for credit in our banking ecosystem and our target customer segment.

items.statement: Net revenue margin expanded to highest quarterly value of 42.8%, up 275 bps sequentially and 925 bps YoY
items.quote: One of the key highlights for the quarter was a continued improvement in our net revenue margin. Despite lower revenues, our net revenue margin expanded to its highest quarterly value of 42.8%, improving 275 basis points sequentially and 925 basis points year-on-year.

items.statement: Digitally active customers grew 22% YoY to 64.6 lakhs; FinoPay app customers grew 38% to 8.4 lakhs
items.quote: Digitally active customer s increased by 22% year -on-year to 64.6 lakhs, while active FinoPay, which is our app customers, grew even faster at 38% to 8.4 lakhs

items.statement: CASA contribution to revenue increased from 45% in Q4 FY26 to 54% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: CASA increased its contribution to the revenue from 45% in Q4 FY26 to 54% in the current quarter, reflecting the growing strength of our liability franchise.

items.statement: B2B UPI P2M business paused for recalibration after Feb '26 event; will take at least next couple of quarters for relaunch
items.quote: Besides the event of Feb '26, one of our most profitable B2B business has been paused for recalibration, and it will take at least next couple of quarters for the relaunch.

items.statement: BC business must be restructured or sold as SFB cannot carry out BC activities for other banks per RBI regulation
items.quote: By virtue of the regulation, a small finance bank cannot carry out BC activities for other banks. So that is one of the prescribed stipulation, which is there by virtue of the small finance bank license.

items.statement: Plan to open 40 new branches in Year 1 of SFB operations to enhance term deposit accretion
items.quote: We intend to open in year 1, 40 new branches as well, and that is part of our plan as well.

items.statement: Senior leadership for SFB identified, expected to join by end of calendar year (September-October)
items.quote: Individuals for key leadership positions have been identified, and we expect these senior executives to join us by end of the calendar year.

items.statement: Confident of achieving revenue target of Rs. 1,000 crores by FY27.
items.quote: In summary, we would like to reiterate that our trajectory towards the Rs. 1,000 crores revenue by FY '27 remains firmly on track, supported by a robust product pipeline and a sustained demand across key therapeutic segments including anesthetics, anti-diabetics, anti-anxiety, vitamins, and ADHD.

items.statement: Confident of EBITDA margin guidance of 33% to 35%.
items.quote: We remain confident of our guidance of EBITDA margins in the range of 33% to 35%.

items.statement: Total capex earmarked for Patalganga Phase-1 is around Rs. 200 crores.
items.quote: The total CapEx earmarked for this facility is around Rs. 200 crores for Phase-1.

items.statement: Two new anesthetic liquid inhalation products launched in Q2 FY27 from Ambernath.
items.quote: We launched two new anesthetic liquid inhalation products in Q2 FY '27 from our Ambernath facility and we expect them to scale up over the coming quarters.

items.statement: Contrast media products expected to launch in H2 FY27.
items.quote: We expect the products to be launched in H2 FY '27.

items.statement: Water shortage caused deferment of sales of around Rs. 35 crores.
items.quote: Demand remained strong during the quarter, but water shortages led to a deferment of sales of around Rs. 35 crores.

items.statement: Solar power policy change increased fuel and power costs, impacting EBITDA by Rs. 8 crores.
items.quote: Second, Maharashtra government changed the solar power policy, which led to increased fuel and power costs during the quarter. This alone had an impact of Rs. 8 crores at EBITDA levels.

items.statement: Will pass on increased power prices and reduced ToD hours to customers.
items.quote: See, on the other part, whatever it is, the increase in the prices or due to what do you call reduction in ToD hours, that we will be passing it on to our customers.

items.statement: Annual maintenance shutdown for Blocks A to D in August will be phased, not impacting Q2 FY27 production.
items.quote: Furthermore, we would like to highlight that we have revisited our earlier plan to undertake the annual maintenance shutdown for Blocks A to D in August, and we believe that we can undertake the maintenance in a phased manner instead of a complete shutdown. Hence, it will not impact our Q2 FY '27's production in any major way.

items.statement: EU audit at Ambernath facility scheduled for second half of November.
items.quote: So, we have already received the dates for audit from EU at Ambernath facility. The audit is scheduled for the second half of November.

items.statement: Expect to sign term sheet for large anesthetic CDMO contract next quarter.
items.quote: We have made good progress specifically on one of the large anesthetic CDMO contract that we are looking at. We are very close to signing a term sheet. So, hopefully in the next quarter, we will be able to announce something good.

items.statement: Expect CEP for anesthetic API between October to November this year.
items.quote: We have also filed for the CEP, and we are expecting the CEP also to be received somewhere between October to November of this year, which will further boost the sales of those products in regulated markets like Europe.

items.statement: Block F work to start in next couple of quarters.
items.quote: We haven't started it yet. We will be starting it in next couple of quarters.

items.statement: Ambernath depreciation expected Rs. 14-15 crores; overall depreciation Rs. 35-40 crores.
items.value: Rs. 14 crores to Rs. 15 crores; Rs. 35 crores to Rs. 40 crores
items.quote: Ambernath alone I think would contribute somewhere around Rs. 14 crores to Rs. 15 crores on depreciation. So, that you can add up to a regular I think should be somewhere around nearing to Rs. 35 crores to Rs. 40 crores should be the overall depreciation.

items.statement: Closing inventory around Rs. 230-240 crores; to be liquidated over next three to four quarters.
items.quote: Somewhere around Rs. 230 crores to Rs. 240 crores. It is on the higher side. Since the last quarter, we had planned for taking the maintenance, so we had started building up the inventory. Now that we are revisiting that, we have to now start slowly liquidating the inventory.

items.statement: Cash reserves around Rs. 150 crores in FDs and mutual funds.
items.quote: Cash reserves. See, we have around Rs. 150 crores in FDs and mutual funds.

items.statement: Expect shipments to South Africa to start sometime next year (April 2028 to March 2029)
items.quote: Directionally, I can tell you, sometime next year, which means from April 28 to March of 29, we are expecting shipments to start to South Africa.

items.statement: LCV manual transmission commercialization expected next year (FY29) as beachhead contract
items.quote: Around the same time, we are looking forward to commercializing an LCV manual transmission.

items.statement: Automatic transmission programs earliest revenue in second half of 2028
items.quote: As far as automatics are concerned, the earliest now that we see is second half of 28.

items.statement: US manufacturing plant (Project Mayflower) targeting commissioning in second half of Calendar 2028
items.quote: Yes, right now, the thinking is that we will do this in the second half of Calendar '28, the earliest.

items.statement: First phase US facility investment estimated at approximately $5 million
items.quote: But the figure that we are looking at is about $5 million in the first phase.

items.statement: Indonesia transfer case contract of 70,000 units over 10-12 months, ~30% dispatched in Q1
items.quote: The Indonesia order through our OEM customers in India is a kind of export order because 70,000 of our transfer cases are going to land up in Indonesia in the next 10 to 12 months.

items.statement: More than 50% of Indonesia transfer case business has potential to become recurring
items.quote: More than 50% of the business has the potential to become recurring in nature.

items.statement: Internal target to sustain EBITDA margins of 20% to 22% and above
items.quote: My proposition to you is if I can sustain 20% to 22% and above, I think that is a very fair offering we are giving you.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin at 29.4% driven by favorable mix, exports, and 4x4 product margins
items.quote: EBITDA margin improved to 29.4% compared to 24.9% in Q1 of FY '26 and 24.5% in Q4 of FY '26, supported by a favourable product mix, higher contributions from exports, and better margins from the 4x4 products.

items.statement: EV transmission schedules uplift to Rs 10-12 crores per quarter for next three quarters from prior Rs 7-8 crores
items.quote: We were averaging 6.5, let's say, 7 to 8 crores a quarter on the EV products. Our forecasts now are in the region of 10 to 12.

items.statement: Export revenue ~Rs 23 crores in Q1 FY27 (annualized ~Rs 92 crores), all exclusive contracts
items.quote: In absolute terms, the export has grown, I think it is almost Rs. 34 crores and for the quarter, it is around Rs. 23 crores. If you annualize it, you can see it is Rs. 92 crores.

items.statement: Transfer case revenue Rs 76 crores in Q1 FY27 (93% YoY growth), 53% of total revenue
items.quote: The transfer case segment delivered strong growth during the quarter, with revenue increasing 93% year-on-year to Rs. 76 crores compared to Rs. 39.3 crores in Q1 of FY '26.

items.statement: Component segment revenue Rs 34.4 crores in Q1 FY27 (83% YoY growth) driven by precision components and exports
items.quote: The component segment continued its strong performance, with revenue increasing 83% year-on-year to Rs. 34.4 crores compared to Rs. 18.8 crores in Q1 of FY '26.

items.statement: Execution bandwidth challenged by multiple simultaneous growth opportunities
items.quote: What's interesting is that the development of these opportunities is coming all together. So, the opportunity also therefore presents challenges in terms of execution bandwidth. And that is what continues to preoccupy us.

items.statement: New transfer case assembly line at Shirwal targeting 400 units/day (~120,000/year) with German automation
items.quote: I believe we will have capacity on that line of 400 a day, about 120,000 a year on that new line, which will go into our Shirwal facility.

items.statement: Automatic transmission programs expected to deliver INR 300-400 crores revenue potential
items.quote: We think that automatic transmission programs at a minimum will deliver INR 300 crores to INR 400 crores.

items.statement: Opening order book for FY27 was over INR300 crores; delivered more than 20% in Q1, remaining INR256.8 crores to be delivered by Q3
items.quote: We entered FY27 with an opening order book of more than INR300 crores, and our priority for the year is conversion of the opening order book into revenue. We delivered more than 20% of the same in the first quarter.

items.statement: Order book as of June 30, 2026 stood at approximately INR256.8 crores; plan to execute and deliver by Q3
items.quote: Our order book as idea of June 30, 2026, stood at approximately INR256.8 crores. We plan to execute and deliver this order book by Q3

items.statement: Blended gross margin for FY27 expected to hover between 50% and 55% range
items.quote: for this year, our blended gross margin would likely hover between a 50%, 55% range.

items.statement: No specific capex plan beyond regular product development; can scale from single shift to three shifts in existing space
items.quote: Right now, we do not have a capex plan other than our regular product developmental efforts that will continue in pushing the boundaries for our continued programs that are already there.

items.statement: Raised INR500 crores via QIP; received Letter of Intent for up to INR151 crores from Technology Development Board for YETI under RDI scheme
items.quote: We completed a qualified institutional placement raising INR500 crores with participation from marquee domestic and global institutional investors.

items.statement: Received Letter of Intent for financial assistance of up to INR151 crores for YETI under Government of India's RDI Scheme
items.quote: Separately, we received a Letter of Intent for assistance of up to INR151 crores from the Technology Development Board for the advancement of our YETI program under the Government of India's RDI scheme.

items.statement: INR20,000 crores drone procurement under Fast Track mode announced; one opportunity in RFP stage, others in approval pipeline with RFPs expected in H2
items.quote: Public reports of INR20,000 crores of drone procurement under the fast-track procurement route from the Indian Army are now seeing the light of the day with one opportunity in the RFP stage, others remain in the approval pipeline with the expectation of RFPs in the second half of the year.

items.statement: Defense Acquisition Council cleared capital acquisition proposals worth INR52,000 crores including jet-based kamikaze drone and naval shipborne UAS
items.quote: Further, the Defense Acquisition Council has cleared capital acquisition proposals worth INR52,000 crores, including a jet-based kamikaze drone system and a naval shipborne unmanned aerial system.

items.statement: Ministry of Defense nearly doubled operational procurement limits for field commanders; expect accelerated procurement in Q3 and Q4
items.quote: On the revenue procurement front, the Indian Ministry of Defense has nearly doubled the operational procurement limits for field commanders of Indian defense forces through revision of the delegation of Financial Powers to Defense Services 2026.

items.statement: Q1 revenue mix was 60% defense, 40% civil vs usual 70-30; defense has higher margin due to EW resilience requirements
items.quote: if you see the product mix was more see our usual product mix, like, for example, last year was 70-30. And this quarter, it was 60-40, which is the kind of variation that happens in our business because of what we deliver in a specific quarter.

items.statement: Supply chain pressure on thermal cameras and electronic components causing timeline delays; reviewing closely to meet customer timelines
items.quote: So, due to the current ongoing geopolitical conflicts, there is a pressure on the supply chain of thermal cameras and the electronic supply chain also is seeing a certain pressure where the timeline delays are happening.

items.statement: Expect more outcomes from revenue and run-rate programs in FY27; some fast-track procurement outcomes may slip to FY28, a couple may close in FY27
items.quote: In terms of the programs around fast track procurement, some of them as they get to RFP towards the end of the year, we will see a slip into FY28 for some of them. For at least a couple of them, we expect that the outcomes may happen within this year itself.

items.statement: YETI designed for 6,500m takeoff altitude carrying up to 200kg; range 50km at max payload, up to 200km at 50kg payload
items.quote: YETI, in my opinion, is the only platform in the world from whatever we have searched that is designed to take off at 6,500 meters takeoff altitude.

items.statement: Participated in RFP for hybrid variant of ZOLT platform; will continue pursuing combat drone opportunities
items.quote: So, this one particularly is centered around the hybrid variant of our ZOLT platform. And yes, we have participated in it. And we are also going to continue to put efforts towards participating in any combat-related platforms as well that come through.

items.statement: Indigenization level: roughly 20-22% of revenue is import substitute; international content across product line is 60-65%
items.quote: So roughly about, you can say, 20%, 22% of our revenue is an import substitute. And you can say our international content across our product line is roughly about 60% to 65%.

items.statement: Deployed UAV fleet crossed 1 million customer missions; an ideaForge drone takes off every 2 minutes globally
items.quote: I'm elated to share that during the quarter; our deployed fleet crossed the milestone of 1 million customer missions. Across our fleet today an ideaForge drone takes off somewhere in the world every 2 minutes.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth guided at 20%+ with potential for 25%+, implying revenue above INR10,000 crores vs INR8,430 crores in FY26; guidance to be revisited after Q3
items.quote: We believe that after Q3 we will be in a better position to give any revised guidance. For now, you may look at our guidance as 20%+ and perhaps 25%+, depending on how the rest of the year averages out.

items.statement: Added 3 COCO stores, 4 franchise stores and 1 Sennes showroom in Q1; plan 12-15 more stores in remainder of FY27, majority franchise, focused on East and North India
items.quote: The company remains on track to open another 12 to 15 stores during the remainder of the financial year, and these are very much in the pipeline.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 7% (INR213 crores) vs sustainable guidance 7.5%-7.8%; Q1 FY26 reported 10.1% included 1.5%-2% inventory gains; adjusted PAT Q1 FY26 ~INR70-75 crores vs INR101 crores this quarter
items.quote: We have maintained the same guidance with the Q1 results this year. Therefor e, we consider the quarter's 7% EBITDA margin and INR213 crores of EBITDA to be a good outcome

items.statement: Customs duty gain estimated at INR12-15 crores in Q1 on ~45 days impact; further benefit expected over next 2-3 quarters; partly offset by customer schemes and discounts
items.quote: We estimate that the customs-duty gain in Q1 was around INR12-15 crores. This benefit will be partly offset by customer schemes, discounts and other promotional measures.

items.statement: July and August sales tracking ~25% YoY growth and 8-10% above May-June run rate; Q2 seasonally softer but planning quarter for festive season
items.quote: Compared with last year, July is also showing growth of about 25%.

items.statement: Diamond jewellery sales +43% value, +18% volume; shift to lightweight, design-led, lower-ticket jewellery; 9-carat and 14-carat assortment expanded; old gold exchange 43% of sales quantity
items.quote: We must mention that diamond jewellery sales increased by almost 43% in value and 18% in volume.

items.statement: Hedging maintained at ~50% under Board policy due to gold price volatility; intend to move toward 75-80% as conditions stabilise; GML availability constrained in March-April, now normalised
items.quote: At present, we are maintaining hedging at approximately 50% because the last financial year saw extreme volatility. We need to balance liquidity risk with the risk of gold-price movements.

items.statement: Other expenses rose from ~INR80 crores to ~INR195 crores on store renovations, customer schemes and brand building; management says this run rate will not continue and will subside in upcoming quarters
items.quote: Exactly. This run rate will not continue, and we expect it to subside in the upcoming quarters.

items.statement: Long-term vision: INR20,000 crores+ revenue and 300+ stores over 4-5 years; target PAT margin 4.5%-5%, ROE/ROCE toward 20%
items.quote: Looking beyond individual quarters, our long-term vision is to build on the INR8,430 crores of revenue achieved in the previous financial year and, over the next 4-5 years, grow the company to INR20,000 crores-plus of revenue.

name: Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Ltd

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth to surpass last year's 37%; EBITDA margin upwards of 24% for full FY27.
items.quote: I think we have said that last year, we grew 37% Y-o-Y. As you can clearly see this year, we will easily surpass that growth even the EBITDA is concerned. I think the company is on track close to upwards of 24% EBITDA margin for the full FY27 is concerned.

items.statement: ARPOB growth guidance of 9% to 10% for the year.
items.quote: I think 9% to 10% is the right estimation to be taken.

items.statement: ARPOB to continue growing 8% to 10% year-on-year each year, including this fiscal.
items.quote: I think we have maintained that ARPOB will continue to grow somewhere between 8% to 10% Y-o-Y from each year. We are well on track for that. That's also expected for this fiscal year.

items.statement: Capex per bed for the next 1,800 beds expected at INR75 lakhs to INR80 lakhs.
items.quote: 1,800 beds that we're going to add. I think the capex per bed should be around INR75 lakhs to INR80 lakhs capex per bed, which includes the greenfield, the brownfield, the acquisitions.

items.statement: Gurugram hospital expected to go live by Q1 of next fiscal; 250 beds.
items.quote: The Gurugram construction is progressing as per expectations and we expect the hospital to go live by quarter 1 of the next fiscal with a potential to achieve an ARPOB of INR50,000 plus.

items.statement: Brownfield expansion of about 450 beds in Noida cluster to be live in about 15 months; 200 beds earlier, 250 beds in 18-19 months.
items.quote: And it includes around 450 beds of Brownfield addition in the two Noida cluster hospitals, which will be live in somewhere around next 15 months.

items.statement: Blended EBITDA margin expected to improve from current level.
items.quote: We expect our blended EBITDA margin to improve from the current level.

items.statement: New hospitals expected to reach 15% to 20% EBITDA margins within 15 to 18 months after breakeven.
items.quote: Both these 2 hospitals, from here, we are targeting, let's say, around 15 months, once they get breakeven, the EBITDA there could be somewhere around 15% to 20%.

items.statement: New hospitals expected to reach upwards of 25%, around 27% EBITDA margin within two years.
items.quote: Yes, so I think within two years from today, I think new hospitals should be even upwards of 25% of EBITDA margin, somewhere around 27%, just like our existing mature units.

items.statement: Incremental EBITDA at 70% occupancy expected around 22% to 23%.
items.quote: Whatever the occupancy is working right now, okay, so incremental EBITDA, let's say we talk about the 70% occupancy, incremental EBITDA will be around 22% to 23% EBITDA.

items.statement: Occupancy at Greater Noida and Noida Extension expected to improve further in coming quarters.
items.quote: We expect occupancy level at Greater Noida and Noida Extension to improve further in coming quarters.

items.statement: Oncology contributing close to 10% of group revenue with one LINAC; adding more LINACs at Faridabad and New Delhi.
items.quote: Oncology has already started contributing close to 10% to the group's revenue with only one LINAC machine currently at Noida Extension Hospital. We are in the process of adding another LINAC at our Faridabad Sector 20 hospital soon, followed by the New Delhi facility, which will meaningfully strengthen the oncology sales at the group level in the coming years.

items.statement: Management does not comment on proposal to limit hospital room charges to 3-star hotel rates; sees no significant impact.
items.quote: As of now, we don't want to comment on it. As industry moves on, when we receive some frameworks, then probably it will be appropriate for us to comment and see that.

items.statement: Debt increased to around INR300 crores from INR210 crores, partly for acquisition funding; comfortable with up to 2x trailing EBITDA debt.
items.quote: If you see that we have a debt in our books in March of nearly around INR210 crores which is now being increased to around INR300 crores. Basically, it has increased because we have partly taken the acquisition fund from the debts around INR80 crores.

items.statement: Depreciation expected around INR20 crores to INR30 crores per quarter, around INR29 crores, for next three quarters.
items.quote: If you see around INR20 crores to INR30 crores okay and the same trend will maintain so as and when we add in the Gurugram facility the then there is a margin increase in the at a group level group, consolidate level the trend we are projecting right now is around INR29 crores for a quarter.

items.statement: Interest cost of INR6.6 crores this quarter expected to continue as no fresh loans planned.
items.quote: So, if you see, so we have reported around the interest cost of last quarter is INR5 crores. This quarter we have reported around INR6.6 crores. The same will continue as we are not going to take any fresh loan further.

items.statement: Expect EBITDA per TEU to remain around INR 2,400 level going forward
items.quote: Going forward, we expect EBITDA per TEU to remain around INR2,400 level.

items.statement: Target EBITDA per TEU of INR 2,750 in 3-year plan including Farukhnagar project
items.quote: In our 3 years plan, we have targeted EBITDA per TEU of INR2,750. That's including Farukhnagar project.

items.statement: Endeavor to maintain EBITDA per TEU in range of INR 2,400 to INR 2,500 per TEU
items.quote: So we will endeavor to maintain profitability, EBITDA per TEU numbers in the range of INR2,400 to INR2,500 per TEU.

items.statement: Planned capex of close to INR 400 crores over 3-year plan 2030
items.quote: So overall, there is a requirement of close to INR400 crores of capex.

items.statement: Expect to incur close to INR 100 crores capex in current financial year FY27
items.quote: Close to INR100 crores of that capex we should incur in the current financial year, '26-27.

items.statement: Speedy JNPT expansion to incur around INR 20 crores capex in FY27
items.quote: In Speedy JNPA, we are expected to incur around INR20 crores of capex in this financial year

items.statement: Farukhnagar PFT completion by March 2027, ICD by Q3 FY28
items.quote: The PFT portion should get completed by February, March '27, and the ICD portion should get completed by Q3, which is October, November, December '27.

items.statement: Speedy JNPT expansion adds approximately 60,000 TEUs annual handling capacity
items.quote: This will add approximately 60,000 TEUs of annual handling capacity for us in Speedy JNPT

items.statement: Tax rate expected to remain at 25% under concessional tax regime
items.quote: Going forward, tax rate is expected to remain at 25% as we have moved to concessional tax regime from now onwards.

items.statement: Revenue per TEU increased from INR 11,000-11,500 to INR 13,000 per TEU
items.quote: if you see, I think a year back, we were hovering around INR11,000 to INR11,500 per TEU. Now that is something which we have been able to push at INR13,000 per TEU in the current financial quarter.

items.statement: Container volumes grew 7% year-on-year in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Our container volumes grew 7% year -on-year, demonstrating the resilience of our business model and the strength of our customer relationships.

items.statement: Higher share of transhipment containers volume and upward rate revisions drove profitability improvement
items.quote: The improvement in profitability came on the back of operational efficiencies supported by technology improvements and by higher share of transhipment containers volume plus upward rate revisions at various locations.

items.statement: No dividend payout planned currently due to growth phase and capex requirements
items.quote: As of now, because considering the plans which we are having, we are staying away from declaring dividend at this point of time.

items.statement: Raised equity of INR 120 crores, INR 25 crores called, INR 90 crores yet to be called for capex funding
items.quote: Recently, we have raised an equity of INR120 crores. Out of that, INR25 crores we have already called and close to INR90 crores is yet to be called.

items.statement: Management transition: Pranav Choudhary to take over as MD from September 1, 2026
items.quote: Pranav will take charge from September 1 st. We have requested him also to be part of this call

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth target ~15% and EBITDA margin upwards of 10%
items.quote: For financial year 27, our objective remains to deliver approximately 15% revenue growth and EBITDA margins on upwards of 10%.

items.statement: EBITDA margin target 11-12% for FY27
items.quote: Our target this year is to achieve 11 -12%, more than 10%.

items.statement: Overall capacity utilization expected to reach 70-75% by year end
items.quote: Overall, it will be around 70-75%.

items.statement: Kutch new facility investment Rs 20-25 crore for 10,000 IBC units/month, commissioning by March 2027
items.quote: We are investing approximately 20 to 25 crore in a new facility with a capacity of 10,000 IBC units per month, which is expected to be commissioned by March 2027.

items.statement: Kutch plant revenue potential Rs 50 crore initially, up to Rs 100 crore at full capacity
items.quote: It is a 100 crore business, but we are going by 50 crores.

items.statement: EBITDA per ton increased to Rs 16,380 in Q1 FY27 vs Rs 11,252 in Q1 FY26 and Rs 15,053 in Q4 FY26
items.quote: EBITDA per ton increased to approximately 16 ,380 in Q 1 FY26 compared with 11 ,252 in Q1 FY26 and 15 ,053 in Q4FY26.

items.statement: Gross margin compressed to 23% in Q1 FY27 as raw material costs rose with price increases
items.quote: Gross profit rose 19% year -on-basis, but gross margin compressed a little to 23% as raw material costs rose in step with price increase.

items.statement: Gross margin expected to return to 26-27% as polymer prices normalize
items.quote: So we should have this understanding that this year also we will match the number of 26-27% in gross profit.

items.statement: Polymer drum selling price at Rs 193/kg in Q1 FY27 vs Rs 138/kg in Q4 FY26; expects price to settle at Rs 140/kg in 5-6 months
items.quote: In the last quarter, our selling price was Rs.138 in March. This time, my selling price of polymer drums is Rs.193 per kg. The selling price has increased by Rs.55.

items.statement: Raw material cost pass-through maintained; EBITDA per ton resilient despite volume decline
items.quote: This clearly demonstrates that despite the temporary volume impact, our pricing, product mix, and operating efficiency are supporting profitability at the unit level.

items.statement: Export volumes impacted by Middle East war and freight costs; expects recovery next quarter as rates normalize
items.quote: In the middle east, due to the war, freight cost has grown significantly, so there is a problem in export, we are not able to export. For this, it is growing by 2 -4% this quarter. And the growth that was supposed to happen has not happened, so everything should match from the next quarter.

items.statement: Wada facility contributed Rs 43 crore (19% of revenue) in Q1 FY27, operating above 70% utilization, targeting 80%
items.quote: Our WADA facility is in full swing now across HDPE, IBCs, and MS Drums, and is already operating above 70% utilization. We expect it to reach 80% during this year. The facility contributed approximately 43 crore or 19% of revenue from operations in this quarter, Q1 FY27.

items.statement: Reiterated FY27 revenue growth guidance of 15% year-on-year
items.quote: Despite the prevailing geopolitical uncertainty and the challenges arising from West Asia situation, we remain confident in the underlying demand environment and reiterate our FY27 revenue growth guidance of 15%.

items.statement: Expect EBITDA margin of 17% to 18% for FY27
items.quote: And we expect to target an EBITDA margin of 17% to 18% for the year.

items.statement: Placed order for fourth stainless steel bottle manufacturing line, commissioning expected by Q4 FY27, capacity increase 30-35%
items.quote: The new line is expected to be commissioned by Q4 FY27 and increasing our manufacturing capacity by approximately 30 to 35 percentage.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 capex of INR43.42 crores, including INR33.25 crores for Valsad factory building
items.quote: During Q1, the company incurred a total capital expenditure of INR43.42 crores, of which INR33.25 crores was capitalized towards the factory building in Valsad facility.

items.statement: New steel bottle line investment of INR15 crores, expected revenue generation INR30-35 crores
items.quote: we would be investing about INR15 crores and the expected revenue generatio n would be around INR30 crores to INR35 crores because it all depends on the product mix, what we make on that line

items.statement: Gross margin at 50% in Q1 FY27, down 31 bps YoY; EBITDA margin at 16.7%, down 46 bps YoY
items.quote: Gross profit stood at INR158.6 crores, up 10% year-on-year, with gross margin at 50%, broadly in line with historical levels with a modest 31 basis point year-on- year decline, which is driven by geopol itical uncertainties and an elevated cost environment across the industry

items.statement: Implemented selective price increases across all three segments and rationalized schemes and discounts to protect margins
items.quote: We have also taken proactive measures to protect margins, including rationalizing schemes and discounts and implementing selective price increases across all our three segments of businesses: Writing Instrument, Creatives, and Steel Bottle and Houseware business.

items.statement: Raw material price increases of 10-15%, company price hikes of 10% plus/minus in household categories
items.quote: A total of the price hike has been price increase in the raw materials have been to the tune of 10% to 15%. But our price hike here, we are talking of 10% plus/minus in household.

items.statement: Domestic sales grew 13% YoY to INR277 crores; exports flat at INR43 crores due to West Asia disruptions
items.quote: Domestic sales grew 13% Y-o-Y to INR277 crores compared to INR245 crores in Q1 FY26, reflecting continued demand for our brands in the domestic market. Exports stood at INR43 crores and remained broadly flat year-on-year, primarily due to disruptions in the West Asia, resulting in longer transit times and higher freight costs during the quarter.

items.statement: Creative Products and Steel Bottles & Houseware contributed ~31% of revenue in FY26, expected to increase to 35-38% in FY27
items.quote: With the planned capacity expansion in Steel Bottles and continued scaling up of the Creative Product business, we expect the combined contribution to increase to approximately 35% to 38% of overall company revenue in FY27.

items.statement: Pen segment growth was volume-driven with mass and mid-premium mix increasing
items.quote: No, I would say mass and mid has increased, because of the volumes, the mass and mid has increased.

items.statement: Steel bottle capacity utilization at ~65%, existing lines expected to generate ~INR100 crores revenue
items.quote: See, currently, so if you look at Stee l Bottles, currently, the capacity utilization is about 65% and going forward, historically also, whenever we cross 65%, 75%, we tend to invest in the new

items.statement: Working capital improved by 6 days YoY; expect further ~10 days improvement by end of FY27 as West Asia crisis stabilizes
items.quote: But going forward, we expect to streamline inventory levels as the West Asia crisis stabilizes with an anticipated improvement of approximately 10 days in our entire working capital cycle levels.

items.statement: Creative segment capacity expansion at Valsad plant to be commissioned by end of Q2 FY27, fungible for pens and creative products
items.quote: By end of next quarter is when we have the entire capacity in place. The building has been capitalized so far. It is built, but the machineries and mould, etcetera, are yet to be installed. So by end of this quarter is where we see it should start commissioning.

items.statement: Marketing investment guidance for FY27 is 8% to 10% of revenue
items.quote: Marketing investment during the quarter was approximately 8.5% of revenue, which is in line with our full year guidance of 8% to 10% through FY27.

items.statement: Near-term demand visibility remains uneven with soft discretionary spending and intense competition
items.quote: While near -term demand visibility may remain uneven, we believe Mufti 2.0 is building a stronger foundation for the brand's next phase of growth.

items.statement: Healthy consumer interest in April and part of May moderated towards mid-May
items.quote: Coming to the operating environment, we saw healthy consumer interest through April and part of May which moderated towards the mid of May.

items.statement: Opened 5 new stores and closed 7 underperforming stores, total store count now 427
items.quote: As part of our retail transformation strategy, we opened 5 new stores across leading malls and high streets while closing 7 underperfor ming stores, taking our total store count to 427.

items.statement: Gross margin at 61.6%, EBITDA margin at 21.2%, PAT margin at 1.8% for Q1 FY27
items.quote: Gross profit stood at INR77.2 crores with a GP margin of 61.6% for the quarter. EBITDA stood at INR26.6 crores. Our EBITDA margin stood at 21.2%.

items.statement: Aiming to increase same-store revenue in mid-single-digit numbers for FY27
items.quote: And see what we're looking to do this year, we are looking to increase the same-store revenue in the mid-single-digit numbers.

items.statement: Premiumization involves change in merchandise mix, not larger inventory base
items.quote: In fact, we are looking to sharpen our inventory, and it will not be a larger inventory base. It's just going to be a change in the merchandise mix.

items.statement: Unable to extrapolate growth numbers for next couple of years due to transformation phase
items.quote: I'd mentioned earlier also that for the next 2-odd years, it's going to be very difficult for us to say what exactly the numbers will pan out.

items.statement: Demand condition is muted and competition is intense
items.quote: It's both. See, the demand condition is also muted. The discretionary spend is soft in consumer segment. But at the same time, the competition also is intense.

items.statement: Inventory days expected to reduce but cyclical in nature
items.quote: So Jay, there should be some reduction in the inventory days. That is always the endeavour to.

items.statement: Marketing spend of 8% to 10% intended to continue for longer-term growth and brand salience
items.quote: We are spending roughly 8% to 10%, and we intend to continue doing that. And this is for the longer-term growth and sustainability of the brand and to arouse the salience of the brand.

items.statement: New stores opened are generating good revenue
items.quote: No, no. All the new stores we have opened are generating good revenue.

items.statement: Unable to confirm revenue growth will exceed ad spend within one year
items.quote: No. I'm unable to say that today, Nilesh.

items.statement: Focus on improving brand performance and resilience rather than increasing store count
items.quote: So, at this time, we are not only in favour of increasing our store count, we are in favo ur of improving the performance and improving the brand resilience.

items.statement: Premiumization strategy applied across all tiers relative to local market conditions
items.quote: So premiumization is happening all across India. It's not somethin g that is isolated to the Tier 1 cities. However, premiumization is relative.

items.statement: Industry AC growth expected around 20% in FY27; EPACK aims to surpass industry growth and grow non-AC categories faster
items.quote: For AC, we are very confident that this year, the industry is expected to grow at around 20%. So we would definitely surpass the industry growth as we have done it in Q1.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 capex ~INR10 cr; total FY26-27 capex budget INR450 cr, of which INR340-350 cr booked, INR40-45 cr in CWIP, balance INR60-70 cr for rest of year
items.quote: Out of a total budget of INR450-odd crores, which we announced in the beginning of FY26, out of which INR340 crores to INR350 crores is something which is already booked. An additional INR10 crores of capex has been booked in the last quarter, Q1 of FY27 and almost INR40 crores to INR45 crores is something which is in CWIP. So we are estimating a total additional capex of around INR60 crores to IN

items.statement: Robust order book driving Sri City utilization improvement; targeting 55-60% annual utilization across three plants
items.quote: The company with its current robust order book is very confident that the utilizations going forward, especially for Sri City, where there has been a concern over the last few quarters, improving significantly.

items.statement: Underlying EBITDA margin ~6.5% ex-PLI; PLI benefit ~1.5-2% being rolled back, aiming to reverse full PLI discount by year-end for normalized EBITDA next year
items.quote: Currently, yes, 6.5% has been the typical EBITDA net of PLI or excluding PLI for the last couple of quarters. But here, the important thing to note is approximately 1.5% to 2% has been the PLI benefit, which was typically partly passed on and partly retained by the company.

items.statement: Commodity price increases passed on quarterly with lag; forex loss of INR6-7 cr impacted Q1 margins; no forward commodity hedging
items.quote: What impacted us most for the last quarter was especially the forex exchange rate. So that is 1 line item we'd like to flag, which like the forex loss is something which has impacted us largely.

items.statement: AC inventory at 3.5-4 million units, lowest acceptable level; trade largely liquidated old BEE-rated stock; non-AC inventory building for festive season
items.quote: So my estimate here would be all put together, the trade and the brands and everything put together, the inventory level would be anywhere at 3.5 million to 4 million maximum. So inventory levels are lower than what actually is at this point of time.

items.statement: Non-AC revenue grew 68% YoY to ~INR130 cr; SDA/LDA gross margin 1.5-2% higher than AC; 73 customers, 19 product lines, targeting 75 customers and 20 lines by year-end
items.quote: SDA, LDA from approx INR80 crores last year has grown to INR130 crores. So that's the small and large domestic appliances.

items.statement: Compressor QCO import allowed till year-end; domestic capacity sufficient for industry demand; no near-term compressor supply risk
items.quote: Especially in terms of compressors, the QCO allows us to import for the next few months. But at the same time, the domestic capacity ramp-up has happened significantly. And as an industry, we believe that there is sufficient capacity to cater to the industry for the coming season.

items.statement: Andhra Pradesh MoU for INR1,085 cr investment over 5 years from Jan 2024; 35 acres land allotted; ~50% capex subsidy over 10 years
items.quote: The MoU is about the investments we have committed over next 5 years, starting -- which is effective till -- so that's amounting of INR1,085 crores beginning -- starting the investment recognized is from beginning of January '24.

items.statement: Sri City utilization doubled to ~50% in Q1 FY27 from <25% last year; Dehradun and Bhiwadi at >85%; targeting >60% blended annual utilization
items.quote: For Q1, Dehradun and Bhiwadi capacity utilization was closer to 90%. And as far as Sri City is concerned, we have seen a significant improvement in utilization of Sri City from previous reported of less than 25%, we've achieved almost close to 50% utilization of Sri City for the Q1.

items.statement: RAC growth 44% YoY: ~30% volume, ~14% value (AOP increase and commodity pass-through); anchor customer driven
items.quote: The total growth for RAC reported is 44%, approximately 30% of which is volume growth and 12% to 15% is typically the value growth in terms of the increased AOPs and the pass-on of commodities.

items.statement: Depreciation at Q1 level (~INR16-17 cr) expected stable for rest of FY27; no significant capex additions to increase depreciation
items.quote: The Q1 numbers for the depreciation are more or less aligned for the rest. So it has increased as compared to Q4 because the new capacities have been put to use. So there isn't any significant capex in pipeline or CWIP pipeline for the rest of the year.

items.statement: Finance cost up INR3-4 cr QoQ due to 40% revenue growth and working capital needs; inventory normalization key to reducing finance cost
items.quote: Finance cost has also gone up slightly because there is a requirement with respect to the scale of the operations. The company has seen a growth of 40% i n this current quarter as compared to the previous one.
