items.quote: Our inpatient volumes grew by about 39%, and OP volumes by 26% over Q1 of last year.

items.statement: Centres of Excellence revenue contribution rose to about 65% in Q1 FY27, with IP revenues growing 45%.
items.quote: Our Centres of Excellence, the six centres that we consider as our high -acuity specialties -- Cardiology, Cardiac Sciences actually, Oncology, Neurology, Gastroenterology, Orthopaedics, and Renal Sciences continue to be a key growth driver, their revenue contribution rising to about 65% in Q1 of FY27.

items.statement: Oncology share of network revenue grew from 10.8% last year to 12.2%.
items.quote: You could see that from 10.8% in last year, it has already grown to 12.2% at a network level.

items.statement: Electronic City hospital (50th) added about 300 beds in July; Raipur expected to commission in Q4 FY27.
items.quote: We have Raipur, which should be coming on stream towards the end of this year or, last quarter of this fiscal.

items.statement: Nashik brownfield added 103 beds plus LINAC and PET-CT, raising licensed capacity to 307 beds.
items.quote: We commissioned a brownfield capacity addition of 103 beds along with the newly installed linear accelerator and PET -CT at our Nashik hospital, increasing its overall licensed bed capacity to 307 beds.

items.statement: Acquired Kinder Hospital in Whitefield, Bangalore; plans to remodel into multispecialty, adding 100 beds.
items.quote: In addition, a few days ago, the company announced a transaction to acquire the entire business operations and assets of Kinder Hospital in the Whitefield area of Bangalore.

items.statement: Government scheme patient collections were slow in Q1, similar to the broader sector.
items.quote: The other difference would be, Shyam, that in Q1, some of the collection, particularly the scheme patients collection has been a little slow, like the whole sector has been talking about.

items.statement: No plans to bring medical colleges into the listed entity; will stay focused on tertiary and quaternary care hospitals.
items.quote: No, Karan. We have no such plans. You know, we believe Manipal Health Enterprises should remain focused on providing the highest end of tertiary and quaternary care, the brick-and -mortar hospitals that we run.

items.statement: Raising growth guidance to high teens for next few quarters while holding underlying 20% EBITDA margin range.
items.quote: Based on our recent performance and the current environment, we are raising our growth guidance to high teens for next few quarters while holding on to our margin range of underlying 20% EBITDA.

items.statement: Holding guidance of 20% underlying EBITDA margin going forward.
items.quote: Having said this, on margin, we are holding on to our guidance of 20% underlying margin in terms of EBITDA, and this is something which we will sustain as we go forward.

items.statement: PAT delivery in line with plans to deliver double-digit growth for the full year.
items.quote: I want to firstly call out that our PAT delivery is fully in line with our plans to deliver a double -digit growth for the year.

items.statement: Recovered entire cost impact in Q1 and confident of continuing to do so in future quarters.
items.quote: I think net -net, what's important is that in quarter 1, we have recovered the entire cost impact, and we are absolutely confident that we will continue to do so in the future quarters as well.

items.statement: All customer contracts on blended cost basis, so currency depreciation and freight increases also recovered.
items.quote: So all our customer contracts, Sanjesh, are on blended cost basis. So currency depreciation also gets recovered. Freight also saw a sharp increase, and we have been able to recover that from the customers.

items.statement: On steady-state basis, EBITDA will grow faster than revenue growth.
items.quote: On a steady -state basis, our EBITDA will grow faster than our revenue growth.

items.statement: B&C market share currently 8%, believed can double to 16% in next few years.
items.quote: Currently, our market share is 8%. This, we believe, can go up to 16%.

items.statement: Expects high inflationary environment to persist for some time.
items.quote: At this stage, we expect to operate in a high inflationary environment for some time.

items.statement: Europe margins expected to improve to target range of mid-teens in coming quarters.
items.quote: And I think in the coming quarters, we will see Europe margins improving to our target range of mid-teens.

items.statement: Europe operational challenges identified and getting focus; confident of full resolution in coming quarters.
items.quote: These have been identified and are getting disproportionate focus from the team. We are confident that these will get fully resolved in the coming quarters.

items.statement: Merger with Indovida on track to complete within planned timeline; CCI approval received.
items.quote: During the quarter, we received approval from the Competition Commission of India and the transaction continues to progress well. We remain on track to complete it within our planned timeline and are excited about the opportunities this partnership will create for our customers, employees and shareholders.

items.statement: Actively scouting acquisitions in new formats or new markets meeting growth and margin criteria.
items.quote: We are interested in moving into new formats, and we actively are scouting for opportunities for acquisition. As far as acquisitions are concerned, our strategy is very clear.

items.statement: Full-year effective tax rate expected to land between 20% to 22%.
items.quote: I think this year, on a full year basis, we should land anywhere between 20% to 22%. That's how we are looking at it.

items.statement: Sustainable tubes now account for 44% of overall product mix.
items.quote: We continue to make meaningful progress on our sustainability agenda with sustainable tubes now accounting for 44% of our overall product mix.

items.statement: Oral Care 24% growth not expected every quarter; B&C continues to show momentum.
items.quote: The 24% growth will not be something which we'll be able to deliver every quarter, but this quarter has been exceptional on Oral.

items.statement: Thailand operations beginning to ramp up, expected to be another growth driver going forward.
items.quote: Our Thailand operations are beginning to ramp up, and Thailand is a really significant B&C market, and this ramp -up will be another growth driver as we go forward.

items.statement: Group console top line grew 17% QoQ and 38.5% YoY in Q1 FY27
items.quote: So if you look at sequentially, sequential quarter, our top line is growing at about 17 % and YOY, we are up about 38.5 %.

items.statement: Group console EBITDA grew to Rs 12.41 crore in Q1 FY27 from Rs 11.3 crore QoQ and Rs 8.8 crore YoY
items.quote: Of course EBITDA also has, performed fairly well. I would say that we're up from about 11.3 crores to about 12.4 crores sequentially and up from 8.8 crores to about 12.4 crores YOY.

items.statement: Group console sales rose to Rs 186.5 crore in Q1 FY27 from Rs 134.73 crore YoY
items.quote: So that's how, you know, the group console sales have moved up from a 34.73 crores to about a 186.5 crores during the Q1 FY 27.

items.statement: Gross margin declined 145 bps QoQ and 181 bps YoY due to commodity pass-through, but absolute operating profit grew
items.quote: So sequentially, if you look at the gross contributions come down a little bit, I would say quarterly basis or let's say sequential basis, 145 bps, year on year basis down about 181 bps.

items.statement: Margin percentage decline is due to commodity price pass-through; absolute operating profit grew from Rs 8.5 crore to Rs 12.5 crore YoY
items.quote: Therefore, in percentage terms, the margin appears to be getting eroded because, you know, the selling price increases, the selling price per valve, e.g., increases but the margin in absolute term remains the same.

items.statement: Planning Rs 15 crore capex in FY27: Rs 10 crore for automotive (tubeless, TPMS, EV components) and Rs 5 crore for Future Tech (special alloys)
items.quote: Yeah, so I'd say CapEx wise at the group level, we want to invest about 15 cores this year. I would say about about 10 crores would go into the automotive segment, about five cores would go into Future tech which is the metal segment.

items.statement: Strong demand continues in Q2 for both automotive and metals; automotive at 85-90%+ capacity utilization in tubeless, TPMS, EV segments
items.quote: So broadly I would say strong demand continues even now in Q2 with both automotive and metals, right.

items.statement: Automotive volume growth ~20% YoY, rest value growth; metals grew 42% YoY but impacted by war-related raw material issues in April
items.quote: I'd say about 20 % is volume growth and the rest is, I would say value growth.

items.statement: Favorable product mix in Q1; new EV components, global projects (AUMOVIO, SENSATA, BOSCH), special alloys in metals, import substitution gaining share
items.quote: There's some global projects that the company is working on. You would have seen some disclosures, right, with that we made. We've received some LOIs from AUMOVIO and SENSATA these are two large global players in the TPMS census base and BOSCH, of course, is our existing customer also scaling up right now.

items.statement: Geopolitical risks (Middle East war, trade wars, supply chain disruptions) driving import substitution opportunity; copper prices doubled in 12 months
items.quote: I think every car maker, every vehicle manufacturer in the world today knows that the next five to ten years, the biggest challenge is going to be Supply chain, there's going to be disruption, there's more in the pipeline, right.

items.statement: Expect to sustain growth momentum through rest of FY27 in automotive; new programs with AUMOVIO, SENSATA, automotive AC, aftermarket, EV two-wheeler to fuel growth in H2
items.quote: I don't see any challenges for us to sustain this growth momentum through the rest of this year in automotive.

items.statement: EV portfolio expanding beyond battery valves to charging infrastructure, motor control centers, battery terminals; commercialization in 6-12 months
items.quote: We are looking at components related to the charging infrastructure, right? This is the, I would say the charger cable, right. It has certain very special high precision components. We have already prototyped tested.

items.statement: Merger of Tritonvalves Climatech completed; tax credit of Rs 4.75 crore boosted Q1 PAT to Rs 9.75 crore (vs Rs 5.25 crore without)
items.quote: We also got a benefit of the merger, right, in Q1. So, there is a tax credit that we received of about 4.75 crores. So, if you look at it, the reported PAT has moved up to about 9.75, right, whereas without the merger benefit, our part would have been somewhere at about 5.25 crores.

items.statement: Net reporting of brass scrap sales implemented from Q1 FY27; reduces standalone top line optically but improves ratios; no impact on consolidated numbers
items.quote: We also implemented net reporting of brass scrap sales from Q1 FY 27. This is something that we've been talking about on, on some of these calls also in the past that, we were reporting scrap sales, right, Which are kind of invoiced from the hold co. to the subsidiary and August 21,2026 then you know the brass crap gets converted back into brass bars coils and comes back to the hold co

items.statement: Targeting debt/EBITDA 2.5-3x by end of FY27; ROCE improved to 12.5% annualized; inventory held strategically due to rising LME outlook
items.quote: Debt to EBITDA, we are just kind of hovering around the three mark. We are trying our best to bring that under three maybe somewhere between two and a half to three by the end of the year.

items.statement: Estimated feed sales for FY27 around 5,85,000 MTs.
items.quote: It is estimated that the feed sales during FY27 would be around 5,85,000 MTs.

items.statement: Estimated shrimp exports for FY27 around 19,000 MTs.
items.quote: It is estimated that exports during FY27 would be around 19,000 MTs.

items.statement: Estimated investment in pet food around INR 175 crores; land purchased for INR 25 crores.
items.quote: We are estimating around INR 175 crores investment in a pet food. Till now, we have purchased land around INR 25 crores worth of land.

items.statement: PBT margin was 7.06% on revenue in Q1 FY27.
items.quote: The PBT during the quarter stood at 7.06% on revenue as compared to about 13% during Q4 FY 26 and 17% during Q1 FY26.

items.statement: Shrimp culture activity is progressing well with favorable climate and attractive farm-gate prices.
items.quote: At present, the shrimp culture activity is very good. The farmers are very happy that the culture is progressing very well with the climate is also favorable.

items.statement: FY26/27 expected to be challenging for aquaculture due to steep increase in feed raw material prices and global demand issues.
items.quote: To sum up, in general, FY 26/27 is expected to be a challenging season for the aquaculture industry in respect of shrimp production due to steep increase in feed raw material prices as well as exports from India and global demand for shrimp exports.

items.statement: Present purchase prices: fish meal INR 225/kg, soya bean meal INR 71/kg, wheat flour INR 33/kg.
items.value: fish meal INR 225 per kg; soya bean meal INR 71 per kg; wheat flour INR 33 per kg
items.quote: The present purchase price of fish meal isINR 225 per kg; soya bean meal isINR 71 per kg and wheat flour is INR 33 per kg.

items.statement: Average consumption price of fish meal increased to INR 153/kg in Q1 FY27 from INR 123/kg in Q4 FY26 and INR 93/kg in Q1 FY26.
items.quote: The average consumption price of fish meal increased in Q1 to INR 153 per kg from INR 123 per kg in Q4 FY26 and increased from INR 93 per kg in Q1 FY 26.

items.statement: Soya bean meal prices increased to INR 58/kg in Q1 FY27 from INR 49 in Q4 FY26 and INR 40 in Q1 FY26.
items.quote: In price of soya bean meal, their prices increased to INR 58 per kg in Q1 FY27 from INR 49 in Q4 FY26 and increased from 40 in Q1 FY26.

items.statement: Wheat flour price decreased to INR 28/kg in Q1 FY27 from INR 31/kg in Q4 and Q1 FY26.
items.quote: However, the wheat flour price decreased to INR 28 per kg in Q1 FY 27 from INR 31 per kg in Q4 and Q1 FY26.

items.statement: Shrimp production estimated at 8-9 lakh MTs in calendar year 2026; feed consumption estimated at 11-12 lakh MTs.
items.quote: On the basis of estimated shrimp production of about 8-9 lakh MTs in calendar year 2026, the feed consumption is estimated to be about 1 1-12 lakh MTs.

items.statement: Pet food sales increased to INR 180 lakh in Q1 FY27 from INR 151 lakh in Q4 FY26.
items.quote: Q1 FY26/27 sales increased to INR180 lakh compared to INR151 lakhs in Q4 FY25/26, reflecting continued growth in both cat food and dog food segment.

items.statement: Raw material prices expected to stabilize in coming months upon arrival of fresh crops due to favorable monsoon.
items.quote: However, due to favorable monsoon across India, El Nino effects are expected to ease and raw material prices of shrimp feed are expected to stabilize in coming months upon arrival of fresh crops.

items.statement: Company plans to expand pet food product portfolio with new flavors and variants.
items.quote: The company is planning to expand its product portfolio by introducing a new flavor and variants to cater evolving consumer preferences and further strengthen its market presence.

items.statement: Construction of pet food manufacturing facility will commence upon receipt of Consent for Establishment approval.
items.quote: The company has submitted an application to Consent for Establishment to the concerned government authority, and the approval process is currently underway. Construction activity will commence upon receipt of the necessary approval.

items.statement: Targeting annual revenue growth of approximately 25% to 30% and revenue of INR5,000 crores by 2030
items.quote: Your company is poised to achieve a revenue mark of INR5,000 crores by 2030. We are targeting annual revenue growth of approximately 25% to 30%, supported by our strong B2B foundation, expanding B2C and digital ecosystem and value creation across every segment of the business.

items.statement: Expecting 30% revenue growth for full year FY27 if current pace continues
items.quote: In that case, yes, that overall today's top line, if you consider, we would be able to achieve 30% growth.

items.statement: B2C contribution target increased to approximately 40% of overall revenue by FY2030
items.quote: Our retail expansion is aimed to accelerating our B2C growth and increasing the B2C contribution to approximately 40% of overall revenue by FY 2030.

items.statement: Planning 8 to 10 new stores over next 3 to 4 years, mix of flagship and boutique formats
items.quote: B2C business will be the key growth driver going forward, and we have a very aggressive plan to launch 8 to 10 stores over the next 3 to 4 years across geographies.

items.statement: Expect EBITDA and PAT margins to improve as retail share increases to 40% by FY2030
items.quote: Since the overall share of the retail is going to increase to 40%, we are targeting to reach at least 40% of the retail sale by FY 2030. So in that case, the share of retail increases, then our margins of what they say, retail sale will be -- our margins -- retail margins will be high.

items.statement: Seeing very good demand for upcoming marriage and festival seasons despite recent gold price surge
items.quote: We are seeing a very good demand in the very upcoming near future. So this price rise will be easily digested.

items.statement: B2B order books already in execution for festive season, foresee very good next quarter
items.quote: As the season starts now from 15 days after 15 days, all the order books are already in execution, and there are upcoming shows also where we are planning to participate. In that case, we have a good demand.

items.statement: Gold price spikes cause 1-2 week slowdown before demand normalizes; customers digest price increases
items.quote: Every time when there is a steep rise in the prices, yes, there is a certain slowdown of, say, for a fortnight or 2 weeks. Then that price get digested. And once again, the upcoming seasons are coming up.

items.statement: Flagship showroom running at INR30-35 crores monthly revenue, targeting INR500 crores annual revenue
items.quote: Sir, it is around monthly figure you said approximately around INR30 crores to INR35 crores.

items.statement: Main board migration application submission underway, process expected to complete in 2 months
items.quote: We are into the submission process of the application and all the documentation part, and we are going to submit the documentation very shortly. Surely, we would be -- the migration process will be completed in another 2 months, we believe.

items.statement: Inventory turnover days increased from 63 to 73 days due to new retail store inventory
items.quote: It has all over the last years as Q4 FY26, if you take the inventory turnover ratio was 63 and now it is 73 days.

items.statement: Total bank limit of INR100 crores for working capital; no long-term debt; will use internal earnings for retail expansion
items.quote: So the company is having a total bank limit of INR100 crores till date.

items.statement: Old gold exchange contributes 15-20% of retail sales, increased after government policy change
items.quote: So the old gold exchange is total -- out of the total sale, old gold exchange is somewhere around 15% to 20%. Now it has increased. Last year, it was less after the Modi ji statement, it has increased.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 volume growth in jewellery quantum was around 15% year-on-year
items.quote: So the growth in the quantum was around 15%.

items.statement: Wholesale working capital cycle 40-45 days, retail 100-120 days; expect positive cash flow this fiscal
items.quote: Yes, what they say in wholesale, the average working cycle is around 40 to 45 days. And in the retail segment, it is nearly 100 to 120 days.

items.statement: Current inventory level approximately INR460 crores as of Q1 FY27
items.quote: Yes, inventory is approximately around INR460 crores.

items.statement: Cumulative order book of approximately INR 1,500 crores over and above existing business, spread over four to five years
items.quote: I think a cumulative order book of approximately INR1,500 crores is what we have overand above the existing businesses from existing as wellas new customers. And this is of course not an annualized order book. This will be spread over four to five years, and that is what we can share at this point of time.

items.statement: Indian PV market showing strong growth with new programs from Mahindra, Tata Motors, Maruti Suzuki starting production in Q1
items.quote: The Indian PV market has continued to demonstrate strong growth, and we are secing this momentum reflected directly in our customer programs. Several new programs with our key customers, including Mahindra, Tata Motors, Maruti Suzuki, have started production during this quarter.

items.statement: Investing ahead of customer requirements in capacity additions, automation, and technology upgrades
items.quote: Our customers are significantly investing in additional capacity, new vehicle programs, and localization, and we are investing ahead of these requirements in capacity additions, automation, and technology upgrades.

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin at 13% and PAT margin at 9% for Q1 FY27
items.quote: For the standalone business, the total income increased by 6.6% quarter-on-quarter to INR173 crores, EBITDA margin stood at 13%, and PAT margin stood at 9%.

items.statement: Actively looking at acquisition opportunities in India to grow into new products, markets, and customers beyond camshafts
items.quote: We are also actively looking at acquisition opportunities within India, and that will be a way for us to grow into new products, new markets, new customers, and so on. So, it's not necessarily only camshafts, but we will focus on our India operations, that is for sure.

items.statement: Confident about long-term outlook for standalone Indian business, continuing to invest in capacity, automation, and technology
items.quote: Our standalone Indian business is cntering a period of significant opportunity, supported by strong growth in the Indian passenger vehicle market, increasing investments by our customers, several new orders already sceured, and a healthy pipeline of new programs, We are therefore continuing to invest in capacity, automation, and technology to take advantage of this growth.

items.statement: EHCV platform developed and delivered to customer for evaluation and field trials
items.quote: Our own c-mobility business in India with our clectric heavy commercial vehicle platform continues to progress. We have developed the EHCV platform and delivered the vehicle to a customer, and the customer is still undergoing evaluation and field trials at this point.
